## Energy Efficiency Regulations, 2016 {#energy-efficiency-regulations-2016 .Title-of-Act}

[SOR]{.abbr title="Statutory Orders and Regulations"}/2016-311
:::

[ENERGY EFFICIENCY ACT](/eng/acts/E-6.4)

Registration 2016-12-09

Energy Efficiency Regulations, 2016

P.C. 2016-1111 2016-12-09
::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: section
::: {.section .order}
Whereas, pursuant to section 26 of the [Energy Efficiency
Act](/eng/acts/E-6.4)[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13924){#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13924-ID0EFBBA},
a copy of the proposed [Energy Efficiency Regulations,
2016](/eng/regulations/SOR-2016-311), substantially in the annexed form,
was published in the [Canada Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/), Part
I, on April 30, 2016;

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13924-ID0EFBBA){#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13924}S.C.
  1992, c. 36
  :::

Therefore, His Excellency the Governor General in Council, on the
recommendation of the Minister of Natural Resources, pursuant to
sections 20[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^b^](#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13925){#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13925-ID0EGBAA}
and 25 of the [Energy Efficiency Act](/eng/acts/E-6.4)[[Footnote
]{.wb-invisible}^a^](#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13924){#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13924-ID0EDBAA},
makes the annexed [Energy Efficiency Regulations,
2016](/eng/regulations/SOR-2016-311).

- ::: Footnote
  [[Return to footnote
  ]{.wb-invisible}^b^](#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13925-ID0EGBAA){#fn_81000-2-650-Epostedit_hq_13925}S.C.
  2009, c. 8, s. 5
  :::
:::

## [Interpretation]{.HTitleText1} {#h-835208 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  following definitions apply in these Regulations.

  [[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the [Energy Efficiency
      Act](/eng/acts/E-6.4). ([Loi]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[adhesive tag]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[adhesive tag]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a label that is
      attached to an energy-using product by at least two strips of
      adhesive that are located on opposite edges of the
      label. ([étiquette adhésive]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[AHRI]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[AHRI]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Air-Conditioning, Heating
      and Refrigeration Institute. ([AHRI]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ANSI]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ANSI]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the American National Standards
      Institute. ([ANSI]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ASHRAE]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ASHRAE]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the American Society of
      Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers,
      Inc. ([ASHRAE]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CGA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CGA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Canadian Gas
      Association. ([ACG]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CIE]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CIE]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the International Commission on
      Illumination. ([CIE]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CSA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CSA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Canadian Standards
      Association. ([CSA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flap tag]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flap tag]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a label whose top edge is
      attached to an energy-using product by one strip of
      adhesive. ([vignette]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[hang tag]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[hang tag]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a label that is attached to
      an energy-using product by material that is looped around a
      section of the product so that the label hangs freely from the
      product. ([étiquette volante]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[household]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[household]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means manufactured or sold
      primarily for use in a dwelling. ([domestique]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[IEC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[IEC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the International
      Electrotechnical Commission. ([CEI]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[IEEE]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[IEEE]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Institute of Electrical and
      Electronics Engineers. ([IEEE]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[IES]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[IES]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Illuminating Engineering
      Society of North America. ([IES]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mains power]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mains power]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an alternating current
      electric power source that is in a building and is less than or
      equal to a nominal 240-volt single-phase supply. ([alimentation
      principale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[model number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[model number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of any
      model of an energy-using product, the designator that is assigned
      to that model for the purposes of these Regulations and that
      distinguishes it from similar models. ([numéro de
      modèle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[NEMA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[NEMA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the National Electrical
      Manufacturers Association. ([NEMA]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[new Regulations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[new Regulations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means these Regulations as
      they read on the day on which subsection 1(2) of the Regulations
      Amending the Energy Efficiency Regulations, 2016 (Amendment 18)
      comes into force. ([nouveau règlement]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[unique motor identifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[unique motor identifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      identifier consisting of the information set out below, in the
      following sequence:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the manufacturer, in abbreviated
        form;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the nominal power of the motor, expressed in
        kilowatts for an IEC design motor or in horsepower for a NEMA
        design motor;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the number of poles; and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement as to whether the motor is of open
        or enclosed construction. ([identificateur unique du
        moteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reference to energy-using product

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In these Regulations, a reference to an energy-using
  product is a reference to that product as defined in the Division or
  Subdivision associated with it.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Incorporated standards

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In these Regulations, a reference to an AHRI, ANSI,
  ASHRAE, CGA, CIE, CSA, IES or NEMA MG-1 standard is to be read as a
  reference to the standard as amended from time to time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- test procedure waivers

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} In these Regulations, a reference to a testing
  standard that is incorporated by reference does not include any test
  procedure waiver that may be set out in that standard.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standards and procedures of other
jurisdiction incorporated by reference

**[[1.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1.1 .sectionLabel}** Despite these
Regulations, if an energy efficiency standard or test procedure that is
incorporated by reference in these Regulations as amended from time to
time is a reference to a standard or test procedure set out in the laws
of another jurisdiction and that standard or procedure is subsequently
repealed or revoked in that other jurisdiction, the reference to the
standard or procedure in these Regulations is deemed to be a reference
to that standard or procedure as it read on the day before the day on
which it was repealed or revoked and it continues to apply for the
purposes of these Regulations.

## [PART 1]{.HLabel1}[General]{.HTitleText1} {#h-835238 .Part}

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-835239 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Part.

[[certification body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[certification body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of an
    energy-using product, a body that is accredited by the Standards
    Council of Canada to operate a certification program in respect of
    the energy efficiency of the product. ([organisme de
    certification]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[verification mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[verification mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of an
    energy-using product, a mark that is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} issued by a certification body to signify that
      the body has

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} determined that the product complies with the
        applicable energy efficiency standard, and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the product is one for which information
        must be provided to the Minister for the purpose of subsection
        5(1) of the Act, verified the information that is related to the
        product's energy performance; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} issued by a province to signify that the product
      complies with the province's energy efficiency standard. ([marque
      de vérification]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Incorporated products

**[[3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3 .sectionLabel}** Unless otherwise specified
by these Regulations, an energy-using product that is incorporated into
another product remains an energy-using product for the purposes of
these Regulations even if the other product is not an energy-using
product.

### [Verification Mark]{.HTitleText2} {#h-835250 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Verification mark

- **[[4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject
  to subsections (3) to (5), every energy-using product that, for the
  purpose of sale or lease, is shipped from one province to another or
  imported into Canada must be labelled with a verification mark that is
  issued by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a certification body; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a province whose energy efficiency standard for the
    product is equivalent to or exceeds the energy efficiency standard
    prescribed for the product in these Regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location and visibility

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The verification mark must be readily visible on the
  surface of the energy-using product. However, in respect of the
  following energy-using products, the verification mark may be on the
  exterior of the product's package:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a CFL;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a general service lamp;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a modified spectrum incandescent lamp;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a general service fluorescent lamp;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a general service incandescent reflector lamp;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a battery charger; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} an external power supply.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- CFL

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A CFL is not required to be labelled with a
  verification mark if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a laboratory that is accredited to test the energy
    performance of lighting products by either the Standards Council of
    Canada or the National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program
    has verified the values for nominal power, luminous flux and
    correlated colour temperature provided to the Minister under
    subsection 432(1); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a laboratory that is referred to in paragraph (a),
    an A2LA certified laboratory or an ISO 9000 certified laboratory or
    manufacturing facility has

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the life testing of the CFL is completed,
      verified the value for life provided to the Minister under
      subsection 432(1), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the life testing of the CFL is not completed,
      verified 40% of its design life and at that point in the testing
      not more than one unit in the test sample has failed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- external power supplies

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An external power supply is not required to be
  labelled with a verification mark if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is labelled with a mark in accordance with the
    U.S. Department of Energy publication entitled "International
    Efficiency Marking Protocol for External Power Supplies", as amended
    from time to time;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a certification body has verified the information
    related to the product's energy performance that is provided to the
    Minister for the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} it is labelled with the same model number as that
    used when the information was verified.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- general service lamps

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Until March 31, 2018, a general service lamp is not
  required to be labelled with a verification mark if a certification
  body

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has determined that the lamp complies with the
    applicable energy efficiency standard; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has verified the information related to the
    product's energy performance that is provided to the Minister for
    the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 2](#1044827-1125222){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1044827-1125222.html"}
:::

### [Provision of Information]{.HTitleText2} {#h-835273 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed information

- **[[5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A dealer
  who, for the purpose of sale or lease, ships an energy-using product
  from one province to another or imports an energy-using product into
  Canada must, for the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, provide
  the following information to the Minister:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the product as prescribed in these
    Regulations;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product, if any;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the product's model number or, in the case of a
    motor, the product's model number or unique motor identifier;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of the product's manufacturer;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} one of the following, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name of the certification body or province
      whose verification mark will be on the product or its package,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a CFL, the name of the laboratory
      referred to in paragraph 4(3)(a) and the name of the laboratory or
      manufacturing facility referred to in paragraph 4(3)(b),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an external power supply, the
      name of the certification body referred to in paragraph 4(4)(b),
      or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a general service lamp or
      modified spectrum incandescent lamp for which there is no energy
      efficiency standard, if a laboratory that is accredited to test
      the energy performance of lighting products by either the
      Standards Council of Canada or the National Voluntary Laboratory
      Accreditation Program has verified the information displayed on
      the product's package, the name of that laboratory;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other information that is prescribed in these
    Regulations to be provided to the Minister for the purpose of
    subsection 5(1) of the Act; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether a mathematical
    model described in subsection (3) was used to generate any of the
    information provided under paragraph (f).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Manner and time

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be provided electronically or by
  fax, hand delivery, courier or mail before the product is imported
  into Canada or shipped from one province to another.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Mathematical model

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite any provision in these Regulations requiring
  that the information referred to in this section be collected in
  accordance with an identified standard, a dealer may instead provide
  the information as generated by a mathematical model that, by means of
  an engineering or statistical analysis or a computer simulation or
  model, emulates the manner in which the information is collected under
  the identified standard.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-201, s. 3
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-5-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 5"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}CFL life information

- **[[6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-6 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite
  paragraph 5(1)(f), a dealer is not required to provide information
  related to the life of a CFL if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} at the time the information is to be provided the
    life testing of the product is not completed, but 40% of the
    product's design life has been verified as described in subparagraph
    4(3)(b)(ii); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the dealer provides the following information to
    the Minister together with the information provided under subsection
    5(1):

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement indicating that 40% of the product's
      design life has been verified,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the date on which life testing began,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the design life of the product, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the number of hours of life that have been
      verified.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Verified CFL life

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Within 30 days after the day on which the life
  testing of the CFL is completed, the dealer must provide the Minister
  with the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the product's life as verified; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name of the laboratory or manufacturing
    facility that performed the verification, if it is different from
    the name provided under subparagraph 5(1)(e)(ii).

### [Information Pertaining to Imports]{.HTitleText2} {#h-835307 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescribed information

- **[[7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-7 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A dealer
  who, for the purpose of sale or lease, imports an energy-using product
  into Canada must, for the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act,
  provide the following information to the Minister:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the product as prescribed in these
    Regulations;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product, if any;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the product's model number or, in the case of a
    motor, the product's model number or unique motor identifier;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the dealer's address; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a statement as to whether the product is being
    imported

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} for sale or lease in Canada without modification,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} for sale or lease in Canada after being modified
      to comply with the applicable energy efficiency standard, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} for incorporation into any other product that
      is to be exported from Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} However, the following energy-using products are
  not energy-using products for the purpose of subsection (1) if, at the
  time of their importation, they are incorporated into another product:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a battery charger;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an external power supply;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a fluorescent lamp ballast;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an electric motor; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a small electric motor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Manner and time

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be provided by including it in
  any customs invoice or commercial invoice that is required to be
  provided in respect of the energy-using product under subsection 6(1)
  of the [Accounting for Imported Goods and Payment of Duties
  Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-86-1062) and must be provided before
  the product is released under the [Customs Act](/eng/acts/C-52.6).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-201, s. 4
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-7-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 7"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Exemptions from Certain Provisions of the Act]{.HTitleText2} {#h-835330 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption --- product to be modified

- **[[8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A dealer
  is exempt from the application of paragraph 4(1)(a) of the Act if the
  dealer, for the purpose of modifying an energy-using product to comply
  with the applicable energy efficiency standard, ships the product from
  the province in which it was manufactured to another province or
  imports the product into Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Requirements

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The dealer must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} ensure that the product is brought into compliance
    with the applicable energy efficiency standard within 90 days after
    the day on which the product is shipped or imported;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} despite subsection 5(2), provide the information
    referred to in subsection 5(1) within 120 days after the day on
    which the product is shipped or imported; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if requested by the Minister, provide the Minister
    with any other information that is necessary to establish that the
    product has been brought into compliance with the applicable energy
    efficiency standard.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption --- incorporation into product
for export

**[[9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9 .sectionLabel}** A dealer is exempt from the
application of sections 4 and 5 of the Act with respect to the shipment
or importation of an energy-using product that is to be incorporated
into any other product that is to be exported from Canada.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption --- product to be exported

**[[10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-10 .sectionLabel}** A dealer is exempt from
the application of sections 4 and 5 of the Act if the dealer, for the
purpose of exporting the energy-using product from Canada, ships the
product from the province in which it was manufactured to another
province or imports the product into Canada.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption --- motors with same unique
motor identifier

**[[11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-11 .sectionLabel}** A dealer is exempt from
the application of section 5 of the Act in respect of a motor if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information has been provided in respect of a
  motor that has the same unique motor identifier; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the motor is at least as energy efficient as the
  motor for which the information was provided.

### [Specified Energy-Using Products]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1406484 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsection 20.1(2) of Act

**[[11.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-11.1 .sectionLabel}** The following
energy-using products are specified for the purpose of subsection
20.1(2) of the Act:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} clothes dryers;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} clothes washers;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} integrated clothes washer-dryers;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} dishwashers;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} refrigerators and combination refrigerator-freezers;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} freezers;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} gas ranges;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} dehumidifiers;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} microwave ovens;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} miscellaneous refrigeration products;

## [PART 2]{.HLabel1}[Energy-Using Products]{.HTitleText1} {#h-835347 .Part}

### [DIVISION 1]{.HLabel2}[Household Appliances]{.HTitleText2} {#h-835348 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835349 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-12 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Division.

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix D2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix D2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix D2 to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Clothes Dryers, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice D2 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C300-00]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C300-00]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2019-163, s.
    1\]]{.Repealed}

[[CSA C300-12]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C300-12]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C300-12 entitled Energy Performance and Capacity of
    Household Refrigerators, Refrigerator-Freezers, Freezers and Wine
    Chillers. ([CSA C300-12]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C300-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C300-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C300-15 entitled Energy Performance and Capacity of
    Household Refrigerators, Refrigerator-Freezers, Freezers and Wine
    Chillers. ([CSA C300-15]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C358-03]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C358-03]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C358-03 entitled Energy Consumption Test Methods for
    Household Electric Ranges. ([CSA C358-03]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[CSA C360-03]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C360-03]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C360-03 entitled Energy Performance, Water Consumption and
    Capacity of Household Clothes Washers. ([CSA
    C360-03]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C360-13]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C360-13]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C360-13 entitled Energy Performance, Water Consumption and
    Capacity of Household Clothes Washers. ([CSA
    C360-13]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C361-12]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C361-12]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s.
    5\]]{.Repealed}

[[CSA C361-16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C361-16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C361-16 entitled Energy performance and drum volume of
    household electric clothes dryers. ([CSA C361-16]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[CSA C361-92]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C361-92]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C361-92 entitled Test Method for Measuring Energy
    Consumption and Drum Volume of Electrically Heated Household
    Tumble-Type Clothes Dryers. ([CSA C361-92]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

#### [Labelling]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835361 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}EnerGuide label

- **[[13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-13 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  energy-using product prescribed in any of Subdivisions A to G or K of
  this Division must be labelled in the form set out in Schedule 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Manner of labelling

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The label must be an adhesive tag, flap tag or hang
  tag that is attached to the product so that the tag is readily visible
  when the product is viewed from the front.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 2](#1135869-1213586){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135869-1213586.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-13-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 13"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Paper --- adhesive and flap tags

- **[[14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-14 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  paper that is used for adhesive tags or flap tags must weigh,
  exclusive of the release liner and adhesive, not less than the
  equivalent of 26.31 kg (58 pounds) per 500 sheets measuring 63.5 cm
  (25 inches) by 96.52 cm (38 inches).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adhesive --- adhesive and flap tags

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The adhesive that is used to attach an adhesive tag
  or a flap tag to an energy-using product must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} render the tag easily removable from the product
    without the use of a tool or any liquid other than water; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} have an adhesion capacity that is sufficient to
    prevent the tag from being dislodged from the product under normal
    handling conditions.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Paper --- hang tags

- **[[15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-15 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  paper that is used for hang tags must weigh not less than the
  equivalent of 49.9 kg (110 pounds) per 500 sheets measuring 64.77 cm
  (25.5 inches) by 77.47 cm (30.5 inches).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Attachment material --- hang tags

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The material that is used to attach a hang tag to an
  energy-using product must be of sufficient strength to ensure that
  when gradual pressure is applied to the tag by pulling it away from
  the product, the tag will tear before the material breaks.

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Clothes Dryers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835379 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[clothes
dryer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-16 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[clothes dryer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a household tumble-type
clothes dryer that is electrically operated.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Size category

**[[17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-17 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, the size category of a clothes dryer is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} compact, if it has a drum capacity of less than 125 L
  (4.4 cubic feet); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} standard, if it has a drum capacity of 125 L (4.4
  cubic feet) or more.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-18 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  clothes dryer is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5, 13 to 15
  and 19, a clothes dryer is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless it is manufactured on or after February 3, 1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-19 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to clothes dryers that are manufactured during the
  periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A clothes dryer complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by the standard set out in column 1
  that are applicable to a [[clothes dryer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 16.

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Clothes Washers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835410 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[clothes
washer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-21 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[clothes washer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an electrically operated
clothes washer that does not require mechanical fastening to a floor or
wall, is top- or front-loaded and has an internal control system that
regulates the water temperature without the need for user intervention
after the machine is set in operation.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Size category

**[[22]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-22 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, the size category of a clothes washer is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} compact, if it has a container capacity of less than
  45 L (1.6 cubic feet); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} standard, if it has a container capacity of 45 L (1.6
  cubic feet) or more.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[23]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-23 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  clothes washer is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a clothes washer is not considered to be an
  energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 24, unless it
    is manufactured on or after February 3, 1995; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 13 to 15, unless it is
    a household clothes washer and it is manufactured on or after
    February 3, 1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[24]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-24 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to clothes washers described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A clothes washer complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by the standard set out in column 2
  that are applicable to a [[clothes washer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 21.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Integrated Clothes Washer-Dryers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835443 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[26]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-26 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Subdivision.

[[combination clothes washer-dryer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[combination clothes washer-dryer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    household appliance that has

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a clothes washer function and clothes dryer
      function that utilize the same drum;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a common control panel for both functions; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} one power source. ([laveuse-sécheuse
      combinée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[integrated clothes washer-dryer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[integrated clothes washer-dryer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a household appliance that consists of a clothes
      washer component and a clothes dryer component located above,
      below or beside it, that is powered by one power source and that
      has its control panel located on one of the components; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a combination clothes
      washer-dryer. ([laveuse-sécheuse]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[V]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[V]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an integrated clothes washer-dryer
      that is not a combination clothes washer-dryer, the volumes,
      expressed in litres, of the basket for the clothes washer
      component and of the drum for the clothes dryer component; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an integrated clothes washer-dryer
      that is a combination clothes washer-dryer, the volume, expressed
      in litres, of the drum. ([V]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Size category --- other than combination
clothes washer-dryer

- **[[27]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-27 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purposes of these Regulations, the size category of an integrated
  clothes washer-dryer that is not a combination clothes washer-dryer is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} compact, if it has a clothes dryer component with a
    drum capacity of less than 125 L (4.4 cubic feet) and a clothes
    washer component with a basket capacity of less than 45 L (1.6 cubic
    feet); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} standard, if it has a clothes dryer component with
    a drum capacity of 125 L (4.4 cubic feet) or more and a clothes
    washer component with a basket capacity of 45 L (1.6 cubic feet) or
    more.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Size category --- combination clothes
  washer-dryer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of these Regulations, the size
  category of an integrated clothes washer-dryer that is a combination
  clothes washer is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} compact, if it has a drum capacity of less than
    45 L (1.6 cubic feet); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} standard, if it has a drum capacity of 45 L (1.6
    cubic feet) or more.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[28]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-28 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, an integrated clothes washer-dryer is one of the following
types, namely, combination, over/under or side-by-side.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[29]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-29 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  integrated clothes washer-dryer is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5, 13 to 15
  and 30, an integrated clothes washer-dryer is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after February 3,
  1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[30]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-30 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to integrated clothes washer-dryers that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An integrated clothes washer-dryer complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 1 that are applicable to an [[integrated clothes
  washer-dryer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 26.

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[Dishwashers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835491 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[32]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-32 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C373-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C373-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C373-04 entitled Energy Consumption Test Methods and Limits
    for Household Dishwashers. ([CSA C373-04]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[CSA C373-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C373-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C373-14 entitled Energy Performance and Water Consumption of
    Household Dishwashers. ([CSA C373-14]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[dishwasher]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dishwasher]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an electrically operated
    automatic household dishwasher. ([lave-vaisselle]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Size category

**[[33]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-33 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, the size category of a dishwasher is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} compact, if it has a capacity of less than eight
  place settings and six serving pieces; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} standard, if it has a capacity that is equal to or
  greater than eight place settings and six serving pieces.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[34]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-34 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, a dishwasher is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} built-in, if it is designed to be permanently
  connected to a water and electric supply in a dwelling; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} portable, if it is designed not to be permanently
  connected to a water and electric supply in a dwelling.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Labelling --- total annual energy
consumption

**[[35]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-35 .sectionLabel}** In respect of a
dishwasher that is manufactured on or after January 1, 2010, a reference
to "annual energy consumption" in Schedule 1 is to be read as a
reference to "total annual energy consumption".

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[36]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-36 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  dishwasher is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5, 13 to 15
  and 37, a dishwasher is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after February 3, 1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[37]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-37 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to dishwashers described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A dishwasher complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by the standard set out in column 2
  that are applicable to a [[dishwasher]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 32.

#### [SUBDIVISION E]{.HLabel3}[Refrigerators and Combination Refrigerator-Freezers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835531 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[39]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-39 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Subdivision.

[[combination refrigerator-freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[combination refrigerator-freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    household combination refrigerator-freezer that has a defrost
    system, including a compressor-cycled automatic defrost system and a
    capacity of 1 105 L (39 cubic feet) or
    less. ([réfrigérateur-congélateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[compressor-cycled automatic defrost system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[compressor-cycled automatic defrost
    system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a defrost system in which the
    defrosting action for the refrigerated spaces occurs using the
    natural warming of the evaporator and that is automatically
    initiated when the compressor is cycled on and automatically
    terminated when the compressor is cycled off. ([dispositif de
    dégivrage automatique à cycle du compresseur]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[refrigerator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[refrigerator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a household refrigerator
    that has a capacity of 1 105 L (39 cubic feet) or less and that has
    a defrost system, including a compressor-cycled automatic defrost
    system. It does not include

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a household refrigerator that uses an absorption
      refrigeration system; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a miscellaneous refrigeration
      product. ([réfrigérateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Type 5A combination refrigerator-freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Type 5A combination
    refrigerator-freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2019-163, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 3](#1135871-1213613){.wb-lbx

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Size category

**[[40]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-40 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, the size category of a refrigerator or combination
refrigerator-freezer is the capacity range set out below within which
the actual size of the product falls or that is closest to the actual
size of the product:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} less than 70 L (2.5 cubic feet);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} 70 to 126 L (2.5 to 4.4 cubic feet);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} 127 to 182 L (4.5 to 6.4 cubic feet);

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} 183 to 239 L (6.5 to 8.4 cubic feet);

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} 240 to 295 L (8.5 to 10.4 cubic feet);

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} 296 to 352 L (10.5 to 12.4 cubic feet);

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} 353 to 409 L (12.5 to 14.4 cubic feet);

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} 410 to 465 L (14.5 to 16.4 cubic feet);

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} 466 to 522 L (16.5 to 18.4 cubic feet);

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} 523 to 579 L (18.5 to 20.4 cubic feet);

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} 580 to 635 L (20.5 to 22.4 cubic feet);

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} 636 to 692 L (22.5 to 24.4 cubic feet);

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} 693 to 748 L (24.5 to 26.4 cubic feet);

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} 749 to 805 L (26.5 to 28.4 cubic feet);

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} 806 to 862 L (28.5 to 30.4 cubic feet); or

- [(p)]{.lawlabel} 863 to 1 105 L (30.5 to 39.0 cubic feet).

Regulations, a refrigerator or combination refrigerator-freezer is one
of the product types (1) to (7-BI) and (11) to (15I) of Table 1 to CSA
C300-15.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using products

- **[[42]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-42
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Refrigerators and combination
  refrigerator-freezers are prescribed as energy-using products.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5, 13 to 15
  and 43, a refrigerator or combination refrigerator-freezer is not
  considered to be an energy-using product unless it is manufactured on
  or after February 3, 1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[43]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-43 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to refrigerators and combination refrigerator-freezers
  described in column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out
  in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard --- refrigerators

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A refrigerator complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by the standard set out in column 2
  that are applicable to a [[refrigerator]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 39.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard ---
  combination-refrigerator freezers

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A combination refrigerator-freezer complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 that are applicable to a [[combination-refrigerator
  freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 39.

  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a refrigerator or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA C300-15, if the product is manufactured on or
    after September 15, 2014.

#### [SUBDIVISION F]{.HLabel3}[Freezers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835593 .Subheading}

[[freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[45]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-45 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a household freezer that has a
capacity of 850 L (30 cubic feet) or less.

#### [SUBDIVISION G]{.HLabel3}[Electric Ranges]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835647 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[51]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-51 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Subdivision.

[[conventional cooking top]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[conventional cooking top]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a cooking top
    that is not a modular cooking top. ([table de cuisson
    traditionnelle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[E]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[E]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means energy consumption, expressed in
    kilowatt hours per month. ([E]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[electric range]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[electric range]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a household electric
    range. It does not include a portable range that is designed for an
    electrical supply of 120 V or a microwave oven. ([cuisinière
    électrique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[modular cooking top]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[modular cooking top]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a cartridge that
    consists of at least one surface element and that can be plugged
    into a receptacle on the surface of an electric range. ([table de
    cuisson modulaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Size category

**[[52]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-52 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, the size category of an electric range that has at least
one surface element and at least one oven is one of the following, based
on the product's exterior width:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} 60.96 cm (24 inches);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} 76.2 cm (30 inches);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} 91.44 cm (36 inches); or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} 121.92 cm (48 inches).

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[53]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-53 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, an electric range is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it has at least one oven, either self-cleaning or
  non-self-cleaning; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it has no oven, all models.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[54]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-54 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  electric range is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5, 13 to 15
  and 55, an electric range is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless it is manufactured on or after February 3, 1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[55]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-55 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to electric ranges described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An electric range complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by CSA C358-03 that are applicable to
  an [[electric range]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 51.

#### [SUBDIVISION H]{.HLabel3}[Gas Ranges]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835688 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[gas
range]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[57]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-57 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[gas range]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a household propane or natural
gas range that has an electrical power source, is used for food
preparation and provides at least one of the following functions:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} surface cooking;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} oven cooking; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} broiling.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[58]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-58 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A gas
  range is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 59, a
  gas range is not considered to be an energy-using product unless it is
  manufactured on or after February 3, 1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard

**[[59]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-59 .sectionLabel}** The energy efficiency
standard that applies to a gas range is that it must not have a
continuously burning pilot light.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[60]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-60 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C358-03 and provided to the Minister in respect
of a gas range:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the volume of usable oven space, expressed in litres;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether the product is
  built-in or free-standing; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the broiler configuration, namely, open or closed.

#### [SUBDIVISION I]{.HLabel3}[Dehumidifiers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835706 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[61]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-61 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C749-07]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C749-07]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C749-07 entitled Performance of Dehumidifiers. ([CSA
    C749-07]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C749-94]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C749-94]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C749-94 entitled Performance of Dehumidifiers. ([CSA
    C749-94]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[dehumidifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dehumidifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a household appliance
    that is primarily designed to remove moisture from the air and is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} self-contained and encased;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} electrically operated; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} mechanically
      refrigerated. ([déshumidificateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[portable dehumidifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[portable dehumidifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a dehumidifier
    that is not a whole-home dehumidifier. ([déshumidificateur
    portatif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix X1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix X1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix X1 to
    Subpart B of Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of
    Federal Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the
    Energy Consumption of Dehumidifiers, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice X1 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.32(v)(2)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(v)(2)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table to
    paragraph 430.32(v)(2) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10 to the
    United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(v)(2)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[whole-home dehumidifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[whole-home dehumidifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a dehumidifier
    that is designed to be installed in an air duct. ([déshumidificateur
    à conduit]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[62]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-62 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  dehumidifier is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 63, a
  dehumidifier is not considered to be an energy-using product unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured on or after December 31, 1998;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a whole-home dehumidifier, it is
    manufactured on or after June 13, 2019.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[63]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-63 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to dehumidifiers described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A dehumidifier complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by the standard set out in column 2
  that are applicable to a [[dehumidifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 61.

#### [SUBDIVISION J]{.HLabel3}[Microwave Ovens]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1125290 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[65]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-65 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C388-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C388-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C388-15 entitled Energy performance and capacity measurement
    of household microwave ovens. ([CSA C388-15]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[microwave oven]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[microwave oven]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a household cooking
    appliance that is designed to cook or heat food in a compartment by
    means of microwave energy and includes one that has a thermal
    element that is designed for the surface browning of food. ([four à
    micro-ondes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix I]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix I]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix I to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Microwave Ovens, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice I 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.32(j)(3)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(j)(3)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means paragraph
    430.32(j)(3) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States
    Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to time. ([10
    C.F.R. §430.32(j)(3)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[66]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-66 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, a microwave oven is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} microwave-only oven;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} countertop convection microwave oven;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} built-in convection microwave oven; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} over-the-range convection microwave oven.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 17](#1044894-1125306){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1044894-1125306.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[67]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-67 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  microwave oven is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 68, a
  microwave oven is not considered to be an energy-using product unless
  it is manufactured on or after March 31, 2019.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 17](#1044894-1125313){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1044894-1125313.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard

- **[[68]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-68 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standard for a microwave oven is the standard set
  out for that type of microwave oven in 10 C.F.R. §430.32(j)(3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A microwave oven complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by CSA C388-15 or 10 C.F.R. Appendix I
  that are applicable to a [[microwave oven]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 65.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 17](#1044894-1125320){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1044894-1125320.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[69]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-69 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be provided
to the Minister in respect of a microwave oven:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its type;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its volume, expressed in litres (cubic feet); and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its standby power, expressed in watts, as collected
  in accordance with CSA C388-15 or 10 C.F.R. Appendix I.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 17](#1044894-1125327){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1044894-1125327.html"}

#### [SUBDIVISION K]{.HLabel3}[Miscellaneous Refrigeration Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1213668 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[70]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-70 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Subdivision.

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix A to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Refrigerators, Refrigerator-Freezers, and
    Miscellaneous Refrigeration Products, as amended from time to time,
    except for the waiver referred to in section 7 of that
    Appendix. ([appendice A 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.32(aa)(1)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(aa)(1)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table to
    paragraph 430.32(aa)(1) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10 to the
    United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(aa)(1)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.32(aa)(2)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(aa)(2)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table to
    paragraph 430.32(aa)(2) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10 to the
    United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(aa)(2)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[miscellaneous refrigeration product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[miscellaneous refrigeration product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    household refrigeration product, which includes a cooler and
    combination cooler refrigeration product, but does not include a
    refrigerator, refrigerator-freezer or freezer. ([appareil de
    réfrigération divers]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 13](#1135893-1213676){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135893-1213676.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[71]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-71 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, a miscellaneous refrigeration product is one of the
following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it was manufactured on or after January 1, 2008
  and before October 28, 2019, a type described in any of the product
  types (19) or (20) of Table 1 to CSA C300-15; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it is manufactured on or after October 28, 2019, a
  cooler of a product class described in 10 C.F.R. §430.32(aa)(1) or a
  combination cooler refrigeration product of a product class described
  in 10 C.F.R. §430.32(aa)(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 13](#1135893-1213682){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135893-1213682.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[72]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-72 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  miscellaneous refrigeration product is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5, 13 to 15
  and 73, a miscellaneous refrigeration product is not considered to be
  an energy-using product unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2008 and
    before October 28, 2019, and is a type (19) or (20) as described in
    Table 1 to CSA C300-15; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured on or after October 28, 2019.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 13](#1135893-1213691){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135893-1213691.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard

- **[[73]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-73 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to miscellaneous refrigeration products described in
  column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A miscellaneous refrigeration product complies with
  the energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested
  in accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set
  out in column 2 that are applicable to a [[miscellaneous refrigeration
  product]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 70.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[74]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-74 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a miscellaneous
  refrigeration product:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its type;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its adjusted volume; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} its annual energy consumption expressed in

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with
  one of the following standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} CSA C300-12 if the product was manufactured on or
    after January 1, 2008 and before September 15, 2014;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA C300-15 if the product was manufactured on or
    after September 15, 2014 and before October 28, 2019; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 10 C.F.R. Appendix A if the product is manufactured
    on or after October 28, 2019.

#### [SUBDIVISION L]{.HLabel3}[Ceiling Fans]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1213718 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[75]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-75 .sectionLabel}** The following definitions
apply in this Subdivision.

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix U]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix U]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix U to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Ceiling Fans, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice U 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.32(s)(2)(i)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(s)(2)(i)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table
    to subparagraph 430.32(s)(2)(i) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10
    to the United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from
    time to time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(s)(2)(i)]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[ceiling fan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ceiling fan]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a non-portable device that
    is suspended from a ceiling for circulating air via the rotation of
    fan blades. It does not include

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a ceiling fan if the plane of rotation of the fan
      blades is greater than 45 degrees from horizontal;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a centrifugal ceiling fan;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a belt-driven ceiling fan;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an oscillating ceiling fan; and

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a ceiling fan with a maximum rotational speed of
      90 RPM and a maximum airflow of 52.1 cubic metres/minute (1840
      cubic feet/minute). ([ventilateur de plafond]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 13](#1135893-1213730){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135893-1213730.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[76]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-76 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of these
Regulations, a ceiling fan is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} very small diameter;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} standard;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} hugger;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} high-speed small-diameter; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} large-diameter.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 13](#1135893-1213739){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135893-1213739.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[77]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-77 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  ceiling fan is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 78, a
  ceiling fan is not considered to be an energy-using product unless it
  is manufactured on or after January 21, 2020.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 13](#1135893-1213746){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135893-1213746.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard

- **[[78]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-78 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standard for a ceiling fan is the standard as set
  out in 10 C.F.R. §430.32(s)(2)(i).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A ceiling fan complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. Appendix U that are
  applicable to a [[ceiling fan]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
  section 75.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 13](#1135893-1213753){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135893-1213753.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[79]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-79 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with 10 C.F.R. Appendix U and provided to the Minister in
respect of a ceiling fan:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its type;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its blade span;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its air flow at high speed;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} its ceiling fan efficiency; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} its standby power consumption expressed in watts.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 13](#1135893-1213762){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135893-1213762.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 2]{.HLabel2}[Air Conditioners, Condensing Units and Chillers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-835737 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835738 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[107]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-107 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[CSA C656-05]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C656-05]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C656-05 entitled Performance Standard for Split-System and
    Single-Package Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C656-05]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C656-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C656-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CSA-C656-14 entitled Performance Standard for Split-System and
    Single-Package Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C656-14]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C746-06]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C746-06]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C746-06 entitled Performance Standard for Rating Large and
    Single Packaged Vertical Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C746-06]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C746-98]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C746-98]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C746-98 entitled Performance Standard for Rating Large Air
    Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA C746-98]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[small-duct and high-velocity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[small-duct and high-velocity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, with respect
    to a single package central air conditioner or a split-system
    central air conditioner, means one that has an indoor blower and
    coil combination that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} produces at least 300 Pa (1.2 inches of water)
      external static pressure when operated at an air volume rate of
      104 to 165 L/s (220 to 350 cubic feet/minute) per nominal ton of
      cooling; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} uses room outlets that produce velocities greater
      than 5 m/s (1,000 feet/minute) and that each have an area less
      than 39 cm^2^ (6 square inches). ([à grand débit et à petits
      conduits]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[space-constrained]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[space-constrained]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, with respect to a single
    package central air conditioner or a split system central air
    conditioner, means one that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a cooling capacity that is less than or equal
      to 8.79 kW (30,000 Btu/h); and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has an outdoor or indoor unit that has an overall
      displacement or at least two overall exterior dimensions that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} are substantially smaller than those of other
        units of a similar cooling capacity that are usually installed
        in single family homes, and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if increased, would result in a considerable
        increase in the usual cost of installation or in a significant
        loss in the utility of the product to the consumer. ([à espace
        restreint]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix M]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix M]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix M to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps, as amended
    from time to time. ([appendice M 10 C.F.R]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix M1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix M1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix M1 to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps, as amended
    from time to time. ([appendice M1 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 14](#1135895-1213766){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135895-1213766.html"}
- [SOR/2022-265, s. 3](#1382010-1387608){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1382010-1387608.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-107-20191212.html "Link to previous version of section 107"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[107.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-107.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
these Regulations, a central air conditioner manufactured on or after
January 1, 2023 is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} single package, other than space-constrained;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} space-constrained single package;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} split system, other than space-constrained or
  small-duct and high-velocity;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} small-duct and high-velocity split-system; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} space-constrained split-system.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-265, s. 4](#1382012-1387617){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1382012-1387617.html"}
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Room Air Conditioners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835748 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[108]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-108 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CEER]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CEER]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the combined energy efficiency
    ratio of the product, expressed in British thermal units per watt
    hour, that constitutes a single measure of its energy efficiency and
    that integrates standby mode and off mode energy use with on mode
    energy use. ([CEER]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C368.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C368.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C368.1-M90 entitled Performance Standard for Room Air
    Conditioners. ([CSA C368.1]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C368.1-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C368.1-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C368.1-14 entitled Energy performance of room air
    conditioners. ([CSA C368.1-14]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C370]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C370]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2019-163, s.
    15\]]{.Repealed}

[[CSA C62301]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C62301]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C62301:11 entitled Household Electrical Appliances --
    Measurement of Standby Power. ([CSA C62301]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[off mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[off mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s.
    18\]]{.Repealed}

[[on mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[on mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s.
    18\]]{.Repealed}

[[portable air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[portable air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2019-163, s. 15\]]{.Repealed}

[[room air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[room air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a single-phase
    electric air conditioner that has a cooling capacity of 10.55 kW
    (36,000 Btu/h) or less. It does not include a packaged terminal air
    conditioner, a portable air conditioner or a single package vertical
    air conditioner. ([climatiseur individuel]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s.
    18\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 18](#1044900-1125333){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1044900-1125333.html"}
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 15](#1135897-1213767){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135897-1213767.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-108-20190430.html "Link to previous version of section 108"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[109]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-109 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
these Regulations, a room air conditioner is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} 120 V louvred with reverse cycle;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} 120 V louvred without reverse cycle;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} 120 V non-louvred with reverse cycle;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} 120 V non-louvred without reverse cycle;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} 120 V casement-only;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} 120 V casement-slider;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} 240 V louvred with reverse cycle;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} 240 V louvred without reverse cycle;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} 240 V non-louvred with reverse cycle;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} 240 V non-louvred without reverse cycle;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} 240 V casement-only; or

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} 240 V casement-slider.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cooling capacity category

**[[110]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-110 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
these Regulations, the cooling capacity category of a room air
conditioner is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the product was manufactured before June 1, 2014,
  the applicable cooling capacity range set out in Table 2 of CSA
  C368.1; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the product is manufactured on or after June 1,
  2014, the applicable cooling capacity range set out in Table 1 of CSA
  C368.1-14.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[111]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-111 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  room air conditioner is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5, 13 to 15
  and 112, a room air conditioner is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after February 3,
  1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[112]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-112 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to room air conditioners that are manufactured during
  the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A room air conditioner complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 1 that are applicable to a [[room air
  conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 108.
