[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form of labelling

**[[114]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-114 .sectionLabel}** A room air conditioner
must be labelled

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it was manufactured before June 1, 2014, in the
  form set out in Schedule 2; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it is manufactured on or after June 1, 2014, in
  the form set out in Schedule 3.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Manner of labelling

**[[115]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-115 .sectionLabel}** The label must either
be displayed on the principal display panel of the product's package or
must be one of the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an adhesive tag that meets the requirements of
  section 14 and that is attached to the product or the principal
  display panel of its package;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a flap tag that meets the requirements of section 14
  and that is attached to the product; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a hang tag that meets the requirements of section 15
  and that is attached to the product.

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Large Air Conditioners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835830 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[116]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-116 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[AHRI 340/360]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[AHRI 340/360]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the AHRI standard
    ANSI/AHRI 340/360-2007 entitled Performance Rating of Commercial and
    Industrial Unitary Air-Conditioning and Heat Pump Equipment. ([AHRI
    340/360]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C746-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C746-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C746-17 entitled Energy performance rating for large and
    single packaged vertical air conditioners and heat pumps. ([CSA
    C746-17]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IEER]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IEER]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the integrated energy efficiency
    ratio, expressed in British thermal units per watt hour, that
    constitutes a single number cooling part-load efficiency metric of a
    large air conditioner. ([IEER]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[large air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[large air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a commercial or
    industrial unitary air conditioner with a cooling capacity of at
    least 19 kW (65,000 Btu/h) but less than 223 kW (760,000 Btu/h). It
    does not include a single package vertical air
    conditioner. ([climatiseur de grande puissance]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[117]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-117 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  large air conditioner is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 118, a
  large air conditioner is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a large air conditioner with a
    cooling capacity of less than 70 kW, it is manufactured on or after
    December 31, 1998; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a large air conditioner with a
    cooling capacity of 70 kW or more, it is manufactured on or after
    January 1, 2010.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards --- cooled by
air

- **[[118]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-118 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of Table 1 to this
  section apply to large air conditioners that are cooled by air and
  described in column 1 and that are manufactured during the period set
  out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards --- cooled
  by water

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency standards set out in column 3
  of Table 2 to this section apply to large air conditioners that are
  cooled by water and described in column 1 and that are manufactured
  during the period set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards --- cooled
  by evaporation

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency standards set out in column 3
  of Table 3 to this section apply to large air conditioners that are
  cooled by evaporation and described in column 1 and that are
  manufactured during the period set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A large air conditioner complies with the energy
  efficiency standard set out in column 3 if it meets that standard when
  tested in accordance with testing procedures established by the
  standard set out in column 2 that are applicable to a [[large air
  conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 116.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[119]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-119 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the information set out in column 3 of the
table to this section must be collected in accordance with the standard
set out in column 2 and provided to the Minister in respect of a large
air conditioner described in column 1.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Packaged Terminal Air Conditioners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835870 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[120]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-120 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C744-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C744-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the joint CSA and AHRI
    standard ANSI/AHRI 310/380-2004/CAN/CSA-C744-04 entitled Standard
    for Packaged Terminal Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C744-04]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C744-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C744-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the joint CSA and AHRI
    standard ANSI/AHRI 310/380-2014/CAN/CSA-C744-14 entitled Standard
    for Packaged Terminal Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C744-14]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C744-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C744-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the joint CSA and AHRI
    standard ANSI/AHRI 310/380-2017/CAN/CSA-C744-17 entitled Packaged
    terminal air-conditioners and heat pumps. ([CSA
    C744-17]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} )

[[packaged terminal air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[packaged terminal air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    factory-built packaged terminal air conditioner that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} consists of a wall sleeve and a separate
      unencased cooling component and is intended to cool a single room
      or zone; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} consists of a wall sleeve and a separate
      unencased combination of heating and cooling components and is
      intended to heat and cool a single room or zone. ([climatiseur
      terminal autonome]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[121]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-121 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  packaged terminal air conditioner is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 122, a
  packaged terminal air conditioner is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after December
  31, 1998.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[122]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-122 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to packaged terminal air conditioners that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A packaged terminal air conditioner complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 1 that are applicable to a [[packaged terminal air
  conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 120.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[123]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-123 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a packaged terminal air
  conditioner:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its cooling capacity, expressed in kilowatts
    (British thermal units per hour);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its energy efficiency ratio; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, identification of the product as a
    replacement unit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} CSA C744-04, if the product was manufactured on or
    after December 31, 1998 and before September 30, 2012;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA C744-14, if the product was manufactured on or
    after September 30, 2012 and before January 1, 2017; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} CSA C744-17, if the product is manufactured on or
    after January 1, 2017.

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[Single Package Central Air Conditioners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835904 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[124]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-124 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[off mode power consumption]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[off mode power consumption]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the power
    consumption when the unit is connected to mains power but is not
    providing cooling or heating. ([consommation d'énergie en mode
    arrêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[single package central air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[single package central air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
    a single-phase or three-phase central air conditioner that is a
    single package unit and that has a cooling capacity of less than
    19 kW (65,000 Btu/h). It does not include a single package vertical
    air conditioner. ([climatiseur central monobloc]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[through-the-wall]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[through-the-wall]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
    single package central air conditioner, one that has a cooling
    capacity less than or equal to 8.79 kW (30,000 Btu/h), is designed
    to be installed through an exterior wall and is manufactured prior
    to January 1, 2023. ([mural]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional provision --- early
compliance

**[[127.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-127.1 .sectionLabel}** A single package
central air conditioner that is manufactured on or after January 1, 2025
and before January 1, 2026 is deemed to satisfy the requirements of
sections 126 and 127 of these Regulations if it satisfies the
requirements of sections 126 and 127 of the new Regulations that are
applicable to single package central air conditioners that are
manufactured on or after January 1, 2026.

::: HistoricalNote

#### [SUBDIVISION E]{.HLabel3}[Single Package Vertical Air Conditioners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835933 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[single package vertical
air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[128]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-128 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[single package vertical air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
single package commercial air conditioner, with or without heating
capability, that has its major components arranged vertically, is
air-cooled and encased and is intended for mounting through, or on
either side of, an exterior wall. It does not include a single package
commercial air conditioner that has reverse cycle refrigeration.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[129]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-129 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  single package vertical air conditioner is prescribed as an
  energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 130, a
  single package vertical air conditioner is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after January 1,
  2011 and has a cooling capacity of less than 70 kW (240,000 Btu/h).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 21](#1135913-1213797){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135913-1213797.html"}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A single package vertical air conditioner complies
  with the energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when
  tested in accordance with testing procedures established by CSA
  C746-17 that are applicable to a [[single package vertical air
  conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 128.

#### [SUBDIVISION F]{.HLabel3}[Split System Central Air Conditioners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835957 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2022-265, s. 8(E)

\]
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[132]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-132 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[off mode power consumption]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[off mode power consumption]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the power
    consumption when the unit is connected to mains power but is not
    providing cooling or heating. ([consommation d'énergie en mode
    arrêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[split system central air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[split system central air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    single-phase or three-phase central air conditioner that is a split
    system and that has a cooling capacity of less than 19 kW (65,000
    Btu/h). ([climatiseur central bibloc]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[split-system central air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[split-system central air
    conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2022-265, s.
    9\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 24](#1135919-1213822){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135919-1213822.html"}
- [SOR/2022-265, s. 9(E)](#1382022-1387645){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1382022-1387645.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-132-20191212.html "Link to previous version of section 132"){.PITLink}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[133]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-133 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  split-system central air conditioner is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 134, a
  split-system central air conditioner is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after February 3,
  1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards ---
single-phase

- **[[134]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-134 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of Table 1 to this
  section apply to single-phase split-system central air conditioners
  described in column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out
  in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards ---
  three-phase

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency standards set out in column 3
  of Table 2 to this section apply to three-phase split-system central
  air conditioners described in column 1 that are manufactured during
  the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A split-system central air conditioner complies with
  the energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested
  in accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set
  out in column 2 that are applicable to a [[split-system central air
  conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 132.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional provision --- early
compliance

**[[135.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-135.1 .sectionLabel}** A split system
central air conditioner that is manufactured on or after January 1, 2025
and before January 1, 2026 is deemed to satisfy the requirements of
sections 134 and 135 of these Regulations if it satisfies the
requirements of sections 134 and 135 of the new Regulations that are
applicable to split system central air conditioners that are
manufactured on or after January 1, 2026.

#### [SUBDIVISION G]{.HLabel3}[Large Condensing Units]{.HTitleText3} {#h-835984 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[large condensing
unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[136]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-136 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[large condensing unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a commercial or
industrial condensing unit that is intended for air conditioning
applications and that has a cooling capacity of at least 40 kW (135,000
Btu/h) but not more than 70 kW (240,000 Btu/h).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 27](#1044952-1125416){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1044952-1125416.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[137]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-137 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  large condensing unit is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 138, a
  large condensing unit is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after December 31, 1998.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[138]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-138 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to large condensing units described in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A large condensing unit complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by CSA C746-98 that are
  applicable to a [[large condensing unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 136.

#### [SUBDIVISION H]{.HLabel3}[Chillers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836008 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[140]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-140 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[ASHRAE 90.1-16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ASHRAE 90.1-16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means ANSI/ASHRAE/IES
    Standard 90.1-2016, entitled Energy Standard for Buildings Except
    Low-Rise Residential Buildings. ([ASHRAE 90.1-16]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[chiller]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[chiller]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a machine, with or without an
    integral refrigerant condenser, that is designed to use a
    refrigerant cycle to remove heat from a liquid and to reject the
    heat to a cooling medium. ([refroidisseur]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[CSA C743-02]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C743-02]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C743-02 entitled Performance Standard for Rating Packaged
    Water Chillers. ([CSA C743-02]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C743-09]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C743-09]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C743-09 entitled Performance Standard for Rating Packaged
    Water Chillers. ([CSA C743-09]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 27](#1135935-1213844){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135935-1213844.html"}
:::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 142, a
  chiller is not considered to be an energy-using product unless it has
  an integral refrigerant condenser and is manufactured on or after
  October 28, 2004.

#### [SUBDIVISION I]{.HLabel3}[Portable Air Conditioners]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1213857 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[144]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-144 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix CC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix CC]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix CC to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Portable Air Conditioners, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice CC 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[dual-duct portable air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dual-duct portable air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    portable air conditioner that draws some or all of the condenser
    inlet air from outside the conditioned space through a duct attached
    to an adjustable window bracket and discharges the condenser outlet
    air outside the conditioned space by means of a separate duct
    attached to an adjustable window bracket. ([climatiseur portative à
    deux conduits]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[portable air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[portable air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a single
    package air conditioner, other than a packaged terminal air
    conditioner, room air conditioner or dehumidifier, with or without
    mounted wheels, that is portable and that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is designed to deliver cooled and conditioned air
      to an enclosed space;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is powered by single-phase electric current; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has a cooling capacity of less than 19 kW (65,000
      Btu/h). ([climatiseur portatif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[single-duct portable air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[single-duct portable air conditioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    portable air conditioner that draws all of the condenser inlet air
    from the conditioned space without the means of a duct and
    discharges the condenser outlet air outside the conditioned space
    through a single duct attached to an adjustable window
    bracket. ([climatiseur portatif à un conduit
    unique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 30](#1135944-1213879){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135944-1213879.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[145]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-145 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  portable air conditioner is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, a
  portable air conditioner is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless it is manufactured on or after July 1, 2020.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 30](#1135944-1213886){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135944-1213886.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[146]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-146 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be collected in accordance with 10 C.F.R. Appendix CC and
  provided to the Minister in respect of a portable air conditioner:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its seasonally adjusted cooling capacity;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its combined energy efficiency ratio; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whether it is a single-duct portable air
    conditioner or a dual-duct portable air conditioner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For a product with multiple duct configuration
  options, the information required by paragraphs 1(a) and (b) must be
  provided for both applicable duct configurations.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 30](#1135944-1213896){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135944-1213896.html"}
:::

**\[147 to 185 reserved\]**

### [DIVISION 3]{.HLabel2}[Heat Pumps]{.HTitleText2} {#h-836039 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836040 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[186]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-186 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[CSA C656-05]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C656-05]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C656-05 entitled Performance Standard for Split-System and
    Single-Package Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C656-05]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C656-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C656-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C656-14 entitled Performance Standard for Split-System and
    Single-Package Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C656-14]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C746-06]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C746-06]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C746-06 entitled Performance Standard for Rating Large and
    Single Packaged Vertical Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C746-06]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C13256-1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C13256-1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C13256-1-01 entitled Water-Source Heat Pumps --- Testing and
    Rating for Performance --- Part 1: Water-to-Air and Brine-to-Air
    Heat Pumps. ([CSA C13256-1]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[small-duct and high-velocity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[small-duct and high-velocity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with
    respect to a split system central heat pump or a single package
    central heat pump, one that has an indoor blower and coil
    combination that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} produces at least 300 Pa (1.2 inches of water)
      external static pressure when operated at an air volume rate of
      104 to 165 L/s (220 to 350 cubic feet/minute) per nominal ton of
      cooling; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} uses room outlets that produce velocities greater
      than 5 m/s (1,000 feet/minute) and that each have an area less
      than 39 cm^2^ (6 square inches). ([à grand débit et à petits
      conduits]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[space-constrained]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[space-constrained]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, with respect to a single
    package central heat pump or a split system central heat pump, means
    one that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a cooling capacity that is less than or equal
      to 8.79 kW (30,000 Btu/h); and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has an outdoor or indoor unit that has an overall
      displacement or at least two overall exterior dimensions that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} are substantially smaller than those of other
        units of a similar cooling capacity that are usually installed
        in single family homes, and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if increased, would result in a considerable
        increase in the usual cost of installation or in a significant
        loss in the utility of the product to the consumer. ([à espace
        restreint]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix M]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix M]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix M to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps, as amended
    from time to time. ([appendice M 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix M1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix M1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix M1 to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Central Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps, as amended
    from time to time. ([appendice M1 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[186.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-186.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
these Regulations, a central heat pump manufactured on or after January
1, 2023 is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} single package, other than space-constrained;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} space-constrained single package;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} split system, other than space-constrained or
  small-duct and high-velocity;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} small-duct and high-velocity split-system; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} space-constrained split-system.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-265, s. 13](#1382035-1387682){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1382035-1387682.html"}
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Ground-Source Heat Pumps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836050 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[187]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-187 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C446-94]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C446-94]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C446-94 entitled Performance of Ground-Source Heat
    Pumps. ([CSA C446-94]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ground-source heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ground-source heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a single
    package or split-system heat pump that is factory-built, has a
    cooling or heating capacity of less than 40 kW (135,000 Btu/h) and
    is intended for application in an open- or closed-loop ground-source
    system. ([thermopompe géothermique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[188]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-188 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  ground-source heat pump is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 189, a
  ground-source heat pump is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless it is manufactured on or after February 3, 1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[189]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-189 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to ground-source heat pumps that are manufactured during
  the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A ground source heat pump complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 1 that are applicable to a [[ground source heat
  pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 187.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[190]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-190 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a ground-source heat
  pump:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its AHRI type classification;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its cooling capacity, expressed in kilowatts
    (British thermal units per hour);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} its cooling coefficient of performance;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} its heating capacity, expressed in kilowatts
    (British thermal units per hour);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} its heating coefficient of performance; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the ground-source system for which the product is
    intended, namely, open-loop, closed-loop or both open-loop and
    closed-loop.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

    after February 3, 1995 and before June 1, 2006; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA C13256-1, if the product is manufactured on or
    after June 1, 2006.

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Internal Water Loop Heat Pumps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836084 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[internal water loop heat
pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[191]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-191 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[internal water loop heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
water-source single package or split-system heat pump that is
factory-built, is intended for installation in an internal water loop
system and has a cooling or heating capacity of not more than 40 kW
(135,000 Btu/h).

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[192]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-192 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  internal water loop heat pump is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 193,
  an internal water loop heat pump is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after February 3,
  1995.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[193]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-193 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to internal water loop heat pumps described in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An internal water loop heat pump complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by CSA C13256-1 that
  are applicable to an [[internal water loop heat
  pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 191.

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its cooling capacity, expressed in kilowatts (British
  thermal units per hour);

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} its cooling coefficient of performance with 30°C
  inlet water;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} its heating capacity, expressed in kilowatts (British
  thermal units per hour); and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} its heating coefficient of performance with 20°C
  inlet water.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Large Heat Pumps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836111 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[195]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-195 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[AHRI 340/360]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[AHRI 340/360]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the AHRI standard
    ANSI/AHRI 340/360-2007 entitled Performance Rating of Commercial and
    Industrial Unitary Air-Conditioning and Heat Pump Equipment. ([AHRI
    340/360]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C746-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C746-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C746-17 entitled Energy performance rating for large and
    single packaged vertical air conditioners and heat pumps. ([CSA
    C746-17]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C746-98]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C746-98]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C746-98 entitled Performance Standard for Rating Large Air
    Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA C746-98]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[IEER]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IEER]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the integrated energy efficiency
    ratio, expressed in British thermal units per watt hour, that
    constitutes a single number cooling part-load efficiency metric of a
    large heat pump. ([IEER]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[large heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[large heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a commercial or
    industrial unitary heat pump that is intended for air-conditioning
    and space-heating applications and that has a cooling capacity of at
    least 19 kW (65,000 Btu/h) but less than 223 kW (760,000 Btu/h). It
    does not include a single package vertical heat pump. ([thermopompe
    de grande puissance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[196]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-196 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  large heat pump is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 197, a
  large heat pump is not considered to be an energy-using product unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a large heat pump with a cooling
    capacity that is less than 70 kW, it is manufactured on or after
    December 31, 1998; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a large heat pump with a cooling
    capacity that is greater than or equal to 70 kW, it is manufactured
    on or after January 1, 2010.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[197]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-197 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of Table 1 to this
  section apply to large heat pumps described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4 and that have no
  heating section or have an electric heating section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency standards set out in column 3
  of Table 2 to this section apply to large heat pumps described in
  column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out in column 4
  and that have a heating section other than an electric heating
  section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A large heat pump complies with the energy efficiency
  standard set out in column 3 if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 that are applicable to a [[large heat
  pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 195.

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[Packaged Terminal Heat Pumps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836152 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[199]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-199 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C744-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C744-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the joint CSA and AHRI
    standard ANSI/AHRI 310/380-2004/CAN/CSA-C744-04 entitled Standard
    for Packaged Terminal Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps. ([CSA
    C744-04]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C744-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C744-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the joint CSA and AHRI
    standard ANSI/AHRI 310/380-2017/CSA-C744-17 entitled Packaged
    terminal air conditioners and heat pumps. ([CSA
    C744-17]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[packaged terminal heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[packaged terminal heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    factory-built packaged heat pump that consists of a separate
    unencased refrigeration system and uses reverse cycle refrigeration
    as its primary heat source. ([thermopompe terminale
    autonome]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 32](#1135948-1213902){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135948-1213902.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[200]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-200 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  packaged terminal heat pump is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 201, a
  packaged terminal heat pump is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless it is manufactured on or after December 31, 1998.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[201]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-201 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to packaged terminal heat pumps that are manufactured
  during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A packaged terminal heat pump complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 1 that are applicable to a [[packaged terminal heat
  pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 199.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[202]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-202 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a packaged terminal
  heat pump:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its cooling capacity, expressed in kilowatts
    (British thermal units per hour);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its energy efficiency ratio;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} its heating capacity, expressed in kilowatts
    (British thermal units per hour);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} its heating coefficient of performance; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, identification of the product as a
    replacement unit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} CSA C744-04, if the product was manufactured on or
    after December 31, 1998 and before September 30, 2012; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA C744-17, if the product is manufactured on or
    after September 30, 2012.

#### [SUBDIVISION E]{.HLabel3}[Single Package Central Heat Pumps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836186 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2022-265, s. 14

\]
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[203]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-203 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[off mode power consumption]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[off mode power consumption]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the power
    consumption when the unit is connected to mains power but is not
    providing cooling or heating. ([consommation d'énergie en mode
    arrêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[single package central heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[single package central heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    single-phase or three-phase air-to-air central heat pump that is a
    single package unit and that has a cooling or heating capacity of
    less than 19 kW (65,000 Btu/h), but does not include a single
    package vertical heat pump. ([thermopompe centrale
    monobloc]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[single package heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[single package heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2022-265, s. 15\]]{.Repealed}

[[through-the-wall]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[through-the-wall]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
    single package central heat pump, one that has a cooling capacity
    less than or equal to 8.79 kW (30,000 Btu/h), that is designed to be
    installed through an exterior wall and that is manufactured prior to
    January 1, 2023. ([murale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[204]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-204 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  single package central heat pump is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 205, a
  single package central heat pump is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after February 3,
  1995.

  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of Table 1 to this
  section apply to single-phase single package central heat pumps
  described in column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out
  in column 4.

  three-phase

  of Table 2 to this section apply to three-phase single package central
  heat pumps described in column 1 that are manufactured during the
  periods set out in column 4.

  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 that are applicable to a [[single package central heat
  pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 203.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional provision --- early
compliance

**[[206.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-206.1 .sectionLabel}** A single package
central heat pump that is manufactured on or after January 1, 2025 and
before January 1, 2026 is deemed to satisfy the requirements of sections
205 and 206 of these Regulations if it satisfies the requirements of
sections 205 and 206 of the new Regulations that are applicable to
single package central heat pumps that are manufactured on or after
January 1, 2026.

#### [SUBDIVISION F]{.HLabel3}[Single Package Vertical Heat Pumps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836215 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[single package vertical
heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[207]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-207 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[single package vertical heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a single
package commercial heat pump that is encased, that has its major
components arranged vertically and that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is air-cooled and uses reverse cycle refrigeration as
  its primary heat source; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} is intended for mounting through, or on either side
  of, an exterior wall.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[208]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-208 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  single package vertical heat pump is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 209, a
  single package vertical heat pump is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after January 1,
  2011 and has a cooling capacity of less than 70 kW (240,000 Btu/h).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 38](#1135965-1213937){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135965-1213937.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-208-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 208"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[209]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-209 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to single package vertical heat pumps described in
  column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A single package vertical heat pump complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by CSA C746-17 that are
  applicable to a [[single package vertical heat
  pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 207.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[210]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-210 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C746-17 and provided to the Minister in respect
of a single package vertical heat pump:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its classification set out in columns II and III of
  Table 2 to CSA C746-17;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its cooling capacity, expressed in kilowatts (British
  thermal units per hour);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its energy efficiency ratio;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} its heating capacity, expressed in kilowatts (British
  thermal units per hour); and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} its heating coefficient of performance.

#### [SUBDIVISION G]{.HLabel3}[Split System Central Heat Pumps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836243 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2022-265, s. 18

\]
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[211]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-211 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[off mode power consumption]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[off mode power consumption]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the power
    consumption when the unit is connected to mains power but is not
    providing cooling or heating. ([consommation d'énergie en mode
    arrêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[split system central heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[split system central heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    single-phase or three-phase air-to-air central heat pump that is a
    split system and that has a cooling or heating capacity of less than
    19 kW (65,000 Btu/h). ([thermopompe centrale
    bibloc]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[split-system heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[split-system heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2022-265, s. 19\]]{.Repealed}

  split system central heat pump is not considered to be an energy-using

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional provision --- early
compliance

**[[214.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-214.1 .sectionLabel}** A split system
central heat pump that is manufactured on or after January 1, 2025 and
before January 1, 2026 is deemed to satisfy the requirements of sections
213 and 214 of these Regulations if it satisfies the requirements of
sections 213 and 214 of the new Regulations that are applicable to split
system central heat pumps that are manufactured on or after January 1,
2026.

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[Furnaces, Fireplaces, Unit Heaters and Recovery Ventilators]{.HTitleText2} {#h-836271 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote

- SOR/2019-164, s. 1

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1127074 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[256.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-256.1 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[CSA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-P.2-13 entitled Testing method for measuring the annual fuel
    utilization efficiency of residential gas-fired or oil-fired
    furnaces and boilers. ([CSA P.2]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[FER]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[FER]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a gas furnace, an
    oil-fired furnace or an electric furnace, the fan energy rating,
    which is the annual electrical energy consumption of the furnace fan
    normalized by annual fan operating hours and the product's maximum
    airflow (Q~max~). ([FER]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix AA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix AA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix AA to
    Subpart B of Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of
    Federal Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the
    Energy Consumption of Furnace Fans, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice AA 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.32(y)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(y)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Table 1 to
    paragraph 430.32(y) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United
    States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(y)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Gas Furnaces]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836272 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[257]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-257 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA 2.3]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA 2.3]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard ANSI
    Z21.47-2016/CSA 2.3-2016 entitled Gas-Fired Central Furnaces. ([CSA
    2.3]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s.
    34\]]{.Repealed}

[[gas furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gas furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an automatic operating
    gas-fired central forced air furnace that uses propane or natural
    gas and has an input rate of not more than 117.23 kW (400,000
    Btu/h). It does not include a furnace for a park model trailer or a
    recreational vehicle. ([générateur d'air chaud à
    gaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[gas furnace for relocatable buildings]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gas furnace for relocatable buildings]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
    a gas furnace that is intended for use in a temporary modular
    building that can be relocated from one site to another and is
    marked for use in relocatable buildings. ([générateur d'air chaud à
    gaz pour bâtiments relocalisables]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[manufactured home]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[manufactured home]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a factory-built,
    single- or multiple-section, one-storey dwelling that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is designed and constructed for year-round
      occupancy;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is designed to be transported to its installation
      site; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is ready for occupancy when it is installed in
      accordance with the manufacturer's installation
      instructions. ([maison usinée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[replacement non-condensing gas furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[replacement non-condensing gas furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
    a non-condensing gas furnace that is marked for use as a replacement
    for a non-condensing gas furnace in a manufactured
    home. ([générateur d'air chaud à gaz sans condensation de
    remplacement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[through-the-wall]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[through-the-wall]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with respect to a
    gas furnace, one that is designed and marketed to be installed in an
    opening in an exterior wall that is fitted with a weatherized
    sleeve. ([mural]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[258]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-258 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  gas furnace is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 259, a
  gas furnace is not considered to be an energy-using product if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before February 3, 1995;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is a gas furnace for relocatable buildings that
    is manufactured before July 3, 2019; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} it is a replacement non-condensing gas furnace that
    is manufactured before July 3, 2019.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[259]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-259 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to gas furnaces described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A gas furnace complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by the standard set out in column 2
  that are applicable to a [[gas furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 257.

subsection 5(1) of the Act, the information set out in column 3 of the

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Oil-Fired Furnaces]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836303 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[261]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-261 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA B212]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA B212]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CSA-B212-93
    entitled Seasonal Energy Utilization Efficiencies of Oil-Fired
    Furnaces and Boilers. ([CSA B212]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[oil-fired furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[oil-fired furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a warm-air furnace,
    other than a furnace for a mobile home or for a recreational
    vehicle, that has an input rate of not more than 65.92 kW (225,000
    Btu/h) and that is either

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} exclusively oil-fired; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} capable of being fired, at the choice of the
      user, by either oil or another fuel. ([générateur d'air chaud à
      mazout]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[262]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-262 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  oil-fired furnace is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 263,
  an oil-fired furnace is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after December 31, 1998.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[263]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-263 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to oil-fired furnaces that are manufactured during the
  periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An oil-fired furnace complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 1 that are applicable to an [[oil-fired
  furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 261.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Gas Fireplaces]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836324 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[265]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-265 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA P.4.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.4.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CAN/CSA
    P.4.1-02 entitled Testing Method for Measuring Annual Fireplace
    Efficiency. ([CSA P.4.1]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA P.4.1-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.4.1-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CAN/CSA
    P.4.1-15 entitled Testing Method for Measuring Annual Fireplace
    Efficiency. ([CSA P.4.1-15]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[decorative gas fireplace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[decorative gas fireplace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a vented
    fireplace that is fuelled by natural gas or propane, is marked for
    decorative use only and is not equipped with a thermostat or
    intended for use as a heater. ([foyer à gaz
    décoratif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[gas fireplace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gas fireplace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a decorative gas
    fireplace or a heating gas fireplace. ([foyer à
    gaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[heating gas fireplace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[heating gas fireplace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a vented
    fireplace that is fuelled by natural gas or propane and is not a
    decorative gas fireplace. ([foyer à gaz de
    chauffage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 8](#1136341-1214196){.wb-lbx

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[266]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-266 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  gas fireplace is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a gas fireplace is not considered to be an
  energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 7, unless it
    is manufactured on or after June 1, 2003; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 266.1, unless it is
    manufactured on or after January 1, 2020.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[267]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-267 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a gas fireplace:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the type of fuel it uses;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its maximum and minimum input rates, expressed in
    kilowatts (British thermal units per hour);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the fireplace efficiency;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether it is
    freestanding, zero-clearance or an insert;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the type of ignition system it uses;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the venting configuration the product has, namely,
    natural venting, direct venting or powered venting;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether the product is a
    decorative gas fireplace or a heating gas fireplace; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} if the product is a decorative gas fireplace that
    is manufactured on or after January 1, 2020, information that
    indicates whether it is intended for use as a replacement unit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} CSA P.4.1, if the product was manufactured on or
    after June 1, 2003 and before January 1, 2017; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA P.4.1-15, if the product is manufactured on or
    after January 1, 2017.

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[Gas-Fired Unit Heaters]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836348 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[268]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-268 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA P.11]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.11]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-P.11-07 entitled Testing Method for Measuring Efficiency and
    Energy Consumption of Gas-fired Unit Heaters. ([CSA
    P.11]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[gas-fired unit heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gas-fired unit heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    self-contained, automatically controlled, vented, gas-burning
    appliance that distributes warmed air without the use of ducts and
    that has an input rate of not more than 2 931 kW (10,000,000
    Btu/h). ([aérotherme à gaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[269]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-269 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  gas-fired unit heater is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 270, a
  gas-fired unit-heater is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after August 8, 2008.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[270]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-270 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  following energy efficiency standards apply to a gas-fired unit
  heater:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its thermal efficiency must be at least 80% at the
    maximum heat input nominal capacity; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it must be equipped with an intermittent ignition
    device and

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a power-vented system,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an automatic vent damper, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an automatic flue damper.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A gas-fired unit heater complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by CSA P.11 that are
  applicable to a [[gas-fired unit heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 268.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[271]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-271 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA P.11 and provided to the Minister in respect of a
gas-fired unit heater:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the type of fuel it uses;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the type of ignition system it has;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the venting configuration it has, namely, a
  power-vented system, an automatic vent damper or an automatic flue
  damper;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} its maximum heat input and output nominal capacities,
  expressed in kilowatts;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} its thermal efficiency when at the maximum heat input
  nominal capacity;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} its electricity consumption, expressed in kilowatt
  hours, when at the maximum nominal heat input capacity; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} if it is a modulating or staged control gas-fired
  unit heater,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its reduced heat input and output nominal
    capacities, expressed in kilowatts, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} its electricity consumption, expressed in kilowatt
    hours, when at reduced heat input nominal capacity.

#### [SUBDIVISION E]{.HLabel3}[Electric Furnaces]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1214225 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[electric
furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[272]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-272 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[electric furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an automatic operating
central forced air furnace that uses single-phase electric current to
heat one or more electrical resistance heating elements and has an input
rate of not more than 65.92 kW (225,000 Btu/h). It does not include an
electric furnace that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} produces at least 300 Pa (1.2 inches of water)
  external static pressure when operated at an air volume rate of 104 to
  165 L/s (220 to 350 ft^3^/min) per nominal ton of cooling in the
  highest default cooling airflow-control setting; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} uses room outlets that produce velocities greater
  than 5 m/s (1,000 ft/min) and each have an area less than 39 cm^2^ (6
  square inches).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 12](#1136355-1214237){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136355-1214237.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[273]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-273 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  electric furnace is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 274,
  an electric furnace is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after July 3, 2019.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 12](#1136355-1214244){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136355-1214244.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard

- **[[274]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-274 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standard that applies to an electric furnace is that
  its FER must be less than or equal to the FER for product class
  "Non-Weatherized, Electric Furnace/Modular Blower Fan", set out in 10
  C.F.R. §430.32(y).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An electric furnace complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. Appendix
  AA that are applicable to an [[electric
  furnace]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 272.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 12](#1136355-1214251){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136355-1214251.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[275]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-275 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with 10 C.F.R. Appendix AA and provided to the Minister in
respect of an electric furnace:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its maximum heat input nominal capacity, expressed in
  kilowatts (British thermal units per hour);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its FER, expressed in watts per 472 L/s (watts per
  1000 ft^3^/min); and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its maximum airflow (Qmax), expressed in L/s
  (ft^3^/min).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 12](#1136355-1214258){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136355-1214258.html"}
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION F]{.HLabel3}[Recovery Ventilators]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1214259 .Subheading}

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1214260 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[276]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-276 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C439-18]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C439-18]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C439-18 entitled Laboratory methods of test for rating the
    performance of heat/energy-recovery ventilators. ([CSA
    C439-18]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[energy-recovery ventilator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[energy-recovery ventilator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    factory-built packaged unit that has fans or blowers, has a maximum
    rated airflow of not more than 142 L/s (300 ft^3^/min) at 0°C and
    transfers heat and moisture between two isolated
    airstreams. ([ventilateur-récupérateur d'énergie]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[heat-recovery ventilator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[heat-recovery ventilator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    factory-built packaged unit that has fans or blowers, has a maximum
    rated airflow of not more than 142 L/s (300 ft^3^/min) at 0°C and
    transfers heat between two isolated
    airstreams. ([ventilateur-récupérateur de chaleur]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[sensible heat recovery efficiency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[sensible heat recovery efficiency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in
    respect of an energy-recovery ventilator or a heat-recovery
    ventilator, the ratio of the net sensible energy recovered by the
    unit's supply airstream, as adjusted to account for the unit's
    external and internal energy gains and losses, to the maximum
    sensible energy that would be recovered if the unit had an infinite
    transfer area. ([efficacité de récupération de chaleur
    sensible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 12](#1136355-1214268){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136355-1214268.html"}
:::

##### [Energy-recovery Ventilators]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1214269 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[277]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-277 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  energy-recovery ventilator is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, an
  energy-recovery ventilator is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2020.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 12](#1136355-1214276){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136355-1214276.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[278]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-278 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C439-18 and be provided to the Minister in
respect of an energy-recovery ventilator:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its maximum rated airflow at 0°C;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its sensible heat recovery efficiency at 0°C and the
  associated net supply airflow, expressed in L/s, and electrical power
  consumption, expressed in watts; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} unless the unit is marked for use only where the
  outdoor design temperature is greater than or equal to -10°C, its
  sensible heat recovery efficiency at -25°C and the associated net
  supply airflow, expressed in L/s.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 12](#1136355-1214283){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136355-1214283.html"}
:::

##### [Heat-recovery Ventilators]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1214284 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[279]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-279 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  heat-recovery ventilator is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, a
  heat-recovery ventilator is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2020.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 12](#1136355-1214291){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136355-1214291.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[280]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-280 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C439-18 and be provided to the Minister in
respect of a heat-recovery ventilator:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its maximum rated airflow at 0°C;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its sensible heat recovery efficiency at 0°C and the
  associated net supply airflow, expressed in L/s, and electrical power
  consumption, expressed in watts; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} unless the unit is marked for use only where the
  outdoor design temperature is greater than or equal to -10°C, its
  sensible heat recovery efficiency at -25°C and the associated net
  supply airflow, expressed in L/s.

::: HistoricalNote

### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Boilers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-836380 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836381 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[314]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-314 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[ASHRAE 103]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ASHRAE 103]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ANSI/ASHRAE standard
    103-2007 entitled Method of Testing for Annual Fuel Utilization
    Efficiency of Residential Central Furnaces and Boilers. ([ASHRAE
    103]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[automatic water temperature adjustment device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[automatic water temperature adjustment
    device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a device that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} adjusts the temperature of the water supplied by
      a boiler to ensure that an incremental change in inferred heat
      load produces a corresponding incremental change in the
      temperature of the water supplied or, if the boiler fires at a
      single input rate, automatically allows the burner or heating
      element to fire only when the device has determined that the
      inferred heat load cannot be met by the residual heat of the water
      in the system; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} when there is no inferred heat load, limits the
      water temperature in the boiler to not more than
      60°C. ([dispositif automatique de réglage de la température de
      l'eau]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-P.2-13 entitled Testing Method for Measuring the Annual Fuel
    Utilization Efficiency of Residential Gas-Fired or Oil-Fired
    Furnaces and Boilers. ([CSA P.2]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix A to
    Subpart E, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for the Measurement of
    Thermal Efficiency and Combustion Efficiency of Commercial Packaged
    Boilers, as amended from time to time. ([appendice A 10
    C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 13](#1136357-1214302){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136357-1214302.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-314-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 314"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Gas Boilers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836388 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[315]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-315 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CGA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CGA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CGA standard CGA P.2-1991
    entitled Testing Method for Measuring Annual Fuel Utilization
    Efficiencies of Residential Furnaces and Boilers. ([CGA
    P.2]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2019-164, s.
    14\]]{.Repealed}

[[gas boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gas boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a boiler that uses
    exclusively propane or natural gas, is intended for application in a
    low pressure steam, or hot water, central heating system and has an
    input rate of not more than 2 930.71 kW (10,000,000
    Btu/h). ([chaudière à gaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 14](#1136359-1214304){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136359-1214304.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-315-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 315"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[315.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-315.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
these Regulations, a gas boiler is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} household, if it has an input rate of less than 87.92
  kW (300,000 Btu/h); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} commercial, if it is has an input rate of greater
  than or equal to 87.92 kW (300,000 Btu/h) but not more than 2 930.71
  kW (10,000,000 Btu/h).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 15](#1136363-1214312){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136363-1214312.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[316]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-316 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  gas boiler is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a gas boiler is not considered to be an
  energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 4 unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is a household gas boiler that is manufactured
      on or after June 30, 1999, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is a commercial gas boiler that is
      manufactured on or after January 1, 2025; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 5 and 317 unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is a household gas boiler that is manufactured
      on or after December 31, 1998, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is a commercial gas boiler that is
      manufactured on or after January 1, 2025.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 16](#1136365-1214314){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136365-1214314.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-316-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 316"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards --- household

- **[[317]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-317 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of Table 1 to this
  section apply to household gas boilers described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard --- household

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A household gas boiler complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 of Table 1 that are applicable to a [[gas
  boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 315.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards ---
  commercial

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency standards set out in column 2
  of Table 2 to this section apply to commercial gas boilers described
  in column 1 that are manufactured on or after January 1, 2025.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard --- commercial

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A commercial gas boiler complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. Appendix A
  that are applicable to a [[gas boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 315.
