#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Oil-Fired Boilers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836420 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[319]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-319 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA B212]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA B212]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CSA-B212-93
    entitled Seasonal Energy Utilization Efficiencies of Oil-Fired
    Furnaces and Boilers. ([CSA B212]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[oil-fired boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[oil-fired boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a boiler that is
    intended for application in a low pressure steam, or hot water,
    central heating system, has an input rate of less than 2 930.71 kW
    (10,000,000 Btu/h) and is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} exclusively oil-fired; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} capable of being fired, at the choice of the
      user, by either oil or another fuel. ([chaudière à
      mazout]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 19](#1136376-1214355){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136376-1214355.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-319-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 319"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[319.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-319.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
these Regulations, an oil-fired boiler is one of the following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} household, if it has an input rate of less than 87.92
  kW (300,000 Btu/h); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} commercial, if it is has an input rate of greater
  than or equal to 87.92 kW (300,000 Btu/h) but not more than 2 930.71
  kW (10,000,000 Btu/h).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 20](#1136378-1214362){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136378-1214362.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[320]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-320 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  oil-fired boiler is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, an oil-fired boiler is not considered to be
  an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 4, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is a household oil-fired boiler that is
      manufactured on or after June 30, 1999, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is a commercial oil-fired boiler that is
      manufactured on or after January 1, 2025; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 5 and 321, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is a household oil-fired boiler that is
      manufactured on or after December 31, 1998, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is a commercial oil-fired boiler that is
      manufactured on or after January 1, 2025.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 21](#1136380-1214364){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136380-1214364.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards --- household

- **[[321]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-321 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of Table 1 to this
  section apply to household oil-fired boilers described in column 1
  that are manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard --- household

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A household oil-fired boiler complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 of Table 1 that are applicable to an [[oil-fired
  boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 319.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-efficiency standards ---
  commercial

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency standards set out in column 2
  of Table 2 to this section apply to commercial oil-fired boilers
  described in column 1 that are manufactured on or after January 1,
  2025.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing Standard --- commercial

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A commercial oil-fired boiler complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. Appendix A
  that are applicable to an [[oil-fired boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
  as defined in section 319.

W;</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(f)</span> information that indicates
whether product has tankless domestic water heating coils; and</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(g)</span> type of automatic water
temperature adjustment device product has, if any.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="noBorderRight">4</td>
<td class="noBorderRight" scope="row">Commercial oil-fired boilers
manufactured on or after January 1, 2025</td>
<td class="noBorderRight">10 C.F.R. Appendix A</td>
<td><ul>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> type of central heating
system for which product is intended;</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> maximum heat input nominal
capacity, in kW (Btu/h); and</p></li>
<li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> thermal efficiency or, if
product has an input rate of &gt; 732.68 kW (2,500,000 Btu/h) but ≤ 2
930.71 kW (10,000,000 Btu/h) and is intended for hot water systems,
combustion efficiency.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>

</table>

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Electric Boilers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836453 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[electric
boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[323]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-323 .sectionLabel}** In this Subdivision,
[[electric boiler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a boiler that uses
electric energy as a source of heat, is intended for application in a
hot water central heating system, has an input rate of less than 88 kW
(300,000 Btu/h) and is not equipped with tankless domestic water heating
coils.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[324]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-324 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  electric boiler is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 325,
  an electric boiler is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after September 1, 2012.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard

**[[325]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-325 .sectionLabel}** The energy efficiency
standard that applies to an electric boiler is that it must be equipped
with an automatic water temperature adjustment device without which the
boiler is not operable.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[326]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-326 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be provided
to the Minister in respect of an electric boiler:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its input rate, expressed in kilowatts, collected in
  accordance with ASHRAE 103; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the type of automatic water temperature adjustment
  device that it has.

**\[327 to 368 reserved\]**

### [DIVISION 6]{.HLabel2}[Water Heaters]{.HTitleText2} {#h-836468 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836469 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[369]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-369 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[CSA P.3-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.3-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-P.3-15 entitled Testing method for measuring energy
    consumption and determining efficiencies of gas-fired and fuel
    oil-fired water heaters. ([CSA P.3-15]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[first-hour rating]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[first-hour rating]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
    gas-fired storage water heater or an oil-fired water heater, the
    measure of the maximum volume of hot water that the water heater can
    supply within an hour that begins when the water in the water heater
    is fully heated. ([capacité de première heure]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix A to
    Subpart G, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for the Measurement of
    Thermal Efficiency and Standby Loss of Gas-Fired and Oil-Fired
    Storage Water Heaters and Storage-Type Instantaneous Water Heaters,
    as amended from time to time. ([appendice A 10
    C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[V~r~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[V~r~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the nominal volume, expressed in
    litres, of a water heater's storage tank. ([V~r~]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[V~s~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[V~s~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the measured storage volume,
    expressed in litres, of a water heater's storage
    tank. ([V~s~]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-201, s. 38
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 24](#1136389-1214403){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136389-1214403.html"}
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Electric Water Heaters]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836478 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[370]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-370 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[bottom inlet]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[bottom inlet]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a cold water inlet, other
    than one with a dip tube, that enters near the bottom of the water
    heater's storage tank. ([entrée inférieure]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[CSA C191-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C191-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C191-04 entitled Performance of Electric Storage Tank Water
    Heaters for Domestic Hot Water Service. ([CSA
    C191-04]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[electric water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[electric water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a stationary
    electric storage tank water heater that is intended for use on a
    pressurized water system and that has a V~r~ of at least 50 L (13.21
    US gallons). ([chauffe-eau électrique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix B to
    Subpart G, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for the Measurement of
    Standby Loss of Electric Storage Water Heaters and Storage-Type
    Instantaneous Water Heaters, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice B 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-201, s. 39
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 25](#1136391-1214404){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136391-1214404.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[370.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-370.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
these Regulations, an electric water heater is one of the following
types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} household, if it has an input rate of less than or
  equal to 12 kW (40,982 Btu/h); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} commercial, if it is has an input rate of greater
  than 12 kW (40,982 Btu/h).

::: HistoricalNote

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[371]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-371 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  electric water heater is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, an electric water heater is not considered
  to be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, unless it is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a household electric water heater that is
      manufactured on or after February 3, 1995, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a commercial electric water heater that is
      manufactured on or after January 1, 2020; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of section 372, unless it is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a household electric water heater that is
      manufactured on or after February 3, 1995,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a commercial electric water heater that is
      manufactured on or after January 1, 2020, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a commercial electric water heater with a V~r~
      that is less than or equal to 530 L (140 US gallons).

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[372]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-372 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to electric water heaters described in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An electric water heater described in column 1
  complies with the energy efficiency standard set out in column 3 if it
  meets that standard when tested in accordance with testing procedures
  established by the standard set out in column 2 that are applicable to
  an [[electric water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
  section 370.

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Gas-Fired Storage Water Heaters]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836508 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[374]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-374 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA P.3-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA P.3-04]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-P.3-04 entitled Testing Method for Measuring Energy
    Consumption and Determining Efficiencies of Gas-Fired Storage Water
    Heaters. ([CSA P.3-04]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[gas-fired storage water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gas-fired storage water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    stationary gas-heated water container that uses propane or natural
    gas for fuel and has a V~r~ of at least 76 L (20 US
    gallons). ([chauffe-eau à réservoir alimenté au
    gaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[replacement unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[replacement unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a commercial
    gas-fired storage water heater that is marked for replacement
    installations only. ([unité de remplacement]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 30](#1136404-1214440){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136404-1214440.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-374-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 374"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[374.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-374.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
these Regulations, a gas-fired storage water heater is one of the
following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} household, if it has an input rate of less than or
  equal to 21.97 kW (75,000 Btu/h); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} commercial, if it is has an input rate of greater
  than 21.97 kW (75,000 Btu/h).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 31](#1136409-1214448){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136409-1214448.html"}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[375]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-375 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  gas-fired storage water heater is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 376, a
  gas-fired storage water heater is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is a household gas-fired storage water heater
    that is manufactured on or after February 3, 1995; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is a commercial gas-fired storage water heater
    that is manufactured on or after July 1, 2023.

subsection 5(1) of the Act, the information set out in column 3 of the
table to this section must be collected in accordance with the standard
set out in column 2 and provided to the Minister in respect of a
gas-fired storage water heater described in column 1.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Oil-Fired Water Heaters]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836553 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[378]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-378 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA B211-00]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA B211-00]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-B211-00 entitled Energy Efficiency of Oil-Fired Storage Tank
    Water Heaters. ([CSA B211-00]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[oil-fired water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[oil-fired water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a water heater
    that uses oil for fuel and that has a V~r~ of at least 76 L (20 US
    gallons). ([chauffe-eau à mazout]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 35](#1136423-1214645){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136423-1214645.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-378-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 378"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[378.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-378.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
these Regulations, an oil-fired water heater is one of the following
types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} household, if it has an input rate of less than or
  equal to 30.5 kW (105,000 Btu/h); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} commercial, if it is has an input rate of greater
  than 30.5 kW (105,000 Btu/h).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 36](#1136425-1214652){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136425-1214652.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[379]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-379 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  oil-fired water heater is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 380,
  an oil-fired water heater is not considered to be an energy-using
  product unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is a household oil-fired water heater that is
    manufactured on or after February 3, 1995; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is a commercial oil-fired water heater that is
    manufactured on or after January 1, 2020.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 37](#1136427-1214654){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136427-1214654.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards --- household

- **[[380]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-380 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of Table 1 to this
  section apply to household oil-fired water heaters described in column
  1 that are manufactured during the period set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard --- household

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An oil-fired water heater complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 that are applicable to a [[oil-fired water
  heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 378.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards ---
  commercial

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency standards set out in column 2
  of Table 2 to this section apply to commercial oil-fired water heaters
  described in column 1 that are manufactured on or after January 1,
  2020.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard --- commercial

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A commercial oil-fired water heater complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 of Table 2 that are applicable to an [[oil-fired water
  heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 378.

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[Gas-Fired Instantaneous Water Heaters]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1214690 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[382]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-382 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[gas-fired instantaneous water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[gas-fired instantaneous water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    flow-activated water heater that uses natural gas or propane for
    fuel, that has a V~r~ that is less than or equal to 37.85 L (10 US
    gallons) and has an input rate to V~r~ ratio of not less than 309
    W/L (4,000 Btu/h/US gallon). ([chauffe-eau instantané au
    gaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[maximum flow rate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[maximum flow rate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
    gas-fired instantaneous water heater, the maximum litres per minute
    (gallons per minute) of hot water that can be supplied by the water
    heater while operating in a steady state and maintaining a nominal
    temperature rise of 37.3°C (67°F). ([débit maximal]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R Appendix C]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R Appendix C]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix C to the
    Subpart G, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for the Measurement of
    Thermal Efficiency and Standby Loss of Gas-Fired and Oil-Fired
    Instantaneous Water Heaters and Hot Water Supply Boilers (Other Than
    Storage-Type Instantaneous Water Heaters), as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice C 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 40](#1136439-1214697){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136439-1214697.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Type

**[[383]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-383 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
these Regulations, a gas-fired instantaneous water heater is one of the
following types:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} household, if it has an input rate of less than 58.56
  kW (200,000 Btu/h), has a V~r~ of no greater than 7.6 L (2 US gallons)
  and is designed to provide hot water at a temperature no greater than
  82°C (180°F); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} commercial, if it is not described in paragraph (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 40](#1136439-1214703){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136439-1214703.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[384]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-384 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  gas-fired instantaneous water heater is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 385, a
  gas-fired instantaneous water heater is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is a household gas-fired instantaneous water
    heater that is manufactured on or after January 1, 2020; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is a commercial gas-fired instantaneous water
    heater that is manufactured on or after July 1, 2023.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-164, s. 40](#1136439-1214712){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136439-1214712.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[385]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-385 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to gas-fired instantaneous water heaters described in
  column 1 that are manufactured during the period set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standards

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A gas-fired instantaneous water heater complies with
  the energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested
  in accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set
  out in column 2 that are applicable to a [[gas-fired instantaneous
  water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 382.

### [DIVISION 7]{.HLabel2}[Lamps and Lamp Ballasts]{.HTitleText2} {#h-836595 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836596 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[424]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-424 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[ANSI C78.20]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ANSI C78.20]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ANSI standard ANSI
    C78.20-2003 entitled American National Standard for Electric Lamps
    --- A, G, PS, and Similar Shapes with E26 Medium Screw Bases. ([ANSI
    C78.20]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ANSI C78.79]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ANSI C78.79]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ANSI standard ANSI
    C78.79-2014 entitled American National Standard for Electric Lamps
    --- Nomenclature for Envelope Shapes Intended for Use with Electric
    Lamps. ([ANSI C78.79]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ANSI C79.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ANSI C79.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s.
    42\]]{.Repealed}

[[ANSI C81.61]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ANSI C81.61]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ANSI standard ANSI
    C81.61-2016 entitled American National Standard for Electrical Lamp
    Bases --- Specifications for Bases (Caps) for Electric Lamps. ([ANSI
    C81.61]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[appliance lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[appliance lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is designed
    to operate in ambient temperatures of up to 315ºC, has a maximum
    nominal power of 40 W and is marketed as an appliance lamp. ([lampe
    pour appareils électroménagers]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CIE 13.3]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CIE 13.3]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CIE standard CIE
    13.3-1995 entitled Method of Measuring and Specifying Colour
    Rendering Properties of Light Sources. ([CIE 13.3]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[CIE 15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CIE 15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CIE standard CIE 15: 2004
    entitled Colorimetry. ([CIE 15]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[coloured lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[coloured lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is marketed
    as a coloured lamp and has

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a colour rendering index of less than 50, as
      determined in accordance with CIE 13.3; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a correlated colour temperature of less than 2
      500 K or more than 4 600 K. ([lampe colorée]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[IES Handbook]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IES Handbook]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IES publication
    entitled Lighting Handbook, 9th edition. ([Manuel
    IES]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IES LM16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IES LM16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IES standard IES
    LM-16-1993 entitled Practical Guide to Colorimetry of Light
    Sources. ([IES LM16]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IES LM45]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IES LM45]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IES standard IES LM-45-15
    entitled IES Approved Method for the Electrical and Photometric
    Measurement of General Service Incandescent Filament Lamps. ([IES
    LM45]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IES LM49]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IES LM49]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IES standard IES LM-49-12
    entitled IES Approved Method For Life Testing of Incandescent
    Filament Lamps. ([IES LM49]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IES LM65]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IES LM65]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IES standard IES LM-65-14
    entitled IES Approved Method for the Life Testing of Single-Based
    Fluorescent Lamps. ([IES LM65]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[incandescent reflector lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[incandescent reflector lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp in
    which light is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} produced by a filament that is heated to
      incandescence by an electric current; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} directed by an inner reflective coating on the
      outer bulb. ([lampe-réflecteur à incandescence]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[infrared lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[infrared lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that emits more
    than 90% of its radiation in the 0.7 µm to 10 µm range of the
    electromagnetic spectrum. ([lampe infrarouge]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[lamp efficacy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[lamp efficacy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the number of lumens per
    watt determined by

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} dividing a lamp's luminous flux by its power,
      measured under equilibrium conditions at the time of determining
      the luminous flux; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a general service incandescent
      reflector lamp, rounding the number calculated under paragraph (a)
      to the nearest half number. ([efficacité
      lumineuse]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[modified spectrum lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[modified spectrum lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp, other
    than a coloured lamp, that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is marketed as a modified spectrum lamp; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} when operated at its nominal voltage and nominal
      power, has a colour point that, on the 1931 chromaticity diagram
      described in CIE 15, lies below the black-body locus and is at
      least 4 MacAdam steps, as described in IES LM16, distant from the
      colour point of a clear lamp with the same filament and bulb shape
      and that operates at the same nominal voltage and nominal
      power. ([lampe à spectre modifié]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[plant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[plant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that contains a
    filter or coating to suppress light with wavelengths of less than
    0.58 µm and that is marketed as a plant lamp. ([lampe pour
    horticulture]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[rough service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[rough service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is
    marketed as a rough service lamp and has any of the following
    filament constructions, as illustrated in figure 6.12 of the IES
    Handbook:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a C-7A or C-11 filament construction, with at
      least five supports exclusive of lead wires;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a C-17 filament construction, with eight supports
      exclusive of lead wires; or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a C-22 filament construction, with 16 supports
      exclusive of lead wires. ([lampe à construction
      renforcée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[shatter-resistant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[shatter-resistant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that has
    an external silicone, polytetrafluoroethylene or similar coating
    applied to it for the purpose of resisting breakage and preventing
    glass from reaching the operating environment in the event of
    breakage and that is marketed as a shatter-resistant lamp. ([lampe
    résistante à l'éclatement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[silver bowl lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[silver bowl lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is
    marketed as a silver bowl lamp and that has a reflective coating
    that is applied directly to a part of the bulb surface so that light
    is reflected toward the lamp base. ([lampe à calotte
    argentée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[submersible lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[submersible lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that meets the
    requirements set out in the CSA standard C22.2 No. 89-1976, entitled
    Swimming-Pool Luminaires, Submersible Luminaires and
    Accessories. ([lampe submersible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[vibration service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[vibration service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is marketed as a vibration service lamp;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a maximum nominal power of 60 W; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has a C-5, C-7A or C-9 filament construction ---
      as illustrated in figure 6.12 of the IES Handbook --- or a similar
      construction, with less than five supports. ([lampe
      antivibrations]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

#### [Labelling]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836635 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Label required

**[[425]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-425 .sectionLabel}** Every CFL, general
service lamp, modified spectrum incandescent lamp and general service
incandescent reflector lamp that, for the purpose of sale or lease, is
shipped from one province to another or imported into Canada must be
labelled in accordance with sections 426 to 429.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information on principal display panel

- **[[426]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-426 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  principal display panel of the product's package must display the
  following information in the following order:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} except in the case of a BR or ER lamp, the words
    "Light Output" and "[Flux lumineux]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", followed
    by the numerical value of the product's luminous flux and the word
    "lumens";

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the words "Energy Used" and "[Consommation
    d'énergie]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", followed by the numerical value
    of the product's nominal power and the word "watts"; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the words "Life" and "[Durée de vie]{.otherLang
    lang="fr"}", followed by the numerical value of the product's life
    and the words "hours" and "[heures]{.otherLang lang="fr"}",
    respectively.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Font and size

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The words "Light Output", "[Flux lumineux]{.otherLang
  lang="fr"}", "Energy Used", "[Consommation d'énergie]{.otherLang
  lang="fr"}", "Life" and "[Durée de vie]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" must be
  in the same font and be equal in size.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Font and size

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The words "lumens", "watts", "hours" and
  "[heures]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" must be in the same font and be equal
  in size, but they must not be more than 50% of the size of the words
  referred to in subsection (2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Font and size

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The numerical values indicating the product's
  luminous flux, nominal power and life must be in the same font and be
  equal in size.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Three-way lamps

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the product is a three-way lamp, the information
  required by paragraphs (1)(a) and (b) must be displayed for each level
  of the lamp's operation.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Value of CFL life

**[[427]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-427 .sectionLabel}** Despite paragraph
426(1)(c), the value that is displayed on the principal display panel
for the life of a CFL may be

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the life testing of the CFL is completed, a value
  that is less than its life; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the life testing of the CFL is not completed, its
  design life, if a laboratory accredited in respect of the energy
  performance of lighting products by either the Standards Council of
  Canada or the National Voluntary Laboratory Accreditation Program, an
  A2LA certified laboratory or an ISO 9000 certified laboratory or
  manufacturing facility has, in accordance with IES LM65, verified 40%
  of the design life and at that point in the testing not more than one
  unit in the test sample has failed.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Design voltage other than 120 V

- **[[428]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-428 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  the design voltage of the product is other than 120 V, the information
  required by section 426 may correspond to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a voltage of 120 V, followed by the words "at 120
    volts" and "[à 120 volts]{.otherLang lang="fr"}"; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the design voltage, followed by the words, "at
    \[*design voltage*\] volts" and "[à \[*tension
    spécifique*\]]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the information corresponds to the design voltage,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the following statements must be displayed on the
    principal display panel:

    "This product is designed for \[*design voltage*\] volts. When used
    on the normal line voltage of 120 volts, the light output and energy
    efficiency are noticeably reduced. See \[*appropriate panel*\] panel
    for 120-volt rating."

    « [Ce produit a été conçu en fonction d'une tension de \[*tension
    spécifique*\] volts. S'il est employé à la tension normale de 120
    volts, son flux lumineux et son efficacité énergétique s'en
    trouveront considérablement réduits. Voir le panneau \[*panneau en
    cause*\] pour les renseignements correspondant à une tension de 120
    volts]{.otherLang lang="fr"}. »;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information required by section 426 for the
    product corresponding to a voltage of 120 V, followed by the words
    "at 120 volts" and "[à 120 volts]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", must be
    displayed on a panel of the product's package other than the
    principal display panel; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the design voltage must be displayed on every panel
    that displays the information required by section 426, other than
    the panel on which the information required by paragraph (b) is
    displayed.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Multiple lamps in common package

**[[429]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-429 .sectionLabel}** If more than one type
of lamp is included in a common package and their characteristics are
not uniform, the principal display panel of the common package must
display the following information for each type of lamp:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its design voltage; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information required by section 426, which must
  be in the size and font specified in that section.

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Compact Fluorescent Lamps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836672 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[430]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-430 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CFL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CFL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an integrally ballasted compact
    fluorescent lamp that has

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a medium screw base; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a nominal voltage of at least 100 V but not more
      than 130 V or a nominal voltage range that lies at least partially
      between those voltages. ([LFC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C861]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C861]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C861-10 entitled Performance of Self-ballasted Compact
    Fluorescent Lamps and Ballasted Adapters. ([CSA
    C861]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[431]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-431 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  CFL is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 432, a
  CFL is not considered to be an energy-using product unless it is
  manufactured on or after June 1, 2009.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[432]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-432 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a CFL:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its nominal voltage;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its nominal power, expressed in watts, or if it is
    a three-way lamp, its nominal power, expressed in watts, at each
    operating level;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} its luminous flux, or if it is a three-way lamp,
    its luminous flux at each operating level;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the lamp efficacy;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} its life, expressed in hours; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} its correlated colour temperature.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in paragraphs (1)(a)
    to (d) and (f) must be collected in accordance with CSA C861; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in paragraph (1)(e)
    must, using a sample of 10 CFLs, be collected in accordance with IES
    LM65, except that if the manufacturer has not specified an operating
    orientation for the lamp or has specified more than one orientation,
    five of the CFLs must be tested in the base-up orientation and the
    other five must be tested in the base-down orientation.

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[General Service Lamps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836697 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[general service
lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

- **[[433]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-433 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this Subdivision, [[general service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
  an electrical device that provides functional illumination and has a
  luminous flux of at least 310 lm but not more than 2 600 lm, a nominal
  voltage of at least 110 V but not more than 130 V or a nominal voltage
  range that lies at least partially between those voltages and a screw
  base. It does not include any of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an appliance lamp;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a CFL;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a coloured lamp;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an infrared lamp;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a G-shape as specified in ANSI
    C78.20 and ANSI C78.79 and a diameter of 12.7 cm or more;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a T-shape as specified in ANSI
    C78.20 and ANSI C78.79 and a maximum nominal power of 40 W or a
    length of more than 25.4 cm or both;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a left-hand thread lamp;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a plant lamp;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an incandescent reflector lamp;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a vacuum type or gas-filled lamp that has a
    sufficiently low bulb temperature to permit exposed outdoor use on
    high-speed flashing circuits and that is marketed as a sign service
    lamp;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a silver bowl lamp;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a traffic signal module, a pedestrian module or a
    street light;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} a submersible lamp;

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a screw base size of E5, E10, E11,
    E12, E17, E26/50×39, E26/53×39, E29/28, E29/53×39, E39, E39d, EP39
    or EX39 as specified in ANSI C81.61;

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a B, BA, CA, F, G16-½, G25, G30, S
    or M-14 shape or other similar shape as specified in ANSI C78.20 and
    ANSI C78.79 and a maximum nominal power of 40 W;

  - [(p)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that emits visible light produced by a
    current passing through a p-n junction solid state device; or

  - [(q)]{.lawlabel} a modified spectrum lamp.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Luminous flux

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of these Regulations, the luminous
  flux of a general service lamp must be calculated in accordance with
  IES LM45, except that the lamp must be tested at 120 V regardless of
  its nominal voltage.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[434]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-434 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  general service lamp is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a general service lamp is not considered to
  be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 435,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if it is a rough service lamp, a vibration
      service lamp, a shatter-resistant lamp or a lamp with an E26d
      screw base,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it has a luminous flux of less than 1 050 lm
      and was manufactured before December 31, 2014, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if it has a luminous flux of at least 1 050 lm
      and was manufactured before January 1, 2014; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 5 and 425 to 429, if
    it was manufactured before September 1, 2008.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[435]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-435 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to general service lamps described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A general service lamp complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures that are applicable to a [[general
  service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 433 and set
  out in the following standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} IES LM45 for the nominal power;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} IES LM49 for the life of the product; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} CIE 13.3 for the colour rendering index.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adjusted testing procedure

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The testing referred to in subsection (2) must,
  despite any provision to the contrary in the identified standard, be
  conducted with the lamp operating at 120 V regardless of its nominal
  voltage.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[436]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-436 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be provided
to the Minister in respect of a general service lamp:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a description of the lamp, collected in accordance
  with ANSI C78.79;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its colour rendering index, collected in accordance
  with CIE 13.3;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its correlated colour temperature, collected in
  accordance with CIE 15;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the following information collected in accordance
  with IES LM45, with the testing procedure adjusted in accordance with
  subsection 435(3), namely,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its nominal power, expressed in watts, or if it is
    a three-way lamp, its nominal power, expressed in watts, at each
    operating level, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} its luminous flux, expressed in lumens, or if it
    is a three-way lamp, its luminous flux, expressed in lumens, at each
    operating level; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} its life, expressed in hours, collected in accordance
  with IES LM49, with the testing procedure adjusted in accordance with
  subsection 435(3).

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional provision -- early
compliance

**[[436.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-436.1 .sectionLabel}** A [[general service
lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in subsection 433(1) of the new
Regulations, is deemed to satisfy the requirements of sections 4 and 5
of these Regulations and any applicable requirements of this Division if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a [[general service incandescent
  lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} or [[general service incandescent
  reflector lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as those terms are defined in
  subsection 433(1) of the new Regulations, it is manufactured on or
  after January 1, 2024 and before January 1, 2026 and satisfies the
  requirements of sections 4, 5, 435 and 436 of the new Regulations that
  would have applied to the lamp if it had been manufactured on or after
  January 1, 2026; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, it is manufactured on or after
  January 1, 2025 and before January 1, 2027 and satisfies the
  requirements of sections 4, 5, 435 and 436 of the new Regulations that
  would have applied to the lamp if it had been manufactured on or after
  January 1, 2027.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Modified Spectrum Incandescent Lamps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836755 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[modified spectrum
incandescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

- **[[437]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-437 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  this Subdivision, [[modified spectrum incandescent
  lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a modified spectrum lamp that has a
  luminous flux of at least 232 lm but not more than 1 950 lm, a nominal
  voltage of at least 110 V but not more than 130 V or a nominal voltage
  range that lies at least partially between those voltages, and a screw
  base. It does not include any of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an appliance lamp;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a CFL;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an infrared lamp;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a G-shape as specified in ANSI
    C78.20 and ANSI C78.79 and a diameter of 12.7 cm or more;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a T-shape as specified in ANSI
    C78.20 and ANSI C78.79 and a maximum nominal power of 40 W or a
    length of more than 25.4 cm or both;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that uses solid state technology, namely, a
    lamp with a light source that comes from light-emitting diodes;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a left-hand thread lamp;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a plant lamp;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an incandescent reflector lamp that has a shape
    specified in ANSI C78.79;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a vacuum type or gas-filled lamp that has a
    sufficiently low bulb temperature to permit exposed outdoor use on
    high-speed flashing circuits and that is marketed as a sign service
    lamp;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a silver bowl lamp;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a traffic signal module, a pedestrian module or a
    street light;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} a submersible lamp;

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a screw base size of E5, E10, E11,
    E12, E17, E26/50×39, E26/53×39, E29/28, E29/53×39, E39, E39d, EP39
    or EX39 as specified in ANSI C81.61; and

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a B, BA, CA, F, G16-½, G25, G30, S
    or M-14 shape or other similar shape as specified in ANSI C78.20 and
    ANSI C78.79 and a maximum nominal power of 40 W.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Luminous flux

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of these Regulations, the luminous
  flux of a modified spectrum incandescent lamp must be calculated in
  accordance with IES LM45, except that the lamp must be tested at 120 V
  regardless of its nominal voltage.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[438]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-438 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  modified spectrum incandescent lamp is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a modified spectrum incandescent lamp is not
  considered to be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 439,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if it is a rough service lamp, a vibration
      service lamp, a shatter-resistant lamp or a lamp with an E26d
      screw base,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it has a luminous flux of at least 788 lm and
      was manufactured before January 1, 2014, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if it has a luminous flux of less than 788 lm
      and was manufactured before December 31, 2014; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 5 and 425 to 429, if
    it was manufactured before September 1, 2008.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[439]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-439 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to modified spectrum incandescent lamps described in
  column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A modified spectrum incandescent lamp complies with
  the energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested
  in accordance with testing procedures that are applicable to a
  [[modified spectrum incandescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 437 and set out in the following standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} IES LM45 for the nominal power;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} IES LM49 for the life of the product; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} CIE 13.3 for the colour rendering index.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Adjusted testing procedure

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The testing referred to in subsection (2) must,
  despite any provision to the contrary in the identified standard, be
  conducted with the lamp operating at 120 V regardless of its nominal
  voltage.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[440]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-440 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be provided
to the Minister in respect of a modified spectrum incandescent lamp:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a description of the lamp, collected in accordance
  with ANSI C78.79;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its colour rendering index, collected in accordance
  with CIE 13.3;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its correlated colour temperature, collected in
  accordance with CIE 15;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the following information collected in accordance
  with IES LM45, with the testing procedure adjusted in accordance with
  subsection 439(3), namely,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its nominal power, expressed in watts, or if it is
    a three-way lamp, its nominal power, expressed in watts, at each
    operating level, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} its luminous flux, expressed in lumens, or if it
    is a three-way lamp, its luminous flux, expressed in lumens, at each
    operating level; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} its life, expressed in hours, collected in accordance
  with IES LM49, with the testing procedure adjusted in accordance with
  subsection 439(3).

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[General Service Incandescent Reflector Lamps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836811 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[441]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-441 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C862-01]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C862-01]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C862-01 entitled Performance of Incandescent Reflector
    Lamps. ([CSA C862-01]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C862-09]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C862-09]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C862-09 entitled Performance of Incandescent Reflector
    Lamps. ([CSA C862-09]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C862-12]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C862-12]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C862-12 entitled Performance of incandescent reflector
    lamps. ([CSA C862-12]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[general service incandescent reflector lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[general service incandescent reflector
    lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an incandescent reflector lamp that
    has a bulb shape described in ANSI C78.79 or a bulb shape similar to
    that shape, and that has an E26/24 single contact or E26/50×39
    skirted medium screw base, a nominal voltage of at least 100 V but
    not more than 130 V or a nominal voltage range that lies at least
    partially between those voltages, a diameter of more than 57 mm and
    a nominal power of at least 40 W but not more than 205 W. It does
    not include any of the following:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a coloured lamp;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a rough service lamp;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a vibration service lamp;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a BR30 or BR40 lamp that has a nominal power of
      50 W or less or of 65 W;

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an R20 lamp that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal power of 45 W or less, or

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal power of 100 W and a nominal
        overall length of not more than 92 mm (3.625 inches) and is
        designed and marketed for pool and spa applications; or

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a modified spectrum lamp that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is an ER30 or ER40 lamp, that has a nominal
        power of 50 W or less,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is an ER40 lamp that has a nominal power of 65
        W, or

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} was manufactured before July 15,
        2012. ([lampe-réflecteur à incandescence
        standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[442]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-442 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  general service incandescent reflector lamp is prescribed as an
  energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a general service incandescent reflector
  lamp is not considered to be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 4, if it was
    manufactured before December 31, 1996; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 425 to 429, if it was
    manufactured before September 1, 2008.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[443]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-443 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to general service incandescent reflector lamps
  described in column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out
  in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A general service incandescent reflector lamp
  complies with the energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard
  when tested in accordance with testing procedures established by CSA
  C862-12 that are applicable to a [[general service incandescent
  reflector lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 441.

#### [SUBDIVISION E]{.HLabel3}[General Service Fluorescent Lamps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836858 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[445]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-445 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix R]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix R]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix R to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring Average Lamp
    Efficacy (LE), Color Rendering Index (CRI), and Correlated Color
    Temperature (CCT) of Electric Lamps, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice R 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.32(n)(4)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(n)(4)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table to
    paragraph 430.32(n)(4) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10 to the
    United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(n)(4)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ANSI C78.81]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ANSI C78.81]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ANSI standard ANSI
    C78.81-2010 entitled American National Standard for Electric Lamps
    Double-Capped Fluorescent Lamps --- Dimensional and Electrical
    Characteristics. ([ANSI C78.81]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ANSI C78.901]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ANSI C78.901]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ANSI standard ANSI
    C78.901-2005 entitled American National Standard for Electric Lamps
    Single --- Based Fluorescent Lamps --- Dimensional and Electrical
    Characteristics. ([ANSI C78.901]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C819-11]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C819-11]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C819-11 entitled Performance of general service fluorescent
    lamps. ([CSA C819-11]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C819-16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C819-16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C819-16 entitled Performance of General Service Fluorescent
    Lamps. ([CSA C819-16]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C819-95]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C819-95]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s.
    44\]]{.Repealed}

[[cold temperature fluorescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cold temperature fluorescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    fluorescent lamp that is marketed for outdoor or cold temperature
    use and that is designed to start at temperatures as low as --29°C
    (--20°F) when used with a ballast that conforms to the requirements
    of ANSI C78.81 and ANSI C78.901. ([lampe fluorescente pour basses
    températures]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[coloured fluorescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[coloured fluorescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    fluorescent lamp that has

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a colour rendering index of less than 40, as
      determined in accordance with CIE 13.3; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a correlated colour temperature of less than 2
      500 K or more than 7 000 K, as determined in accordance with the
      IES standard IES LM-9-09 entitled IES Approved Method for the
      Electrical and Photometric Measurement of Fluorescent
      Lamps. ([lampe fluorescente colorée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[general service fluorescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[general service fluorescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    fluorescent lamp that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is straight-shaped and has a nominal overall
      length of 1 200 mm (48 inches), a medium bi-pin base and a nominal
      power of at least 25 W;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is U-shaped and has a nominal overall length of
      at least 560 mm (22 inches) but not more than 635 mm (25 inches),
      a medium bi-pin base and a nominal power of at least 25 W;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is rapid-start and straight-shaped and has a
      nominal overall length of 2 400 mm (96 inches) and a recessed
      double-contact base;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} is instant-start and straight-shaped and has a
      nominal overall length of 2 400 mm (96 inches), a single-pin base
      and a nominal power of at least 49 W;

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} is straight-shaped and standard output and has a
      nominal overall length of at least 1 125 mm (45 inches) but not
      more than 1 200 mm (48 inches), a miniature bi-pin base and a
      nominal power of at least 25 W;

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} is straight-shaped and high output with a nominal
      overall length of at least 1 125 mm (45 inches) but not more than
      1 200 mm (48 inches), a miniature bi-pin base and a nominal power
      of at least 44 W; or

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} is a physical and electrical equivalent of a lamp
      described in any of paragraphs (a) to (f).

    It does not include any of the following:

    - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a fluorescent lamp that is marketed as a plant
      lamp;

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a cold temperature fluorescent lamp;

    - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a coloured fluorescent lamp;

    - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a fluorescent lamp that is designed to be
      impact-resistant;

    - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a reflectorized or aperture fluorescent lamp;

    - [(m)]{.lawlabel} a fluorescent lamp that is designed for use in
      reprographic equipment;

    - [(n)]{.lawlabel} a fluorescent lamp that is primarily designed to
      produce ultraviolet radiation; or

    - [(o)]{.lawlabel} a fluorescent lamp that has a colour rendering
      index of at least 87. ([lampe fluorescente
      standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[448]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-448 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a general service
  fluorescent lamp:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its nominal power, expressed in watts;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its shape;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} its nominal overall length;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} its diameter;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} its base type;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} its abbreviation under the designation system in
    ANSI C78.81, Annex A, and ANSI C78.901, Annex B;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} its correlated colour temperature;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} its average colour rendering index; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the average lamp efficacy.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with
  one of the following standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} CSA C819-11, if the product was manufactured on or
    after December 31, 1996 and before January 26, 2018; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA C819-16 or 10 C.F.R. Appendix R, if the product
    is manufactured on or after January 26, 2018.

#### [SUBDIVISION F]{.HLabel3}[Fluorescent Lamp Ballasts]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836922 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[449]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-449 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  following definitions apply in this Subdivision.

  [[CSA C654-10]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CSA C654-10]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
      CAN/CSA-C654-10 entitled Fluorescent lamp ballast efficacy
      measurements. ([CSA C654-10]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CSA C654-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CSA C654-14]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
      CAN/CSA-C654-14 entitled Fluorescent lamp ballast efficacy
      measurements. ([CSA C654-14]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fluorescent lamp ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fluorescent lamp ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a ballast
      that is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} designed to start and operate fluorescent lamps
        by

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} providing the necessary voltage and current,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} limiting the current during normal
          operation, and

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if necessary to facilitate lamp operation,
          providing cathode heating;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} designed for a nominal voltage of at least 120
        V but not more than 347 V; and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} described in Table 1A of CSA C654-14.

      It does not include any of the following:

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a ballast --- other than a T12 dimming ballast
        --- that, by means of an integrated dimming capability, is
        designed to reduce the output of a fluorescent lamp by 50% or
        more;

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a low-frequency T8 ballast that is designed and
        marketed only for use in an
        electromagnetic-interference-sensitive environment and that is
        sold in a package of 10 or fewer; or

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a program-start ballast that is designed to
        operate one or more T8 fluorescent lamps with a nominal overall
        length of 1 200 mm and a medium bi-pin base, and that delivers
        an average current of less than 140 mA to each lamp. ([ballast
        pour lampes fluorescentes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[high-frequency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[high-frequency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
      fluorescent lamp ballast, that the ballast operates the lamp at a
      frequency of 10 kHz or more. ([à haute fréquence]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[low-frequency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[low-frequency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
      fluorescent lamp ballast, that the ballast operates at a supply
      frequency of 50 to 60 Hz and operates the lamp at the same
      frequency as the supply. ([à basse fréquence]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(m)(2)(ii)(B)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(m)(2)(ii)(B)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      paragraph 430.32(m)(2)(ii)(B) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10
      to the United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from
      time to time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(m)(2)(ii)(B)]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[10 C.F.R. Appendix Q]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix Q]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix Q to
      Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of
      Federal Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring
      the Energy Consumption of Fluorescent Lamp Ballasts, as amended
      from time to time. ([appendice Q 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[T12 dimming ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[T12 dimming ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a fluorescent
      lamp ballast that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is designed for a nominal voltage of at least
        120 V but not more than 277 V;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} by means of an integrated dimming capability,
        is designed to reduce the output of a T12 fluorescent lamp by
        50% or more; and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is designed to operate one F34T12 fluorescent
        lamp or two F34T12, F96T12ES or F96T12HO ES fluorescent
        lamps. ([ballast de gradation T12]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Table 1A of CSA C654-14

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 1(3), a reference in this
  Subdivision to Table 1A of CSA C654-14 is a reference to that table as
  it read on the day on which the standard was published.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[450]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-450 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  fluorescent lamp ballast is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 451, a
  fluorescent lamp ballast is not considered to be an energy-using
  product if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before February 3, 1995; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured on or after February 3, 1995
    and before November 14, 2014 and

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is a T12 dimming ballast,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is designed to operate a fluorescent lamp other
      than an F32T8, F34T12, F40T10 or F40T12 rapid-start fluorescent
      lamp or an F96T12ES, F96T12IS, F96T12HO or F96T12HO ES fluorescent
      lamp, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} is designed to be used in an outdoor sign and
      to operate two F96T12HO fluorescent lamps in ambient temperatures
      at or below --28.9°C.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[451]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-451 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to fluorescent lamp ballasts described in column 1 that
  are manufactured during the periods described in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A fluorescent lamp ballast complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 that are applicable to a [[fluorescent lamp
  ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 449.

#### [SUBDIVISION G]{.HLabel3}[Metal Halide Lamp Ballasts]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1127017 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[453]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-453 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C863-16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C863-16]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CAN/CSA
    C863-16 entitled Energy efficiency of high-intensity discharge (HID)
    and low-pressure sodium (LPS) lamp ballasts. ([CSA
    C863-16]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[electronic ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[electronic ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a ballast that is
    controlled by a transistor, thyristor or other active electronic
    component and in which impedance is provided by capacitive or
    inductive reactance. ([ballast électronique]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[magnetic-regulated lamp ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[magnetic-regulated lamp ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    ballast that operates at a lagging high power factor and that has

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} three coils;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} isolated secondary windings; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a constant-voltage regulator that, in conjunction
      with capacitive reactance, provides power factor correction and
      lamp wattage regulation. ([ballast à régulation
      magnétique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[metal halide lamp ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[metal halide lamp ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a device
    that is used to obtain the voltage, current and waveform necessary
    for starting and operating a metal halide lamp that has a nominal
    power of at least 50 W but not more than 1 000 W. It does not
    include any of the following:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a magnetic-regulated lamp ballast;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a replacement metal halide lamp ballast; or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an electronic ballast that is designed for a
      nominal voltage of 480 V or to operate a lamp at an output
      frequency of 1000 Hz or more. ([ballast pour lampes aux
      halogénures métalliques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[replacement metal halide lamp ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[replacement metal halide lamp ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
    a ballast that is marketed for use as replacement ballast for a
    metal halide luminaire installation and that is sold in a package of
    10 or fewer. ([ballast pour lampes aux halogénures métalliques de
    remplacement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §431.324]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §431.324]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means section 431.324 of
    Subpart S, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, as amended from time to time. ([10 C.F.R.
    §431.324]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[454]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-454 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  metal halide lamp ballast is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 455, a
  metal halide lamp ballast is not considered to be an energy-using
  product if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before February 10, 2017; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured before December 31, 2019 and is
    capable of using a nominal voltage of 347 V.

- **[[455]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-455 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in Table 3 of CSA C863-16 apply to
  metal halide lamp ballasts.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A metal halide lamp ballast complies with the energy

  ballast]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 453.

**[[456]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-456 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C863-16 and provided to the Minister in respect
of a metal halide lamp ballast:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its type;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the efficiency of the lamp and ballast combination,
  expressed as a percentage;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its nominal voltage;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} its input power, in watts;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the power, in watts, of the lamps that the ballast is
  designed to operate; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} its power factor.

### [DIVISION 8]{.HLabel2}[Lighting Fixtures]{.HTitleText2} {#h-836964 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836965 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[506]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-506 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[CSA C22.2 No. 250.0]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C22.2 No. 250.0]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    C22.2 No. 250.0-08 entitled Luminaires. ([CSA C22.2 No.
    250.0]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ITE VTCSH]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ITE VTCSH]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s.
    52\]]{.Repealed}

[[pin-based]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[pin-based]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with respect to a socket of
    a ceiling fan or ceiling fan light kit, one that is designed to hold
    a fluorescent lamp that is not integrally ballasted and that has a
    plug-in lamp base. It does not include a GU-24 socket. ([à
    broche]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Torchieres]{.HTitleText3} {#h-836971 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[507]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-507 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C22.2 No. 250.4]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C22.2 No. 250.4]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    C22.2 No. 250.4-14 entitled Portable luminaires. ([CSA C22.2 No.
    250.4]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[torchiere]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[torchiere]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a portable luminaire that
    has a reflector bowl or similar-shaped reflector that directs light
    in a predominantly upward direction for the purpose of providing
    indirect lighting and that may be equipped with one or more
    additional sockets intended for other lighting
    functions. ([torchère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[508]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-508 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  torchiere is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 509, a
  torchiere is not considered to be an energy-using product unless it is
  manufactured on or after January 1, 2007.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[509]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-509 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to torchieres described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A torchiere complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by CSA C22.2 No. 250.4 that are
  applicable to a [[torchiere]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
  section 507.

**[[510]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-510 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C22.2 No. 250.4 and provided to the Minister in
respect of a torchiere:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether the product has
  lighting functions additional to those of the bowl; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total power, expressed in watts, for all lighting
  functions.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Ceiling Fan Light Kits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837015 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[515]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-515 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[ceiling fan light kit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ceiling fan light kit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means equipment that
    is designed to provide light from a ceiling fan and that is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} integral to the fan before its retail sale; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} attachable to the fan after its retail
      sale. ([ensemble d'éclairage pour ventilateurs de
      plafond]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[integrated solid-state lighting circuitry]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[integrated solid-state lighting
    circuitry]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2024-54, s.
    1\]]{.Repealed}

[[non-consumer-replaceable solid-state lighting]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[non-consumer-replaceable solid-state
    lighting]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the lighting system in a
    ceiling fan light kit for which the solid-state lighting light
    source and all components necessary for the starting and stable
    operation of the light source -- that is, the driver, heat sink,
    intermediate circuitry -- cannot be replaced by the consumer without
    permanently altering the ceiling fan light kit. Furthermore, if the
    lighting system fails, the entire ceiling fan light kit must be
    replaced. ([éclairage à semi-conducteurs non remplaçable par le
    consommateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.23(x)(1)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.23(x)(1)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means paragraph
    430.23(x)(1) of Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States
    Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to time. ([10
    C.F.R. §430.23(x)(1)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §430.32(s)(6)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(s)(6)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table to
    paragraph 430.32(s)(6) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10 to the
    United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(s)(6)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 54](#1045097-1127139){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045097-1127139.html"}
- [SOR/2024-54, s. 1](#1449593-1449744){.wb-lbx
