[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[516]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-516 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  ceiling fan light kit is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a ceiling fan light kit is not considered to
  be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, if it was
    manufactured before January 1, 2010; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 517,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if it was manufactured before January 1, 2010,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is manufactured on or after January 1,
      2010 and before January 7, 2019, it has a total power less than or
      equal to 10 W or only pin-based sockets, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if it is manufactured on or after January 7,
      2019, it has at least one socket, has maximum wattage markings on
      each socket that together indicate that the combined total power
      for the lighting is less than or equal to 70 W and does not have
      non-consumer-replaceable solid-state lighting.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[518]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-518 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a ceiling fan light
  kit:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it has at least one socket, the type of socket
    and the number of each type of socket;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it has non-consumer-replaceable solid-state
    lighting, the lighting efficacy, expressed in lumens per watt, and
    the total light output, expressed in lumens;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if it has a pin-based socket, the ballast type;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if it is packaged with lamps, their type, brand
    name and model number; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the total power for the lighting, expressed in
    watts.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with
  CSA C22.2 No. 250.0 or 10 C.F.R. §430.23(x)(1).

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[Exit Signs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837034 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[519]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-519 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C860]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C860]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CAN/CSA
    C860-11 entitled Performance of Internally Lighted Exit Signs. ([CSA
    C860]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[exit sign]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[exit sign]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in CSA
    C860. It does not include an exit sign that flashes or that is
    photoluminescent or radioluminescent. ([enseigne de
    sortie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[legend]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[legend]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of the following that is
    displayed on an exit sign:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a representation of a running person, as
      described in Annex B.1 of the CSA standard CSA C22.2 No. 141
      entitled Emergency lighting equipment; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the word "EXIT" or
      "SORTIE". ([légende]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 57](#1045103-1127173){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045103-1127173.html"}
:::

  exit sign is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purpose of section 4, an exit sign
  is not considered to be an energy-using product unless it is
  manufactured on or after November 1, 2004.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[521]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-521 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to exit signs described in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An exit sign complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by CSA C860 that are applicable to an
  [[exit sign]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 519.

#### [SUBDIVISION E]{.HLabel3}[Traffic Signal Modules]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837063 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[523]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-523 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[traffic signal module]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[traffic signal module]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a self-contained
    device that is designed to

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} fit into a traffic signal housing; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide drivers with movement information by
      means of a red or green traffic signal indicator that has a
      nominal diameter of 200 mm (8 inches) or 300 mm (12
      inches). ([module de signalisation routière]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[VTCSH Arrow]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[VTCSH Arrow]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Institute of
    Transportation Engineers standard entitled Vehicle Traffic Control
    Signal Heads: Light Emitting Diode (LED) Vehicle Arrow Traffic
    Signal Supplement, dated July 1, 2007. ([VTCSH
    Arrow]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[VTCSH Circular]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[VTCSH Circular]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Institute of
    Transportation Engineers standard entitled Vehicle Traffic Control
    Signal Heads: Light Emitting Diode (LED) Circular Signal Supplement,
    dated June 27, 2005. ([VTCSH Circular]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[524]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-524 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  traffic signal module is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 525, a
  traffic signal module is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2007.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[525]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-525 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to traffic signal modules described in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing Procedures

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), the maximum power
  and nominal power of a traffic signal module must be determined in
  accordance with the following procedures:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the luminous intensity of the product must be
    determined in accordance with the procedures established by the
    standard set out in column 2 that are applicable to a [[traffic
    signal module]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 523;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the product's power must be measured using a watt
    meter that has an accuracy of ± 1%;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} when determining the product's maximum power, the
    product must be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} mounted in a temperature testing chamber with the
      lens portion of the product outside the chamber, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} operated for a minimum of 60 minutes at a
      temperature of 74°C and with the temperature in front of the lens
      maintained at a minimum of 49°C; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} when determining the product's nominal power, the
    product must be operated for a minimum of 60 minutes at an ambient
    temperature of 25°C.

- **[[526]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-526 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a traffic signal
  module:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its type;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its maximum power, expressed in watts; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} its nominal power, expressed in watts.

    any other traffic signal indicator.

#### [SUBDIVISION F]{.HLabel3}[Pedestrian Modules]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837103 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[527]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-527 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[pedestrian module]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[pedestrian module]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a self-contained
    device that is designed

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to fit into a pedestrian signal housing; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to provide pedestrians with movement information
      by means of a walking person display or a hand display but not by
      means of a countdown message. ([module de signalisation
      piétonnière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[PTCSI]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[PTCSI]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Institute of Transportation
    Engineers standard entitled Pedestrian Traffic Control Signal
    Indicators: Light Emitting Diode (LED) Signal Modules, dated August
    4, 2010. ([PTCSI]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[528]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-528 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  pedestrian module is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 529, a
  pedestrian module is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2007.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[529]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-529 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to pedestrian modules described in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing Procedures

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), the maximum power
  and nominal power of a pedestrian module must be determined in
  accordance with the following procedures:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the luminous intensity of the product must be
    determined in accordance with the procedures established by PTCSI
    that are applicable to a [[pedestrian module]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
    as defined in section 527;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the product's power must be measured using a watt
    meter that has an accuracy of ± 1%;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} when determining the product's maximum power, the
    product must be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} mounted in a temperature testing chamber with the
      lens portion of the product outside the chamber, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} operated for a minimum of 60 minutes at a
      temperature of 74°C and with the temperature in front of the lens
      maintained at a minimum temperature of 49°C; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} when determining the product's nominal power, the
    product must be operated for a minimum of 60 minutes at an ambient
    temperature of 25°C.

### [DIVISION 9]{.HLabel2}[Electronic Products]{.HTitleText2} {#h-837138 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837139 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[573]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-573 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[CSA C62301]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C62301]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C62301:11 entitled Household electrical appliances --
    Measurement of standby power. ([CSA C62301]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[information display]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[information display]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a clock or other
    device that provides visual alphanumeric or graphical information or
    indicates the status of the equipment. ([affichage]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[medical device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[medical device]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
    section 1 of the [Medical Devices
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-98-282). ([instrument
    médical]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Compact Audio Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837144 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[574]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-574 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[compact audio product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[compact audio product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a product that
    consists of an amplifier and a terrestrial tuner that are encased in
    a single housing --- including a product that can produce sound from
    another media --- and that uses mains power as at least one source
    of power and has attached or separable speakers. ([produit audio
    compact]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[off mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[off mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the mode in which the
    product, while connected to mains power, cannot produce sound or
    provide any mechanical function and cannot be switched into another
    mode except by means of a manual switch on the product. ([mode
    arrêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the mode in which the
    product, while connected to mains power,

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is not producing sound, providing mechanical
      function or exchanging data with, or receiving it from, an
      external source; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} can be switched into another mode with a remote
      control unit, an internal signal or an internal timer. ([mode
      veille]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 576, a

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A compact audio product complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in

  applicable to a [[compact audio product]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 574.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[577]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-577 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C62301 and provided to the Minister in respect of
a compact audio product:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its type;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it was manufactured before January 1, 2013 and has
  standby mode, its power consumption in that mode, expressed in watts;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} if it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2013 and
  has standby mode, its power consumption in that mode, expressed in
  watts, as applicable,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} with the information display active,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} with the information display inactive, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} without the information display;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} if it has standby mode, the period, expressed in
  minutes, that begins when standby mode is enabled and ends when the
  measurement of power consumption in that mode is completed; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} if it has off mode, its power consumption, expressed
  in watts, in off mode.

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Video Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837176 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[578]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-578 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[off mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[off mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the mode in which the
    product, while connected to mains power, cannot provide any
    mechanical function and cannot be switched into another mode with a
    remote control unit, a timer or another internal or external
    signal. ([mode arrêt]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the mode in which the
    product, while connected to mains power,

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is not producing video or audio output signals,
      providing any mechanical function or exchanging data with, or
      receiving it from, an external source; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} can be switched into another mode with a remote
      control unit, an internal signal or an internal timer. ([mode
      veille]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[video product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[video product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a household electronic
    product that is encased in a single housing, requires a power supply
    device in order to operate and is designed

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to be connected to mains power; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} primarily to do one or both of the following,
      namely, produce audio and video signals from, or record those
      signals to, digital or analog media.

    It does not include a camera or a portable DVD player that has both
    an integral display screen and a DC power source. ([appareil
    vidéo]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} if it has off mode, its power consumption, expressed
  in watts, in off mode; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the type of playback or recording technology that it
  has.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Televisions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837211 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[582]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-582 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[off mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[off mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the mode in which the
    product, while connected to mains power, cannot produce either sound
    or picture or provide any mechanical function and cannot be switched
    into another mode with a remote control unit, a timer or another
    internal or external signal. ([mode arrêt]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the mode in which the
    product, while connected to mains power,

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is not producing sound or picture, providing any
      mechanical function or exchanging data with, or receiving it from,
      an external source; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} can be switched into another mode with a remote
      control unit, an internal signal or an internal timer. ([mode
      veille]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[television]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[television]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an analog or digital
    product, with or without an internal tuner, that is designed
    primarily for the display and reception of a terrestrial, satellite,
    cable, Internet Protocol TV or other broadcast or recorded
    transmission of analog or digital video and audio signals and
    includes

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a combination television system in which a
      television and one or more other devices are encased as a single
      unit in the television casing; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a component television that has two or more
      separate components and that is marketed and sold as a television
      under one model or system designation.

    It does not include

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a television that is marketed exclusively for
      commercial use and is without an internal tuner; or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a television that is marketed primarily for use
      as a computer monitor. ([téléviseur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[583]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-583 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  television is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 584, a
  television is not considered to be an energy-using product unless it
  is manufactured on or after May 1, 2011.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[584]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-584 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 1 of the table to this
  section apply to televisions that are manufactured during the periods
  set out in column 2.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A television complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by CSA C62301 that are applicable to a
  [[television]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 582.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[585]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-585 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C62301 and provided to the Minister in respect of
a television:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it was manufactured before January 1, 2013 and has
  standby mode, its power consumption in that mode, expressed in watts;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2013 and
  has standby mode, its power consumption in that mode, expressed in
  watts, as applicable,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} with the information display active,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} with the information display inactive, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} without the information display;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} if it has standby mode, the period, expressed in
  minutes, that begins when standby mode is enabled and ends when the
  measurement of power consumption in standby mode is completed; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} if it has off mode, its power consumption, expressed
  in watts, in off mode.

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[External Power Supplies]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837247 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[586]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-586 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  following definitions apply in this Subdivision.

  [[adaptive external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[adaptive external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      external power supply that, without user intervention and while it
      is connected to mains power and each output is connected to a
      load, can alter the output voltage using a digital communication
      protocol with the end-use product. ([bloc d'alimentation externe
      adaptatif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CSA C381.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CSA C381.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
      CAN/CSA-C381.1-08 entitled Test method for calculating the energy
      efficiency of single-voltage external ac-ac and ac-ac power
      supplies. ([CSA C381.1]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[CSA C381.1-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[CSA C381.1-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
      CAN/CSA C381.1-17 entitled Energy performance of external ac-dc
      and ac-ac power supplies. ([CSA C381.1-17]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[detachable battery pack]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[detachable battery pack]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a battery
      that is encased in an enclosure separate from an end-use product
      and that is designed to be removed or disconnected from the
      end-use product for recharging. ([bloc-batterie
      amovible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[direct operation external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[direct operation external power
      supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a power supply device that is
      capable of operating an end-use product, other than a battery
      charger, without the assistance of a battery. ([bloc
      d'alimentation externe à fonctionnement direct]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      single-voltage external power supply or a multiple-voltage
      external power supply that is designed to be used with a household
      or office end-use product that constitutes the primary load. It
      does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a direct operation external power supply that
        has a nominal output voltage of less than 3 V and a nominal
        output current of 1 000 mA or more and that charges the battery
        of an end-use product that is fully or primarily motor-operated;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an indirect operation external power supply
        that has a nominal output power of greater than 250 W;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a device that powers the charger of a
        detachable battery pack of an end-use product;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a device that is an accessory to a medical
        device; or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a device that is solely designed to power
        solid-state lighting or a ceiling fan that has a direct current
        motor. ([bloc d'alimentation externe]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[indirect operation external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[indirect operation external power
      supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a power supply device that can
      only operate an end-use product with the assistance of a
      battery. ([bloc d'alimentation externe à fonctionnement
      indirect]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[multiple-voltage external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[multiple-voltage external power
      supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a device that is designed to
      convert line voltage AC input into more than one simultaneous
      lower voltage AC or DC outputs. ([bloc d'alimentation externe à
      tensions multiples]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[replacement external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[replacement external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      external power supply that is marked as a replacement to be used
      with a specific end-use product that was manufactured before July
      1, 2017. ([bloc d'alimentation externe de
      remplacement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[security external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[security external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      external power supply manufactured before July 1, 2017 that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is designed to convert line voltage AC into
        lower voltage AC output;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal output power of 20 W or more; and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is designed for and marketed with equipment
        that operates continuously in on mode to perform any of the
        following principal functions:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to monitor, detect, record or provide
          notification of any intrusion on real property or immovables,
          or access to real property or immovables or physical assets,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to provide notification of threats to
          personal safety resulting from an intrusion or access referred
          to in subparagraph (i),

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} to monitor, detect, record or provide
          notification of fire, gas, smoke, flooding or any other
          physical threats to real property or immovables, physical
          assets or personal safety, or

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} to deter or control access to real property
          or immovables or physical assets or prevent the unauthorized
          removal of physical assets.

      It includes an external power supply for equipment that is
      designed and marketed with a built-in alarm or theft-deterrent
      feature and whose principal functions are those referred to in
      paragraph (c). ([bloc d'alimentation externe de
      sécurité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[single-voltage external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[single-voltage external power supply]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      a device that is designed to convert line voltage AC input into
      only one lower AC or DC voltage output at a time. ([bloc
      d'alimentation externe à simple tension]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[10 C.F.R. Appendix Z]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix Z]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix Z to
      Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of
      Federal Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring
      the Energy Consumption of External Power Supplies, as amended from
      time to time. ([appendice Z 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(w)(1)(i)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[10 C.F.R. §430.32(w)(1)(i)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table
      to paragraph 430.32(w)(1)(i) of Subpart C, Part 430 of Title 10 to
      the United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from
      time to time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.32(w)(1)(i)]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[verification mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[verification mark]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
      in section 2. ([marque de vérification]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2018-201, s. 64\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[587]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-587 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  external power supply is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, an external power supply is not considered
  to be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 5 if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before July 1, 2010, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured on or after July 1, 2010 and
      before July 1, 2017 and

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is a multiple-voltage external power supply
        or an adaptive external power supply,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} it is a direct operation external power supply
        that has a nominal output power of greater than 250 W, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} it is an indirect operation external power
        supply that has a nominal output voltage of greater than 3 V and
        a nominal output current of less than 1 000 mA and that charges
        the battery of an end-use product that is fully or primarily
        motor-operated; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 588 if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before July 1, 2010,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured on or after July 1, 2010 and
      before July 1, 2017 and

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} it is a multiple-voltage external power supply
        or an adaptive external power supply,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} it is a direct operation external power supply
        that has a nominal output power of greater than 250 W, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} it is an indirect operation external power
        supply that has a nominal output voltage of greater than 3 V and
        a nominal output current of less than 1 000 mA and that charges
        the battery of an end-use product that is fully or primarily
        motor-operated, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before July 1, 2013 and is
      a replacement external power supply.

- **[[589]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-589 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether the product is a

    power supply;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for each voltage output, its nominal output voltage
    at the highest and lowest settings and information that indicates
    whether that voltage is AC or DC;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} its nominal output power, expressed in watts, at
    the highest and lowest power settings, if applicable;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} its average efficiency at the highest and lowest
    power settings, if applicable;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} its power in no-load mode, expressed in watts;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the Roman numeral mark, if applicable;

    replacement external power supply or a security external power

    product or equipment, as applicable, and the model number and brand

#### [SUBDIVISION E]{.HLabel3}[Battery Chargers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1127272 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[590]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-590 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[backup battery charger]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[backup battery charger]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a device that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is incorporated into an end-use product,
      including a device that is incorporated into an uninterruptible
      power supply or that uses an external power supply, that is
      designed to operate continuously using mains power; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} recharges a battery that is used to maintain the
      continuity of electrical power to the end-use product such that
      the product can continue its full or partial operation in the
      event of a failure of mains power. ([chargeur de batterie de
      secours]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[battery charger]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[battery charger]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a device that charges
    the battery of a wheelchair, golf cart, low-speed vehicle or any
    other end-use product. It does not include any of the following:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a device that charges the battery of a vehicle
      other than a wheelchair, golf cart or low-speed vehicle;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a device that charges the battery of a medical
      device;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a wireless battery charger, other than a wireless
      battery charger that is inductive and designed for wet
      environments; or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a backup battery charger. ([chargeur de
      batterie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C381.2-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C381.2-17]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CSA
    C381.2-17 entitled Energy performance of battery-charging systems
    and uninterruptible power supplies. ([CSA
    C381.2-17]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[low-speed vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[low-speed vehicle]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a vehicle that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} does not use fuel as an on-board source of
      energy;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} travels on two or more wheels;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is powered by an electric power train that is
      designed to allow the vehicle to attain a speed of no greater than
      40 km/h over a distance of 1.6 km on a paved level surface; and

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has a loaded weight, as specified by its
      manufacturer, of less than 1 361 kg. ([véhicule à basse
      vitesse]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix Y]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix Y]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix Y to
    Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Battery Chargers, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice Y 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 66](#1045139-1127310){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045139-1127310.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[591]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-591 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  battery charger is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 592, a
  battery charger is not considered to be an energy-using product unless
  it is manufactured on or after June 13, 2019.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 66](#1045139-1127317){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045139-1127317.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard

- **[[592]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-592 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  battery charger must have a unit energy consumption that is less than
  or equal to that set out for the battery charger's product class in
  Table C.1 of CSA C381.2-17.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standards

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A battery charger complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with the
  testing procedures established by CSA C381.2-17 or 10 C.F.R. Appendix
  Y that are applicable to a [[battery charger]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
  as defined in section 590.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 66](#1045139-1127324){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045139-1127324.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[593]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-593 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with CSA C381.2-17 or 10 C.F.R. Appendix Y and provided to
the Minister in respect of a battery charger:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its product class;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its rated battery energy (E~batt~), expressed in
  watt-hours;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its unit energy consumption, expressed in
  kilowatt-hours per year;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} its power, expressed in watts, when it is in active
  mode, maintenance mode and standby mode, respectively; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} if an external power supply was used to test the
  battery charger, the power supply's model number and the name of its
  manufacturer.

- [SOR/2018-201, s. 66](#1045139-1127333){.wb-lbx

**\[594 to 634 reserved\]**

### [DIVISION 10]{.HLabel2}[Commercial Refrigeration]{.HTitleText2} {#h-837307 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837308 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of
[[E~daily~]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

**[[635]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-635 .sectionLabel}** In this Division,
[[E~daily~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the daily energy consumption of a
product, expressed in kilowatt hours per day.

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Commercial Refrigerators, Refrigerator-Freezers and Freezers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837311 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[636]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-636 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[AV]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[AV]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a commercial
    refrigerator-freezer, its adjusted volume in litres, which is the
    sum of the refrigerator volume and 1.63 times the freezer
    volume. ([VC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[closed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[closed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a refrigerated compartment of a
      commercial refrigerator, commercial refrigerator-freezer or
      commercial freezer, that all its points of access can be closed
      off from the outside by a physical barrier and from which any
      refrigerated item can be accessed by opening a door or drawer; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a commercial refrigerator,
      commercial refrigerator-freezer or commercial freezer, that all of
      its compartments are as described in paragraph (a). ([type
      fermé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[commercial freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[commercial freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a freezer that is
    self-contained or remote-condensing, that uses or is designed to be
    used with a vapour-compression refrigeration system and whose
    compartments are all designed for the freezing and display or
    storage of food, beverages or ice at temperatures below 0°C. It does
    not include a household freezer or walk-in freezer. ([congélateur
    commercial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[commercial refrigerator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[commercial refrigerator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a refrigerator
    that is self-contained or remote-condensing, that uses or is
    designed to be used with a vapour-compression refrigeration system
    and whose compartments are all designed for the display or storage
    of food, beverages or flowers at temperatures at or above 0°C. It
    does not include a household refrigerator, refrigerated buffet
    table, refrigerated preparation table or walk-in
    cooler. ([réfrigérateur commercial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[commercial refrigerator-freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[commercial refrigerator-freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    refrigerator-freezer that is self-contained or remote-condensing,
    that uses or is designed to be used with a vapour-compression
    refrigeration system and that has two or more compartments, at least
    one of which is designed for the display or storage of food and
    beverages at temperatures at or above 0°C and at least one of which
    is designed for the freezing and display or storage of food and
    beverages at temperatures below 0°C. It does not include a household
    refrigerator-freezer, walk-in freezer or walk-in
    cooler. ([réfrigérateur-congélateur commercial]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[CSA C657]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C657]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CSA
    C657-2015 entitled Energy Performance Standard for Commercial
    Refrigeration Equipment. ([CSA C657]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ice cream freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ice cream freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a commercial freezer
    that is designed to operate at temperatures at or below --21°C ±
    1.1°C and that is designed or marketed for the storage, display or
    dispensing of ice cream. ([congélateur de crème
    glacée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[open]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[open]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a commercial
    refrigerator, commercial refrigerator-freezer or commercial freezer
    --- or a refrigerated compartment of one --- that it is not
    closed. ([type ouvert]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[pull-down temperature reduction capability]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[pull-down temperature reduction
    capability]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the capability of a
    commercial refrigerator, when it is situated in an area that has an
    ambient temperature of 32.22˚C and when it is fully loaded with 355
    mL beverage cans that are at a temperature of 32.22˚C at the time of
    loading, to cool those cans to an average stable temperature of
    3.33˚C in 12 hours or less. ([capacité d'abaisser la
    température]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[TDA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[TDA]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the total display area of a
    product, expressed in square metres. ([TDA]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[transparent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[transparent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a refrigerated compartment of a
      commercial refrigerator, commercial refrigerator-freezer or
      commercial freezer, that it is closed and has a TDA that is at
      least 75% of the geometrically projected area of the refrigerated
      space on the plane of the face with the largest access space; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a commercial refrigerator,
      commercial refrigerator-freezer or commercial freezer, that all of
      its compartments are as described in paragraph
      (a). ([transparent]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[V]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[V]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a refrigerated
    compartment of a commercial refrigerator, commercial
    refrigerator-freezer or commercial freezer, its volume, expressed in
    litres, calculated in accordance with clause 8 of CSA
    C657. ([V]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

##### [Commercial Refrigerators]{.HTitleText4} {#h-837329 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[637]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-637 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  commercial refrigerator is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a commercial refrigerator is not considered
  to be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is self-contained and manufactured on or after
      April 1, 2007, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is remote-condensing and manufactured on or
      after January 1, 2012; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 638, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is self-contained, closed and was manufactured
      on or after April 1, 2007 and before January 1, 2012, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2012.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 68](#1045156-1127342){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045156-1127342.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-637-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 637"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[638]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-638 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to commercial refrigerators described in column 1 that
  are manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A commercial refrigerator complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 that are applicable to a [[commercial
  refrigerator]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 636.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[639]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-639 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a commercial
  refrigerator:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its E~daily~;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for each of its compartments,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its equipment class designation and its TDA or V,
      as applicable, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is tested at its lowest temperature
      setting, the integrated average temperature, expressed in degrees
      Celsius, at the lowest temperature setting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standards

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with
  one of the following standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} CSA C657, Test Procedure A, if the product was
    manufactured before March 27, 2017; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA C657, Test Procedure B, if the product is
    manufactured on or after March 27, 2017.

##### [Commercial Refrigerator-Freezers]{.HTitleText4} {#h-837356 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[640]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-640 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  commercial refrigerator-freezer is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a commercial refrigerator-freezer is not
  considered to be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is self-contained, is closed and is
      manufactured on or after April 1, 2007,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is self-contained, is open and is
      manufactured on or after January 1, 2012, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} it is remote-condensing and is manufactured on
      or after January 1, 2012; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 641, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is self-contained, is closed, is not
      transparent and is manufactured on or after April 1, 2007,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is self-contained, is open or transparent and
      is manufactured on or after January 1, 2012, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} it is remote-condensing and is manufactured on
      or after January 1, 2012.

  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out

  refrigerator-freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section

##### [Commercial Freezers]{.HTitleText4} {#h-837387 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[643]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-643 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  commercial freezer is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a commercial freezer is not considered to be
  an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is self-contained and manufactured on or after
      April 1, 2007, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is remote-condensing and is manufactured on
      or after January 1, 2012; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 644, unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it is self-contained, closed and was manufactured
      on or after April 1, 2007 and before January 1, 2012, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2012.

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[644]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-644 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to commercial freezers described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A commercial freezer complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 that are applicable to a [[commercial
  freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 636.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[645]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-645 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a commercial freezer:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its E~daily~; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for each of its compartments,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its equipment class designation and its TDA or V,
      as applicable, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is tested at its lowest temperature
      setting, the integrated average temperature, expressed in degrees
      Celsius, at the lowest temperature setting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standards

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with
  one of the following standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} CSA C657, Test Procedure A, if the product was
    manufactured before March 27, 2017; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} CSA C657, Test Procedure B, if the product is
    manufactured on or after March 27, 2017.

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Refrigerated Vending Machines]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837414 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[646]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-646 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[ASHRAE 32.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ASHRAE 32.1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ASHRAE standard
    32.1-2010 entitled Methods of Testing for Rating Vending Machines
    for Bottled, Canned, and Other Sealed Beverages. ([ASHRAE
    32.1]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[combination vending machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[combination vending machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    refrigerated beverage vending machine containing two or more
    compartments separated by a solid partition --- whether or not they
    share a product delivery chute --- in which at least one compartment
    is designed to be refrigerated and has temperature controls; and at
    least one compartment is not designed to be refrigerated and does
    not contain temperature controls. ([distributeur automatique
    mixte)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C804]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C804]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C804:18 entitled Energy performance of refrigerated bottled
    or canned beverage vending machines. ([CSA C804]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[refrigerated beverage vending machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[refrigerated beverage vending machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
    a self-contained product that is designed to accept consumer
    payments and dispense refrigerated beverages in bottles, cans or
    other sealed containers. ([distributeur automatique de boissons
    réfrigérées]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[snack and refrigerated beverage vending machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[snack and refrigerated beverage vending
    machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a self-contained product that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is designed to accept consumer payments and
      dispense packages of solid non-refrigerated food and bottled,
      canned or other sealed refrigerated beverages; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a vendible capacity of not more than 100 of
      those beverages. ([distributeur automatique de boissons
      réfrigérées et de collations]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[standby mode]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a mode into which the
    product automatically enters during a period of extended inactivity
    that is capable of reducing its energy consumption by means of the
    following power states:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a refrigeration power state in which the average
      temperature of the refrigerated beverages is allowed to rise to
      4.4°C; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the product is equipped with lights,

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a lighting power state in which the lights are
        turned off, and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a machine power state in which the power
        states referred in paragraph (a) and subparagraph (i) are in
        operation at the same time. ([mode veille]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

[[V]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[V]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a refrigerated
    beverage vending machine, its volume, expressed in litres,
    calculated in accordance with Appendix C to ASHRAE
    32.1. ([V]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

##### [Refrigerated Beverage Vending Machines]{.HTitleText4} {#h-837428 .Subheading}

**[[646.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-646.1 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
these Regulations, the class of a refrigerated beverage vending machine
is one of the following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} Class A, if it is not a combination vending machine
  and 25% or more of the surface area on the front side of the
  refrigerated beverage vending machine is transparent;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} Class B, if it is not a combination vending machine
  and less than 25% of the surface area on the front side of the
  refrigerated beverage vending machine is transparent;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} Combination A, if it is a combination vending machine
  and 25% or more of the surface area on its front side is transparent;
  and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} Combination B, if it is a combination vending machine
  and less than 25% of the surface area on its front side is
  transparent.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 45](#1135987-1213997){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135987-1213997.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[647]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-647 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  refrigerated beverage vending machine is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 648, a
  refrigerated beverage vending machine is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after January 1,
  2007.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[648]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-648 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to refrigerated beverage vending machines described in
  column 1 that are manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The refrigerated beverage vending machine complies
  with the energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard in the
  following circumstances:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subject to paragraph (b), it is manufactured before
    January 8, 2019 and tested in accordance with testing procedures
    established by sections 1 to 7.2 of ASHRAE 32.1 that are applicable
    to a [[refrigerated beverage vending machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
    as defined in section 646, except that the ambient temperature
    during the testing to determine E~daily~ must be 23.9°C ± 1°C;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured before August 31, 2012, is
    designed to display and dispense less than 20 discrete types of
    beverages and is tested in accordance with testing procedures
    established by sections 1 to 7.2 of ASHRAE 32.1 that are applicable
    to a [[refrigerated beverage vending machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
    as defined in section 646, except that the ambient temperature
    during the testing to determine the E~daily~ must be 32.2°C ± 1°C;
    or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured on or after January 8, 2019 and
    tested in accordance with testing procedures established by CSA
    C804.

##### [Snack and Refrigerated Beverage Vending Machines]{.HTitleText4} {#h-837453 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[650]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-650 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  snack and refrigerated beverage vending machine is prescribed as an
  energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 651, a
  snack and refrigerated beverage vending machine is not considered to
  be an energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after
  January 1, 2007 and before January 8, 2019.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 48](#1135996-1214028){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1135996-1214028.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-650-20170628.html "Link to previous version of section 650"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[651]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-651 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  following energy efficiency standards apply to a snack and
  refrigerated beverage vending machine:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its E~daily~ must be less than or equal to 55%
    (8.66 + 0.009 × vendible capacity); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it must be capable of operating in standby mode.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A snack and refrigerated beverage vending machine
  complies with the energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard
  when tested in accordance with testing procedures established by
  sections 1 to 7.2 of ASHRAE 32.1 that are applicable to a [[snack and
  refrigerated beverage vending machine]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 646, except that the ambient temperature during the
  testing to determine E~daily~ must be 23.9°C ± 1°C.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[652]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-652 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with ASHRAE 32.1, with the testing procedures adjusted in
accordance with subsection 651(2), and be provided to the Minister in
respect of a snack and refrigerated beverage vending machine:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its E~daily~; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its vendible capacity.

#### [SUBDIVISION C]{.HLabel3}[Ice-Makers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-837470 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[653]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-653 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C742-08]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C742-08]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C742-08 entitled Energy Performance of Automatic Icemakers
    and Ice Storage Bins. ([CSA C742-08]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C742-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C742-15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C742-15 entitled Energy Performance of Automatic Icemakers
    and Ice Storage Bins. ([CSA C742-15]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C742-98]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C742-98]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C742-98 entitled Performance of Automatic Ice-Makers and Ice
    Storage Bins. ([CSA C742-98]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[ice-maker]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[ice-maker]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a factory-assembled
    automatic ice-maker that has a capacity of at least 23 kg/day (51
    pounds per day) but not more than 1 814 kg/day (4,000 pounds per
    day) and that produces cubed, flaked, crushed or fragmented ice in
    either a batch or a continuous process. ([machine à
    glaçons]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §431.134]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §431.134]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means section 431.134 of
    Subpart H, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, as amended from time to time. ([10 C.F.R.
    §431.134]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[654]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-654 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  ice-maker is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 655,
  an ice-maker is not considered to be an energy-using product unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured on or after December 31, 1998
    and before January 28, 2018 and has a capacity of not more than 1
    000 kg/day (2,200 pounds per day); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is manufactured on or after January 28, 2018 and
    has a capacity of not more than 1 814 kg/day (4,000 pounds per day).

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[655]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-655 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to ice-makers described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An ice-maker complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets that standard when tested in accordance with
  testing procedures established by the standard set out in column 2
  that are applicable to an [[ice-maker]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
  defined in section 653.

#### [SUBDIVISION D]{.HLabel3}[Walk-in Freezer and Walk-in Cooler Components]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1127935 .Subheading}

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1127490 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[657]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-657 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[A~dd~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[A~dd~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} represents, with respect to display
    door assemblies, the surface area in m^2^ (square
    feet). ([A~pp~]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[A~nd~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[A~nd~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} represents, with respect to a door
    assembly other than a display door assembly, the surface area in
    m^2^ (square feet). ([A~pa~]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[annual walk-in energy factor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[annual walk-in energy factor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ratio
    of total heat removed from an enclosed space, excluding heat
    generated by the operation of the walk-in refrigeration system, to
    the total energy input of the walk-in refrigeration system during a
    one-year period, expressed in watt-hours per watt-hours. ([facteur
    énergétique annuel de la chambre froide]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[dedicated condensing refrigeration system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dedicated condensing refrigeration
    system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a dedicated condensing unit, a
    single-package dedicated system or a matched refrigeration
    system. ([unité de condensation dédié]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}) 

[[dedicated condensing unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dedicated condensing unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a positive
    displacement condensing unit that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has one or more compressors, a condenser and one
      refrigeration circuit; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is designed to serve one refrigerated
      load. ([unité de condensation dédiée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2019-163, s. 49\]]{.Repealed}

[[display door assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[display door assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a walk-in door
    assembly that is designed for product display and that has 75% or
    more of its surface area composed of glass or other transparent
    material. ([assemblage de porte de présentation]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[envelope]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[envelope]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the portion of a walk-in cooler or walk-in
      freezer that isolates the interior, refrigerated environment from
      the ambient, external environment; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all energy-consuming components of the walk-in
      cooler or walk-in freezer that are not part of its refrigeration
      system. ([enveloppe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[floor panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[floor panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a walk-in panel that is
    installed, or designed to be installed, as the floor of a walk-in
    freezer. ([panneau de plancher]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[freight door assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[freight door assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a walk-in door
    assembly, other than a display door assembly, that is 1.22 m (4
    feet) or more in width and 2.44 m (8 feet) or more in
    height. ([assemblage de porte de quai de
    chargement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[matched refrigeration system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[matched refrigeration system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    refrigeration system that includes a dedicated condensing unit and
    one or more unit coolers with which it is sold. ([système de
    réfrigération apparié]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Net Refrigeration Capacity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Net Refrigeration Capacity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
    [[(q~net~)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} is the net refrigeration capacity
    available for space and product cooling. ([puissance frigorifique
    nette]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [q~net~]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[passage door assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[passage door assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a walk-in door
    assembly that is not a display door assembly or a freight door
    assembly. ([assemblage de porte de passage]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[RSI-value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[RSI-value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a walk-in
    panel and a walk-in door assembly, its thermal resistance, in square
    metre kelvins per watt (m²·K/W). ([valeur-RSI]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[R-value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[R-value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a walk-in panel
    and a walk-in door assembly, its thermal resistance, expressed in
    square foot Fahrenheit per Btu/h
    (ft^2^·°F·h/Btu). ([valeur-R]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[single-package dedicated system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[single-package dedicated system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    single-package refrigeration system that has

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one or more compressors, one condenser and a
      means of forced circulation of refrigerated air; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} components by which heat is transferred from air
      to refrigerant without any components that are external to the
      system imposing resistance to the flow of the refrigerated
      air. ([système dédié monobloc]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[structural panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[structural panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a walk-in panel that
    is installed, or is designed to be installed, as the ceiling or a
    wall of a walk-in cooler or walk-in freezer. ([panneau de
    structure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix A to
    Subpart R, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for the Measurement of
    Energy Consumption of the Components of Envelopes of Walk-In Coolers
    and Walk-In Freezers, as amended from time to time. ([appendice A 10
    C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix B to
    Subpart R, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for the Measurement of
    R-Value for Envelope Components of Walk-In Coolers and Walk-In
    Freezers, as amended from time to time. ([appendice B 10
    C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix C]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix C]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix C to
    Subpart R, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for the Measurement of Net
    Capacity and AWEF of Walk-In Cooler and Walk-In Freezer
    Refrigeration Systems, as amended from time to time. ([appendice C
    10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §431.304]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §431.304]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means section 431.304 of
    Subpart R, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, as amended from time to time. ([10 C.F.R.
    §431.304]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[unit cooler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[unit cooler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an assembly that includes
    a means for forced air circulation and elements by which heat is
    transferred from air to refrigerant without any element external to
    the cooler imposing air resistance. ([refroidisseur
    d'air]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[walk-in cooler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[walk-in cooler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an enclosed storage
    space that has an area of less than 278.71 m^2^ (3,000 square feet)
    and is designed to be cooled to temperatures at or above 0°C and to
    allow a person to enter, but does not include a walk-in cooler that
    is designed and marketed exclusively for medical, scientific or
    research purposes. ([réfrigérateur-chambre]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[walk-in door assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[walk-in door assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an assembly that
    is installed, or is designed to be installed, in an opening of an
    interior or exterior wall of a walk-in cooler or walk-in freezer in
    order to allow access through the opening or to close it off and
    that consists of the framing material necessary for its attachment
    and a moveable door panel, including any glass, door plugs or
    mullions, but does not include a walk-in door assembly that is
    designed and marketed exclusively for medical, scientific or
    research purposes. ([assemblage de porte de chambre
    froide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[walk-in freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[walk-in freezer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an enclosed storage
    space that has an area of less than 278.71 m^2^ (3000 square feet)
    and is designed to be cooled to temperatures below 0°C and to allow
    a person to enter, but does not include a walk-in freezer that is
    designed and marketed exclusively for medical, scientific or
    research purposes. ([congélateur-chambre]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[walk-in panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[walk-in panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a panel that is
    installed, or is designed to be installed, as part of the envelope
    of a walk-in cooler or walk-in freezer, but does not include a
    walk-in door assembly or a walk-in panel that is designed and
    marketed exclusively for medical, scientific or research
    purposes. ([panneau de chambre froide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[walk-in process cooling refrigeration system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[walk-in process cooling refrigeration
    system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a refrigeration system that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is sold as a set with an insulated enclosure and,
      when assembled with the enclosure, has a cooling capacity of at
      least 1.035 kW/m^3^ (100 Btu/h/ft^3^) of enclosed internal volume;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is a unit cooler --- or a dedicated condensing
      unit exclusively sold as a set that has a dedicated condensing
      unit and a unit cooler --- that has an evaporator coil with a
      means of forced air circulation and a height that is

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at least 1.37 metres (4.5 feet), as measured
        perpendicular to the tubes, and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} at least one and a half times the width, as
        measured parallel to the tubes; or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is sold as a set that has a dedicated condensing
      unit and an evaporator coil that does not have a means of forced
      air circulation. ([système de réfrigération de type chambre pour
      refroidissement industriel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[walk-in refrigeration system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[walk-in refrigeration system]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    refrigeration system that is installed, or that is designed to be
    installed, in a walk-in cooler or walk-in freezer and has a unit
    cooler or a dedicated condensing refrigeration system. It includes
    all controls and other components that are integral to its operation
    but does not include a walk-in process cooling refrigeration system
    or a walk-in refrigeration system that is designed and marketed
    exclusively for medical, scientific or research purposes. ([système
    de réfrigération de chambre froide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

##### [Nameplate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1128006 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Nameplate required

- **[[658]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-658
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every walk-in door assembly and
  walk-in panel that is manufactured on or after June 26, 2017 must be
  labelled with a nameplate that is attached to the outside of the
  product in a location that is readily visible prior to assembly of the
  walk-in cooler or walk-in freezer and that sets out the following
  information in English and French:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the brand name or manufacturer of the product; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement indicating whether the product is
    intended for use in a walk-in cooler, walk-in freezer or both.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional requirements

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every walk-in cooler dedicated condensing
  refrigeration system that is manufactured on or after January 1, 2020
  and every walk-in refrigeration system that is manufactured on or
  after July 10, 2020 must be labelled with a nameplate that is attached
  to the outside of the product in a location that is readily visible
  prior to assembly of the walk-in cooler or the walk-in freezer and
  that sets out the following information in English and French:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the brand name or manufacturer of the product;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement indicating whether the product is
    intended for use in a walk-in cooler, walk-in freezer or both;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the model number;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the product's date of manufacture, if it is not
    included in the model number; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a statement indicating that the product is for
    indoor use only, if applicable.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For matched refrigeration systems, the statement
  referred to in paragraph (2)(e) must appear on the dedicated
  condensing unit.

##### [Walk-in Door Assemblies]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1128013 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[659]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-659 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  walk-in door assembly is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 660, a
  walk-in door assembly is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after June 5, 2017.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 76](#1045207-1128020){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045207-1128020.html"}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[660]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-660 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to walk-in door assemblies described in column 1 that
  are manufactured on or after June 5, 2017.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A walk-in door assembly complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard set out
  in column 2 that are applicable to a [[walk-in door
  assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 657.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[661]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-661 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with 10 C.F.R. §431.304 and provided to the Minister in
respect of a walk-in door assembly:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its E~daily~;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether it is a display
  door assembly, freight door assembly or passage door assembly;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether it is for use with
  a walk-in cooler or walk-in freezer; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the product is a freight door assembly or passage
  door assembly, its RSI-value (R-value).

##### [Walk-in Panels]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1128042 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[662]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-662 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A

##### [Walk-in Refrigeration Systems]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1128070 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[665]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-665 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  walk-in refrigeration system is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a walk-in refrigeration system is not
  considered to be an energy-using product for the purposes of sections
  4, 5 and 666 unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is a walk-in cooler dedicated condensing
    refrigeration system manufactured on or after January 1, 2020;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is a walk-in freezer dedicated condensing
    refrigeration system manufactured on or after July 10, 2020; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} it is a walk-in cooler or walk-in freezer unit
    cooler manufactured on or after July 10, 2020.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[666]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-666 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to walk-in refrigeration systems described in column 1
  that are manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A walk-in refrigeration system complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. Appendix C
  that are applicable to a [[walk-in refrigeration
  system]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 657.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[667]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-667 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be collected
in accordance with 10 C.F.R. Appendix C and provided to the Minister in
respect of a walk-in refrigeration system:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its annual walk-in energy factor;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates whether it is designed and
  marketed for use indoors, outdoors or both;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates if it is for use in a
  walk-in cooler or walk-in freezer;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates if it has a unit cooler or
  a dedicated condensing refrigeration system; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} if it is a walk-in freezer unit cooler or dedicated
  condensing refrigeration system, its net refrigeration capacity
  expressed in watts.

::: HistoricalNote
