**\[668 to 702 reserved\]**

### [DIVISION 11]{.HLabel2}[Dry-type Transformers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-837504 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[703]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-703 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[CSA C802.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C802.2]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C802.2-00 entitled Minimum Efficiency Values for Dry-Type
    Transformers. ([CSA C802.2]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[CSA C802.2-12]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C802.2-12]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard
    CAN/CSA-C802.2-12 entitled Minimum efficiency values for dry-type
    transformers. ([CSA C802.2-12]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[dry-type transformer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dry-type transformer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a transformer
    whose core and windings are in a gaseous or dry compound insulating
    medium and that is either single-phase with a nominal power of 15 to
    833 kVA or three-phase with a nominal power of 15 to 7 500 kVA, has
    a nominal frequency of 60 Hz and has a high voltage winding of 35 kV
    or less. It does not include any of the following:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an autotransformer;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a drive (isolation) transformer that has two or
      more output windings or a nominal low-voltage line current of more
      than 1 500 A;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a grounding transformer;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a rectifier transformer;

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a sealed transformer;

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a non-ventilated transformer;

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a testing transformer;

    - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a furnace transformer;

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a welding transformer;

    - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a special impedance transformer;

    - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a transformer that has a nominal low-voltage line
      current of 4 000 A or more;

    - [(l)]{.lawlabel} an on-load regulating transformer;

    - [(m)]{.lawlabel} a resistance grounding transformer; or

    - [(n)]{.lawlabel} a transformer that is in a voltage class greater
      than 1.2 kV and that has a BIL of less than 20 kV or more than 199
      kV. ([transformateur à sec]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix A to
    Subpart K, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for Measuring the Energy
    Consumption of Distribution Transformers, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice A 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[transformer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[transformer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a static-electric device
    that consists of two or more coils of insulated wire, together with
    the necessary accessories, and that transfers alternating current by
    electromagnetic induction from one coil to another to change the
    original voltage. ([transformateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[704]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-704 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  dry-type transformer is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a dry-type transformer is not considered to
  be an energy-using product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, if it was
    manufactured before January 1, 2005; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of section 705, if it has a BIL of
    more than 150 kV and was manufactured before January 1, 2010.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards ---
manufactured before January 1, 2016

- **[[705]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-705 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  respect of dry-type transformers that were manufactured on or after
  January 1, 2005 and before January 1, 2016, the energy efficiency
  standards set out in column 2 of the table to this section apply to
  dry-type transformers that were manufactured during the periods set
  out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A dry-type transformer complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by the standard
  referred to in column 1 that are applicable to a [[dry-type
  transformer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 703.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard ---
single-phase and 1.2 kV voltage class

- **[[705.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-705.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In respect of dry-type transformers
  that are single-phase, in the 1.2 kV voltage class and manufactured on
  or after January 1, 2016, the energy efficiency standards set out in
  column 2 of Table 1 to this section apply to dry-type transformers
  that have a kVA rating described in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards ---
  single-phase and voltage class greater than 1.2 kV

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In respect of dry-type transformers that are
  single-phase, in a voltage class greater than 1.2 kV and manufactured
  on or after January 1, 2016, the energy efficiency standards that are
  set out in relation to the product's BIL rating set out in column 2 of
  Table 2 to this section apply to dry-type transformers that have a kVA
  rating set out in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interpolation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (1) and (2), if the
  kVA rating of the product falls between the kVA ratings set out in two
  consecutive items in column 1 of the applicable table to this section,
  the energy efficiency standard for the product is an interpolation of
  the corresponding energy efficiency standards set out in column 2.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A dry-type transformer complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. Appendix A
  that are applicable to a [[dry-type
  transformer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 703.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards ---
three-phase and 1.2 kV voltage class

- **[[705.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-705.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In respect of dry-type transformers
  that are three-phase, in the 1.2 kV voltage class and manufactured on
  or after January 1, 2016, the energy efficiency standards set out
  column 2 of Table 1 to this section apply to dry-type transformers
  that have a kVA rating set out in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards ---
  three-phase and voltage class greater than 1.2 kV

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In respect of dry-type transformers that are
  three-phase, in a voltage class greater than 1.2 kV and manufactured
  on or after January 1, 2016, the energy efficiency standards that are
  set out in relation to the product's BIL rating set out in column 2 of
  Table 2 to this section apply to dry-type transformers that have a kVA
  rating set out in column 1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interpolation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (1) and (2), if the
  kVA rating of the product falls between the kVA ratings set out in two
  consecutive items in column 1 of the applicable table to this section,
  the energy efficiency standard for the product is an interpolation of
  the corresponding energy efficiency standards set out in column 2.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reduced energy efficiency standard

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency standard that is applicable to
  a dry-type transformer under this section is reduced by 0.11 if the
  transformer has multiple high-voltage windings and a voltage ratio
  other than 2:1.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A dry-type transformer complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. Appendix A
  that are applicable to a [[dry-type
  transformer]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 703.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[706]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-706 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a dry-type transformer:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, information that indicates whether
    the transformer is in the 1.2 kV voltage class;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its BIL rating;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, information that indicates whether
    the transformer is a three-phase transformer that has multiple
    high-voltage windings and a voltage ratio other than 2:1;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} its kVA rating;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} its phase --- namely, single-phase or three-phase;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the tested efficiency, expressed as a percentage;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the loss, expressed in watts, when it is under load
    and when it is not under load; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} if it is manufactured on or after January 1, 2010,
    the impedance, expressed as a percentage.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with
  one of the following standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} CSA C802.2-12, if the product was manufactured on
    or after January 1, 2005 and before January 1, 2016; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 10 C.F.R. Appendix A, if the product is
    manufactured on or after January 1, 2016.

**\[707 to 747 reserved\]SOR/2022-265, s. 40**

### [DIVISION 12]{.HLabel2}[Motors]{.HTitleText2} {#h-837554 .Subheading}

#### [Definitions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1406694 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[748]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-748 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[CSA C390-10]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C390-10]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CSA
    C390-10 entitled Test methods, marking requirements, and energy
    efficiency levels for three-phase induction motors. ([CSA
    C390-10]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IEC 60034-2-1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IEC 60034-2-1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IEC standard CEI/IEC
    60034-2-1 entitled Rotating electrical machines -- Part 2-1:
    Standard methods for determining losses and efficiency from tests
    (excluding machines for traction vehicles), as amended from time to
    time. ([CEI 60034-2-1]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IEEE 112]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IEEE 112]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IEEE standard IEEE 112
    entitled Standard Test Procedure for Polyphase Induction Motors and
    Generators, as amended from time to time. ([IEEE
    112]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-265, s. 41](#1382122-1406701){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1382122-1406701.html"}
:::

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Electric Motors]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1127931 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[749]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-749 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C390-10]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C390-10]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2022-265, s.
    42\]]{.Repealed}

[[electric motor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[electric motor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a machine that converts
    electrical power into rotational mechanical power and that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is an electric three-phase induction design;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is one of the following designs:

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a NEMA design A, B or C with a three- or
        four-digit NEMA frame number,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an enclosed NEMA design A, B or C with a NEMA
        frame number of 56, or

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an IEC design N or H with an IEC frame number
        of 80 or above;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal output power of not less than 0.75
      kW (1 horsepower) and not more than 375 kW (500 horsepower);

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has a cage or squirrel-cage design;

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} is rated for continuous duty or S1 operation;

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} is designed to operate at a single speed;

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal voltage of not more than 600 V AC;

    - [(h)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal frequency of 50 Hz, 50/60 Hz or 60
      Hz;

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has a two-, four-, six- or eight-pole
      construction;

    - [(j)]{.lawlabel} has an open or enclosed construction; and

    - [(k)]{.lawlabel} has an IP code from 00 to 67.

    It does not include any of the following:

    - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a motor that is cooled by air that is forced over
      the motor by a fan or blower that is not an integral part of the
      motor;

    - [(m)]{.lawlabel} a liquid-cooled motor;

    - [(n)]{.lawlabel} an inverter-only motor; or

    - [(o)]{.lawlabel} a motor that is designed to operate continuously
      only while immersed. ([moteur électrique]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[explosion-proof motor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[explosion-proof motor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an electric
    motor

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of which measures have been taken to
      prevent excessive temperatures and the production of arcs or
      sparks by the motor; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is encased in an enclosure that can
      withstand the explosion of any flammable gas or vapour that might
      enter it, without being damaged and without transmitting the
      explosion to the outside. ([moteur
      antidéflagrant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[footless]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[footless]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of an electric
    motor, that it does not have feet or detachable feet or that it is
    not designed to receive detachable feet. ([sans
    pieds]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IEC 60034-5]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IEC 60034-5]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IEC standard CEI/IEC
    60034-5: 2006 entitled Rotating electrical machines - Part 5:
    Degrees of protection provided by the integral design of rotating
    electric machines (IP code) - Classification. ([CEI
    60034-5]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IEC 60529]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IEC 60529]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IEC standard CEI/IEC
    60529: 2013 entitled Degrees of Protection Provided by Enclosures
    (IP Code). ([CEI 60529]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IEEE 112-2004]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IEEE 112-2004]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2022-265, s.
    42\]]{.Repealed}

[[integral gear assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[integral gear assembly]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a product that
    consists of an electric motor and a gear mechanism that are combined
    in such a manner that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the end bracket or mounting flange forms an
      integral part of both the motor and the gear mechanism; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the motor and the gear mechanism are
      separated, only one of them remains intact. ([assemblage
      d'engrenages intégrés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IP code]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IP code]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the classification of the
    degree of protection provided by an enclosure, as set out in IEC
    60034-5, IEC 60529 or NEMA MG-1. ([code IP]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[NEMA MG-1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[NEMA MG-1]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the NEMA standard MG 1
    entitled NEMA MG 1 Motors and Generators. ([NEMA
    MG-1]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[750]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-750 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An
  electric motor is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5, 751 and
  752, an electric motor is not considered to be an energy-using product
  if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before February 3, 1995;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before November 27, 1999 and is
    an explosion-proof motor or is part of an integral gear assembly;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before January 1, 2011 and it

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has an eight-pole construction,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} has NEMA U frame dimensions,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} is a NEMA design C or an IEC design H,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} is a close-coupled pump motor,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} is a vertically mounted solid shaft normal thrust
      motor,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} is a fire-pump motor or other NEMA design B
      motor with a nominal output power of more than 150 kW (200
      horsepower) or is an IEC design N motor with a nominal output
      power of more than 150 kW (200 horsepower), or

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} is footless;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before June 1, 2016 and it

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is a NEMA design A with a nominal output power of
      more than 150 kW (200 horsepower),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is an enclosed NEMA design with a NEMA frame
      number of 56,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} has NEMA frame dimensions other than T or U,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} has an IEC frame number of 80 or more but less
      than 90,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} is a partial electric motor, a brake motor or a
      vertical hollow shaft motor,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} is designed to operate continuously in free air,
      but can operate continuously for a period of at least 30 minutes
      while completely immersed,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} has a separately powered blower,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} has a base, end shields or flanges that are
      not within the dimensions specified in NEMA MG-1, or

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} has a NEMA shaft that is not a standard shaft,
      R-shaft or S-shaft, as specified in NEMA MG-1; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} it was manufactured before June 1, 2017 and is a
    medical-imaging motor.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[751]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-751 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 3 of the table to this
  section apply to electric motors described in column 1 that are
  manufactured during the periods set out in column 4.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An electric motor complies with the energy efficiency
  standard if it meets the standard when tested at 100% of its nominal
  full load in accordance with testing procedures established by the
  standard set out in column 2 that are applicable to an [[electric
  motor]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 749.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[752]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-752 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be provided
to the Minister in respect of an electric motor:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an electric motor for which a unique
  motor identifier was not provided under paragraph 5(1)(c),

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its nominal output power, expressed in kilowatts
    (horsepower),

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the number of poles, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its construction --- namely, open construction or
    enclosed construction; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an electric motor described in column 1
  of the table to this section, the information set out in column 3,
  which must be collected in accordance with the standard set out in
  column 2.

#### [SUBDIVISION B]{.HLabel3}[Small Electric Motors]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1127823 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[753]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-753 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Subdivision.

[[CSA C747-09]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[CSA C747-09]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CSA standard CSA
    C747-09 entitled Energy efficiency test methods for small
    motors. ([CSA C747-09]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[IEEE 114-2010]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[IEEE 114-2010]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the IEEE standard IEEE
    114-2010 entitled IEEE Standard Test Procedure for Single-Phase
    Induction Motors. ([IEEE 114-2010]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[small electric motor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[small electric motor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a machine that
    converts electrical power into rotational mechanical power and that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal output power of not less than 0.18
      kW (0.25 horsepower) and not more than 2.2 kW (3 horsepower);

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is a NEMA design with a two-digit frame number or
      an IEC design with a frame number of 63 or 71;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal frequency of 50/60 Hz or 60 Hz;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has a two-, four- or six-pole construction;

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} operates using alternating current;

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} is one of the following types, namely,
      capacitor-start capacitor-run, capacitor-start induction-run or
      polyphase;

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} has an open construction;

    - [(h)]{.lawlabel} is rated for continuous duty or S1 operation;

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is designed to operate at a single speed; and

    - [(j)]{.lawlabel} is designed as a general purpose motor.

    It does not include a split-phase motor, shaded pole motor or
    permanent split-capacitor motor. ([petit moteur
    électrique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §431.446]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §431.446]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means section 431.446 of
    Subpart X, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, as amended from time to time. ([10 C.F.R.
    §431.446]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 80](#1045231-1127861){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045231-1127861.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[754]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-754 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  small electric motor is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 755, a
  small electric motor is not considered to be an energy-using product
  if it was manufactured before March 9, 2015 or it is incorporated into
  any other product that is subject to these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 80](#1045231-1127868){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045231-1127868.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[755]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-755 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in the applicable table in
  paragraph (a) of 10 C.F.R. §431.446 apply to a small motor.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A small electric motor complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the product's average full load efficiency is
    determined using horsepower and kilowatt ratings that are determined
    in accordance with paragraph (b) of 10 C.F.R. §431.446;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the product is tested at 100% of its nominal full
    load; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the product is tested in accordance with testing
    procedures established by one of the following standards that are
    applicable to a [[small electric motor]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
    defined in section 753:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the motor is polyphase and has a nominal
      output power ≥ 0.18 kW (0.25 horsepower) but ≤ 0.75 kW (1
      horsepower), CSA C747-09, IEEE 112 (Test Method A) or IEC
      60034-2-1 (Test Method 2-1-1A),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the motor is polyphase and has a nominal
      output power \> 0.75 kW (1 horsepower) but ≤ 2.2 kW (3
      horsepower), CSA C390-10, IEEE 112 (Test Method B) or IEC
      60034-2-1 (Test Method 2-1-1B), or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if the motor is capacitor-start capacitor-run
      or capacitor-start induction-run, CSA C747-09, IEEE 114-2010 or
      IEC 60034-2-1 (Test Method 2-1-1A).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 80](#1045231-1127881){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045231-1127881.html"}
- [SOR/2022-265, s. 45](#1382135-1406715){.wb-lbx

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

- **[[756]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-756 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For
  the purpose of subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information
  must be provided to the Minister in respect of a small electric motor:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} its average full load efficiency;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its type, namely, capacitor-start capacitor-run,
    capacitor-start induction-run or polyphase; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the motor is one for which a unique motor
    identifier has not been provided under paragraph 5(1)(c), its
    nominal output power expressed in kilowatts (horsepower) and the
    number of poles.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information must be collected in accordance with
  one of the following standards:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the motor is polyphase and has a nominal output
    power ≥ 0.18 kW (0.25 horsepower) but ≤ 0.75 kW (1 horsepower),
    CSA C747-09, IEEE 112 (Test Method A) or IEC 60034-2-1 (Test Method
    2-1-1A);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the motor is polyphase and has a nominal output
    power \> 0.75 kW (1 horsepower) but ≤ 2.2 kW (3 horsepower),
    CSA C390-10, IEEE 112 (Test Method B) or IEC 60034-2-1 (Test Method
    2-1-1B); or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the motor is capacitor-start capacitor-run or
    capacitor-start induction-run, CSA C747-09, IEEE 114-2010 or
    IEC 60034-2-1 (Test Method 2-1-1A).

### [DIVISION 13]{.HLabel2}[Commercial Pre-Rinse Spray Valves]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1127897 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[800]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-800 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[commercial pre-rinse spray valve]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[commercial pre-rinse spray valve]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    handheld device for spraying water on food service items, that has a
    release-to-close valve and is designed and marketed to be used in
    conjunction with commercial dishwashing or commercial ware washing
    equipment. ([pulvérisateur de prérinçage
    commercial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §431.264]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §431.264]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the test method set
    out in section 431.264 of Subpart O, Part 431 of Title 10 to the
    United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §431.264]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §431.266]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §431.266]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table to
    paragraph 431.266(b) of Subpart O, Part 431 of Title 10 to the
    United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §431.266]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 80](#1045231-1127904){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045231-1127904.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[801]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-801 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  commercial pre-rinse spray valve is prescribed as an energy-using
  product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 802, a
  commercial pre-rinse spray valve is not considered to be an
  energy-using product unless it is manufactured on or after June 27,
  2016.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2018-201, s. 80](#1045231-1127911){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1045231-1127911.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standards

- **[[802]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-802 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standards set out in column 2 of the table to this
  section apply to commercial pre-rinse spray valves described in column
  1 that are manufactured during the periods set out in column 3.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A commercial pre-rinse spray valve complies with the
  energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. §431.264
  that are applicable to a [[commercial pre-rinse spray
  valve]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section 800.

### [DIVISION 14]{.HLabel2}[Pumps]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1214082 .Subheading}

#### [SUBDIVISION A]{.HLabel3}[Clean Water Pumps]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1214103 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[804]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-804 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this subdivision.

[[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix A to
    Subpart Y, Part 431 of Title 10 to the United States Code of Federal
    Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for the Measurement of
    Energy Consumption of Pumps, as amended from time to
    time. ([appendice A 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[10 C.F.R. §431.465(b)(4)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[10 C.F.R. §431.465(b)(4)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the table to
    paragraph 431.465(b)(4) of Subpart Y, Part 431 of Title 10 to the
    United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended from time to
    time. ([10 C.F.R. §431.465(b)(4)]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[best efficiency point]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[best efficiency point]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the pump
    hydraulic power operating point that results in a maximum
    efficiency. ([point de rendement maximal]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[clean water]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[clean water]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means water that has a maximum
    non-absorbent solid content of 0.25 kg/m^3^(0.016 lb/ft^3^), a
    maximum dissolved solid content of 50 kg/m^3^ (3.1 lb/ft^3^) and a
    total gas content that does not exceed the saturation volume and
    that may include additives necessary to prevent the water from
    freezing down to -10°C (14°F). ([eau claire]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[clean water pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[clean water pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a pump -- with or
    without mechanical equipment, driver and controls, that is designed
    for pumping clean water -- other than a fire pump, a self-priming
    pump, a prime-assist pump, a magnet-driven pump, a pump designed to
    be used in a nuclear facility, a pump designed to Canadian or United
    States military specifications or a pump designed and marketed for
    use as a pool pump, that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is one of the following types:

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an end suction close-coupled pump with a
        maximum specific speed of 5000 RPM,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an end suction frame mounted pump with its own
        bearings and with a specific speed not more than 5000 RPM,

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} an in-line pump,

      - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a radially split, multi-stage, vertical,
        in-line diffuser casing pump, or

      - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a submersible turbine pump with a bowl diameter
        not greater than 152 mm (6 in),

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a shaft input power not less than 0.75 kW (1
      horsepower) and not greater than 150 kW (200 horsepower) at best
      efficiency point and full impeller diameter;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has a flow rate of 5.68 m^3^/h (25 US
      gallons/min) or greater at best efficiency point and full impeller
      diameter;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has a maximum head of 139.9 m (459 ft) at best
      efficiency point and full impeller diameter;

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} has a design temperature range that lies within
      -10 and 120°C (14 and 248°F); and

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} is designed to operate with either a 2-pole or
      4-pole induction motor or a non-induction motor with a nominal
      speed of rotation of either 1800 RPM or 3600 RPM, as determined in
      accordance with 10 C.F.R. Appendix A, and in which the driver and
      impeller rotate at the same speed. ([pompe à eau
      claire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 54](#1136016-1214143){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136016-1214143.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy-using product

- **[[805]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-805 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  clean water pump is prescribed as an energy-using product.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, for the purposes of sections 4, 5 and 806, a
  clean water pump is not considered to be an energy-using product
  unless it is manufactured on or after January 27, 2020.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 54](#1136016-1214150){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136016-1214150.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Energy efficiency standard

- **[[806]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-806 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  energy efficiency standard that applies to a clean water pump is the
  maximum pump energy index set out for the applicable equipment class
  in 10 C.F.R. §431.465(b)(4).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Testing standard

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A clean water pump complies with the energy
  efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested in
  accordance with testing procedures established by 10 C.F.R. Appendix A
  that apply to a [[clean water pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined
  in section 804.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 54](#1136016-1214157){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136016-1214157.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[807]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-807 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
subsection 5(1) of the Act, the following information must be provided
to the Minister in respect of a clean water pump:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its nominal power in kilowatts;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the impeller diameter in millimetres;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its type, namely, end suction close-coupled pump, end
  suction frame mounted with own bearings pump, in-line pump, radially
  split multi-stage, vertical, in-line diffuser casing pump or
  submersible turbine pump;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} its nominal speed of rotation collected in accordance
  with 10 C.F.R. Appendix A;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} its mode of operation, namely, constant load or
  variable load; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} its pump energy index value collected in accordance
  with 10 C.F.R. Appendix A.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-163, s. 54](#1136016-1214167){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136016-1214167.html"}
:::

## [SCHEDULE 1 / [ANNEXE 1]{.otherLang lang="fr"}]{.scheduleLabel}[(Subsection 13(1) and section 35 / [paragraphe 13(1) et article 35]{.otherLang lang="fr"})]{.OriginatingRef}[Explanation for Elements on Household Appliance Energy Efficiency Label / [Explication du contenu de l'étiquette indiquant l'efficacité énergétique des appareils domestiques]{.otherLang lang="fr"}]{.scheduleTitleText}  {#h-837647 .scheduleLabel}
:::

<figure>
<div class="imageGroupcenter">
<img src="/images/SOR-2016-311img/SOR-2016-311-ef001.jpg"
alt="The graphic depicts the form for the bilingual EnerGuide label for a household appliance and provides instructions for the information that must be on the label. Except for the EnerGuide logo, which has white text on a black background, all text on the label is black on a white background. The label displays the following information about the appliance: its annual energy consumption, its type and size category and its model number. The label also displays a horizontal scale that shows the annual energy consumption of the product, expressed in kilowatts, relative to similar models in the same size and type category. From top to bottom, the elements of the label and their associated instructions are the following: The Canada word-mark is at the top of the graphic. The EnerGuide logo is prominently displayed underneath the Canada word-mark. Below, under the heading “Energy consumption”, the value “AAA kWh per year” is prominently displayed. The instruction for this value states “Replace “AAA” with annual energy consumption of model in kilowatt hours”. Next, the label depicts a gradient scale that gradually changes from white on the left to black on the right. The value “BBB kWh” is displayed at the left endpoint of the scale, immediately above a bolded heading that states “Uses least energy”. The instruction for this value states “Replace “BBB” with value of most energy-efficient model within same type and size category.” The value “CCC kWh” is displayed at the right endpoint of the scale, immediately above a bolded heading that states “Uses most energy”. The instruction for this value states “Replace “CCC” with value of least energy-efficient model within same type and size category.” Immediately above the scale and depicted as an inverted black triangle is the energy consumption indicator which is used to mark the relative energy performance of the product at issue. The instruction for this indicator states “Position model on annual energy consumption scale relative to others within same type and size category.” Next below, at the left margin, is the heading “Similar models compared”. The values “DDD” and “EEE”, which are related to this heading, are centered on the graphic. The instruction for those values states “Replace “DDD” with applicable type, if any, and replace “EEE” with applicable size category, if any.” Next below, at the left margin, is the heading “Model number”. The value “FFF”, which is related to this heading, is centered on the graphic. The instruction for this value states “Replace “FFF” with model number.” Lastly, the graphic provides a reminder that “Removal of this label before first retail purchase is an offence (S.C. 1992, c. 36)”." />
</div>
</figure>

    :::: section

    - ###### Cooling capacity category {#cooling-capacity-category .MarginalNote}

      [110]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of these Regulations, the
      cooling capacity category of a room air conditioner is the
      applicable cooling capacity range set out in

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} Table 2 of CSA C368.1, if the product was
        manufactured before June 1, 2014;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} Table 2 to Part 2 of TSD D2SA001, if the
        product is manufactured on or after June 1, 2014 and before May
        26, 2026; and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} Table 3 to Part 2 of TSD D2SA001, if the
        product is manufactured on or after May 26, 2026.
    :::
    ::::

      is replaced by the following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText
      - ###### Early compliance {#early-compliance .MarginalNote}

        [127.1]{.lawlabel} A single package central air conditioner that
        is manufactured on or after January 1, 2025 and before January
        1, 2026 is deemed to satisfy the requirements of sections 126
        and 127 if it satisfies the requirements of those sections that
        would have applied to the single package central air conditioner
        if it had been manufactured on or after January 1, 2026.
      :::

      is replaced by the following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText
      - ###### Early compliance {#early-compliance-1 .MarginalNote}

        [135.1]{.lawlabel} A split system central air conditioner that
        is manufactured on or after January 1, 2025 and before January
        1, 2026 is deemed to satisfy the requirements of sections 134
        and 135 if it satisfies the requirements of those sections that
        would have applied to the split system central air conditioner
        if it had been manufactured on or after January 1, 2026.
      :::
      ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 25

  - [25]{.lawlabel} Subsection 145(2) of the Regulations is replaced by
    the following:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    - ###### Limit {#limit-1 .MarginalNote}

      [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, a portable air conditioner is not
      considered to be an energy-using product

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 4 and 5, unless it
        is manufactured on or after July 1, 2020; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of sections 145.1, 147 and
        148, unless it is manufactured on or after January 10, 2025.
    :::
    ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 26

  - [26]{.lawlabel} The Regulations are amended by adding the following
    after section 145:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    - ###### Energy efficiency standard {#energy-efficiency-standard .MarginalNote}

      - [145.1]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The energy efficiency
        standard applicable to a portable air conditioner is that it
        must have a CEER equal to or greater than the result determined
        by the formula

        ::: Subsection
        1.04 A ÷ (3.7117 A^0.6384^)

        where

        [A]{.dfn}
        :   is its SACC, expressed in Btu/h.
        :::

      - ###### Testing standard {#testing-standard .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} A portable air conditioner complies with the
        energy efficiency standard if it meets that standard when tested
        in accordance with the applicable testing procedures established
        by 10 C.F.R. Appendix CC.
    :::
    ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 28

  - [28]{.lawlabel} The reference "\[147 to 185 reserved\]" after
    section 146 of the Regulations is replaced by the following:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    - ###### Form of labelling {#form-of-labelling .MarginalNote}

      [147]{.lawlabel} A portable air conditioner manufactured on or
      after January 10, 2025 must be labelled in the form set out in
      Schedule 4.

    - ###### Manner of labelling {#manner-of-labelling-1 .MarginalNote}

      [148]{.lawlabel} The label must be displayed on the principal
      display panel of the product's package, either

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} by printing it on that panel; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} by affixing to the panel an adhesive tag that
        is printed on paper that meets the requirements of subsection
        14(1) and that has an adhesion capacity that is sufficient to
        prevent the tag from being dislodged from the packaging under
        normal handling conditions.

    \[149 to 185 reserved\]
    :::
    ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 33

  - [33]{.lawlabel} The definition [[single package central heat
    pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 203 of the Regulations is
    replaced by the following:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText

    [[single package central heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

    :   [[single package central heat pump]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
        single-phase or three-phase air-to-air central heat pump that is
        a single package unit and that has a cooling capacity of less
        than 19 kW (65,000 Btu/h), but does not include a single package
        vertical heat pump. ([thermopompe centrale
        monobloc]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
    :::
    ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 36(2)

  - - [36]{.lawlabel} [(2)]{.lawlabel} Section 206.1 of the Regulations
      is replaced by the following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText
      - ###### Early compliance {#early-compliance-2 .MarginalNote}

        [206.1]{.lawlabel} A single package central heat pump that is
        manufactured on or after January 1, 2025 and before January 1,
        2026 is deemed to satisfy the requirements of sections 205 and
        206 if it satisfies the requirements of those sections that
        would have applied to the single package central heat pump if it
        had been manufactured on or after January 1, 2026.
      :::
      ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 41

  - [41]{.lawlabel} Section 257 of the Regulations is amended by adding
    the following in alphabetical order:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText

    [[space-constrained]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

    :   [[space-constrained]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, with respect to a gas
        furnace, means one that

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} uses single-phase electric current; and

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has an outdoor or indoor unit

          - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that has an overall displacement that is
            --- or two or more overall exterior dimensions that are ---
            substantially smaller than those of other units of a similar
            heating capacity that are usually installed in single-family
            homes, and

          - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} with respect to which an increase in the
            overall displacement or two or more overall exterior
            dimensions would result in a considerable increase in the
            usual cost of installation or in a significant loss in the
            utility of the product to the consumer. ([à espace
            restreint]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
    :::
    ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 45

  - - [45]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The definition [[first-hour
      rating]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 369 of the Regulations
      is replaced by the following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText

      [[first-hour rating]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[first-hour rating]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of
          an electric water heater, gas-fired storage water heater or
          oil-fired water heater, the measure of the maximum volume of
          hot water that the water heater can supply within an hour that
          begins when the water in the water heater is fully
          heated. ([capacité de première heure]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})
      :::
      ::::

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} Section 369 of the Regulations is amended by
      adding the following in alphabetical order:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText

      [[10 C.F.R. Appendix E]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[10 C.F.R. Appendix E]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Appendix E
          to Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to the United States Code
          of Federal Regulations, entitled Uniform Test Method for
          Measuring the Energy Consumption of Water Heaters, as amended
          from time to time, except for sections 5.1.1 and
          5.1.2. ([appendice E 10 C.F.R.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

      [[electric water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[electric water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
          stationary electric storage tank water heater that is intended
          for use on a pressurized water system and has a V~r~ of at
          least 50 L (13.21 US gallons). ([chauffe-eau
          électrique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

      [[gas-fired instantaneous water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[gas-fired instantaneous water
          heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a flow-activated water
          heater that uses propane or natural gas for fuel, has a V~r~
          that is less than or equal to 38 L (10 US gallons) and has an
          input rate to V~r~ ratio of at least 309 W/L (4,000 Btu/h/US
          gallon). ([chauffe-eau instantané au gaz]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

      [[gas-fired storage water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[gas-fired storage water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
          stationary gas-heated water container that uses propane or
          natural gas for fuel and has a V~r~ of at least 76 L (20 US
          gallons). ([chauffe-eau à réservoir alimenté au
          gaz]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

      [[oil-fired water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[oil-fired water heater]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a water
          heater that uses oil for fuel and has a V~r~ of at least 76 L
          (20 US gallons). ([chauffe-eau à mazout]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

      [[V~eff~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[V~eff~]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the effective storage
          volume, expressed in litres, of a water heater's storage tank,
          as determined in accordance with 10 C.F.R. Appendix
          E. ([V~eff~]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
      :::
      ::::

    - [(3)]{.lawlabel} Section 369 of the Regulations is renumbered as
      subsection 369(1) and is amended by adding the following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText
      - ###### Interpretation --- draw pattern {#interpretation-draw-pattern .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this Division, a reference to

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a "very-small-usage" draw pattern is to be
          read as a reference to the draw pattern set out in Table III.1
          to section 5.5 of 10 C.F.R. Appendix E;

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a "low-usage" draw pattern is to be read as a
          reference to the draw pattern set out in Table III.2 to
          section 5.5 of 10 C.F.R. Appendix E;

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a "medium-usage" draw pattern is to be read
          as a reference to the draw pattern set out in Table III.3 to
          section 5.5 of 10 C.F.R. Appendix E; and

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a "high-usage" draw pattern is to be read as
          a reference to the draw pattern set out in Table III.4 to
          section 5.5 of 10 C.F.R. Appendix E.
      :::
      ::::

    - ###### Early compliance {#early-compliance-4 .MarginalNote}

      [373.1]{.lawlabel} An electric water heater that is manufactured
      on or after May 6, 2028 and before May 6, 2029 is deemed to
      satisfy the requirements of sections 372 and 373 if it satisfies
      the requirements of those sections that would have applied to the
      electric water heater if it had been manufactured on or after May
      6, 2029.

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 60

  - - [60]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The definitions [[ANSI
      C78.20]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[appliance
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[coloured
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[IES LM45]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef},
      [[IES LM49]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[IES
      LM65]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[incandescent reflector
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[infrared
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[modified spectrum
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[rough service
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[shatter-resistant
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[silver bowl
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[submersible
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} and [[vibration service
      lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 424 of the Regulations are
      repealed.

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} The definitions [[CIE
      13.3]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[CIE 15]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} and
      [[plant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 424 of the
      Regulations are replaced by the following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText

      [[CIE 13.3]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[CIE 13.3]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CIE standard CIE
          013.3-1995 entitled Method of Measuring and Specifying Colour
          Rendering Properties of Light Sources. ([CIE
          13.3]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

      [[CIE 15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[CIE 15]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the CIE standard CIE
          015:2004 entitled Colorimetry. ([CIE 15]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

      [[plant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[plant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is
          designed and marketed for plant growing applications and that
          emits its highest radiant power peaks in the range of 440 to
          490 nm, 620 to 740 nm or both of these ranges of the
          electromagnetic spectrum. ([lampe pour
          horticulture]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
      :::
      ::::

    - [(3)]{.lawlabel} Section 424 of the Regulations is amended by
      adding the following in alphabetical order:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText

      [[colour rendering index]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[colour rendering index]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
          measured degree of colour shift that objects undergo when they
          are illuminated by a light source as compared with the colour
          of those same objects when they are illuminated by a reference
          source of comparable colour temperature. ([indice de rendu des
          couleurs]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

      [[former Regulations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[former Regulations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means these
          Regulations as they read immediately before the day on which
          subsection 1(2) of the Regulations Amending the Energy
          Efficiency Regulations, 2016 (Amendment 18) comes into
          force. ([règlement antérieur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})
      :::
      ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 61

  - [61]{.lawlabel} Section 425 of the Regulations is replaced by the
    following:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    - ###### Label required {#label-required .MarginalNote}

      - [425]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every general service lamp
        that is manufactured on or after January 1, 2027 and that, for
        the purpose of sale or lease, is shipped from one province to
        another or imported into Canada must be labelled in accordance
        with sections 426 to 429.

      - ###### Former Regulations {#former-regulations .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} Sections 425 to 429 of the former Regulations
        continue to apply in respect of a lamp that is referred to in
        section 425 of the former Regulations that is manufactured
        before January 1, 2027.
    :::
    ::::

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 62

  - - [62]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs 426(1)(a) to (c) of
      the Regulations are replaced by the following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText
      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the words "Light output" and "[Flux
        lumineux]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", followed by the numerical
        value of the product's luminous flux and the word "lumens";

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the words "Efficacy" and
        "[Efficacité]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", followed by the numerical
        value of the product's nominal efficacy and the words
        "lumens/watt";

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the words "Power" and "[Puissance]{.otherLang
        lang="fr"}", followed by the numerical value of the product's
        nominal power consumption and the word "watts";

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the words "Life" and ["Durée de vie]{.otherLang
        lang="fr"}", followed by the numerical value of the product's
        life and the words "hours" and "[heures]{.otherLang lang="fr"}",
        respectively; and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the words "Light appearance" and "[Apparence de
        la lumière]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", followed by the numerical
        value of the product's correlated colour temperature and the
        upper case letter "K" or the word "Kelvin".
      :::
      ::::

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsections 426(2) to (5) of the Regulations are
      replaced by the following:

      :::: section
      ::: AmendedText
      - ###### Font and size {#font-and-size .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} The words "Light output", "[Flux
        lumineux]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", "Efficacy",
        "[Efficacité]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", "Power",
        "[Puissance]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", "Life", "[Durée de
        vie]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", "Light appearance" and "[Apparence
        de la lumière]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" must be in the same font
        and be equal in size.

      - ###### Font and size --- units {#font-and-size-units .MarginalNote}

        [(3)]{.lawlabel} The words "lumens", "lumens/watt", "watts",
        "hours", "[heures]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" and "Kelvin" and the
        upper case letter "K" must be in the same font and be equal in
        size, but they must not be more than 50% of the size of the
        words referred to in subsection (2).

      - ###### Font and size --- numerical values {#font-and-size-numerical-values .MarginalNote}

        [(4)]{.lawlabel} The numerical values indicating the product's
        luminous flux, efficacy, nominal power, life and correlated
        colour temperature must be in the same font and be equal in
        size.

      - ###### Three-way lamps {#three-way-lamps .MarginalNote}

        [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the product is a three-way lamp, the
        information required by paragraphs (1)(a) to (c) must be
        displayed for each level of the lamp's operation.

      - ###### Variable correlated colour temperature {#variable-correlated-colour-temperature .MarginalNote}

        [(6)]{.lawlabel} If the product has a variable correlated colour
        temperature, the information required by paragraph (1)(e) must
        be displayed for the lamp's range of operation or for each level
        of its operation.
      :::
      ::::

  - [64]{.lawlabel} The heading before section 430 and sections 430 to

- --- SOR/2025-110, s. 65

  - [65]{.lawlabel} Section 433 of the Regulations is replaced by the
    following:

    :::: section
    ::: AmendedText
    - ###### Definitions {#definitions .MarginalNote}

      - [433]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions
        apply in this Subdivision.

        [[10 C.F.R. §430.23(gg)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[10 C.F.R. §430.23(gg)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
            paragraph 430.23(gg) of Subpart B, Part 430 of Title 10 to
            the United States Code of Federal Regulations, as amended
            from time to time. ([10 C.F.R. §430.23(gg)]{.DefinedTermLink
            lang="fr"})

        [[appliance lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[appliance lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is designed and marketed to operate in a
              household appliance such as a refrigerator, oven or vacuum
              cleaner; and

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a maximum wattage of 40 W. ([lampe
              pour appareil domestique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[black light lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[black light lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
            ultraviolet lamp that has its highest radiant power peaks in
            the UV-A band (315 to 400 nm) of the electromagnetic
            spectrum. ([lampe à lumière noire]{.DefinedTermLink
            lang="fr"})

        [[bug lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[bug lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that has
            radiant power peaks above 550 nm on the electromagnetic
            spectrum and a visible yellow coating. ([lampe
            anti-insectes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[CFL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[CFL]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a compact fluorescent lamp
            that has an integrated or non-integrated single base. It
            does not include circline or U-shaped
            lamps. ([LFC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[coloured lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[coloured lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is
            designed and marketed as a coloured lamp and that, in each
            of its modes of operation, has,

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it is an incandescent lamp,

              - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a colour rendering index of less than
                50, as determined in accordance with CIE 13.3, or

              - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a correlated colour temperature of
                less than 2500 K or greater than 4600 K; and

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it is a lamp other than an
              incandescent lamp,

              - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a colour rendering index of less than
                40, as determined in accordance with CIE 13.3, or

              - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a correlated colour temperature of
                less than 2500 K or greater than 7000 K. ([lampe
                colorée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[fluorescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[fluorescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
            low-pressure mercury, electric-discharge source in which a
            fluorescing coating transforms some of the ultraviolet
            energy generated by the mercury discharge into
            light. ([lampe fluorescente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[general lighting application]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[general lighting application]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
            lighting that provides an interior or exterior area with
            overall illumination. ([source d'éclairage
            général]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[general service incandescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[general service incandescent
            lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a standard incandescent
            lamp, including a halogen type lamp, that is intended for
            general lighting applications and that

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a medium screw base;

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a lumen range of not less than 310 lm
              and not more than 2600 lm or, in the case of a modified
              spectrum incandescent lamp, not less than 232 lm and not
              more than 1950 lm; and

            - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is capable of being operated at a voltage
              that is at least partially within the range from 110 V to
              130 V.

            It does not include an appliance lamp, black light lamp, bug
            lamp, coloured lamp, G-shape lamp --- as described in ANSI
            C78.79 --- with a diameter of 127 mm (5 in) or more,
            infrared lamp, left-hand thread lamp, marine lamp, marine
            signal service lamp, mine service lamp, plant lamp, R20
            short lamp, sign service lamp, silver bowl lamp, showcase
            lamp or traffic signal lamp. ([lampe à incandescence
            standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[general service incandescent reflector lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[general service incandescent reflector
            lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp in which light is
            produced by a filament heated to incandescence by an
            electric current and that

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contains an inner reflective coating on
              the outer bulb to direct the light;

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has an R, PAR, ER, BR, BPAR or similar
              bulb shape with an E26 medium screw base;

            - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has a rated voltage or voltage range that
              lies at least partially in the range of 115 V to 130 V;

            - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has a diameter exceeding 57 mm (2.25
              inches); and

            - [(e)]{.lawlabel} has a rated wattage of 40 W or higher.

            It does not include a coloured lamp, rough service lamp,
            vibration service lamp or R20 short lamp. ([lampe-réflecteur
            à incandescence standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[general service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[general service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, subject
            to subsection (2), an electrical device that is used in
            general lighting applications and that

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a base that complies with ANSI
              C81.61;

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is able to operate, in the case of an
              integrated lamp, at

              - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a voltage of 12 V or 24V,

              - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a voltage ranging from 100 V to 130 V,

              - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a voltage ranging from 220 V to 240
                V, or

              - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a voltage of 277 V or 347 V;

            - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is able to operate at any voltage, in the
              case of a non-integrated lamp; and

            - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has an initial lumen output of

              - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at least 310 lm but no more than 3300
                lm, or

              - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a modified spectrum
                incandescent lamp, at least 232 lm but no more than 3300
                lm.

            It includes a CFL, general service incandescent lamp,
            general service incandescent reflector lamp, general service
            LED lamp and general service OLED lamp. ([lampe
            standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[general service LED lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[general service LED lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}  means an
            integrated or non-integrated lamp that is designed for use
            in general lighting applications and that uses
            light-emitting diodes as the primary source of
            light. ([lampe à DEL standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[general service OLED lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[general service OLED lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
            integrated or non-integrated lamp that is designed for use
            in general lighting applications and that uses organic
            light-emitting diodes as the primary source of
            light. ([lampe à DELO standard]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[infrared lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[infrared lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has its highest radiant power peaks in
              the infrared region of the electromagnetic spectrum (770
              nm to 1 mm);  

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a rated wattage of 125 W or greater;
              and

            - [(c)]{.lawlabel} provides heat as its primary
              purpose. ([lampe infrarouge]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[integrated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[integrated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a lamp,
            means containing all of the components necessary for the
            starting and stable operation of the lamp, not including any
            replaceable or interchangeable parts, and being connected
            directly to a branch circuit through a base and
            corresponding socket that comply with ANSI
            standards. ([intégrée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[LED downlight retrofit kit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[LED downlight retrofit kit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
            retrofit kit that is designed and marketed to install into
            an existing downlight for the purpose of replacing the
            existing light source and related electrical components with
            a light source that uses light-emitting diodes as the
            primary source of light. It includes a kit that employs an
            ANSI standard lamp base, either integrated or connected to
            the downlight retrofit by wire leads. ([ensemble de
            conversion à DEL]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[left-hand thread lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[left-hand thread lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp
            with the direction of threads on the lamp base oriented in
            the left-hand direction. ([lampe à filetage à
            gauche]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[light fixture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[light fixture]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a complete
            lighting unit consisting of at least one light source and at
            least one ballast or driver, together with the parts
            designed to distribute the light, to position and protect
            the light sources and to connect the light sources to the
            power supply. ([luminaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[marine lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[marine lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is
            designed and marketed for use on boats and that can operate
            at a voltage ranging from 12 V to 13.5 V. ([lampe
            marine]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[modified spectrum incandescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[modified spectrum incandescent
            lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an incandescent lamp that,
            when operated at the rated voltage and wattage of the lamp,
            has a colour point on the CIE 1931 chromaticity diagram,
            figure 2, page 3 of IES LM16 that lies 

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} below the black-body locus; and

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} at least 4 MacAdam steps, as referenced
              in IES LM16, distant from the colour point of a clear lamp
              with the same filament and bulb shape, operated at the
              same rated voltage and wattage.

            It does not include a coloured lamp. ([lampe à incandescence
            à spectre modifié]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[R20 short lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[R20 short lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is
            an R20 incandescent reflector lamp that is designed,
            labelled and marketed for pool and spa applications and that

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a rated wattage of 100 W; and

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a maximum overall length of 92 mm
              (3.625 inches). ([lampe courte R20]{.DefinedTermLink
              lang="fr"})

        [[reflector lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[reflector lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that has
            an R, PAR, BPAR, BR, ER, MR or similar bulb shape, as
            described in ANSI C78.79, and that is used to provide
            directional light. ([lampe-réflecteur]{.DefinedTermLink
            lang="fr"})

        [[rough service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[rough service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that
            is marketed as a rough service lamp and has any of the
            following filament constructions, as illustrated in figure
            6.12 of the IES Handbook:

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a C-7A or C-11 filament construction with
              at least five supports exclusive of lead wires;

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a C-17 filament construction with eight
              supports exclusive of lead wires;

            - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a C-22 filament construction with 16
              supports exclusive of lead wires. ([lampe à construction
              renforcée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[shatter-resistant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[shatter-resistant lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp
            that is designed and marketed as a shatter-resistant,
            shatter-proof or shatter-protected lamp and has an external
            silicone, polytetrafluoroethylene or similar coating applied
            to it for the purpose of resisting breakage and preventing
            glass from reaching its environment in the event of
            breakage. ([lampe résistante à
            l'éclatement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[showcase lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[showcase lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that is
            designed and marketed for use in a showcase, has a T-shape,
            as described in ANSI C78.79, and has a maximum rated wattage
            of 75 W. ([lampe de vitrine]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[sign service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[sign service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a vacuum
            type or gas-filled lamp that is designed and marketed for
            use in a sign and that

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has sufficiently low bulb temperature to
              permit exposed outdoor use on high-speed flashing
              circuits; and

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a maximum rated wattage of 15
              W. ([lampe d'enseigne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[silver bowl lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[silver bowl lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that
            is marketed as a silver bowl lamp and that has an opaque
            reflective coating that is applied directly to a part of the
            bulb surface so that the light is reflected toward the lamp
            base. ([lampe à calotte argentée]{.DefinedTermLink
            lang="fr"})

        [[specialty MR lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[specialty MR lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp that
            is designed and marketed for a specialty application and
            that has an MR shape, as described in ANSI C78.79, a
            diameter of less than or equal to 57 mm (2.25 inches) and a
            lifetime of 300 hours or less. ([lampe MR
            spécialisée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[three-way incandescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[three-way incandescent lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
            incandescent lamp that is marketed as a three-way lamp and
            that employs two filaments, operated separately and in
            combination, to provide three light levels. ([lampe à
            incandescence à trois intensités]{.DefinedTermLink
            lang="fr"})

        [[traffic signal lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[traffic signal lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp
            that is designed and marketed for use in a [[traffic signal
            module]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section 523,
            and that has a lifetime of 8000 hours or greater. ([lampe de
            signalisation routière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

        [[TSD D7SB001]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[TSD D7SB001]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the technical
            standards document D7SB001 published by the Minister and
            entitled General Service Lamps: Energy Efficiency Standards
            for General Service Lamps. ([DNT D7SB001]{.DefinedTermLink
            lang="fr"})

        [[vibration service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

        :   [[vibration service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a lamp
            that is sold at retail in packages of one or two, is
            designed and marketed as a vibration service lamp and

            - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a maximum nominal power of 60 W; and

            - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a C-5, C-7A or C-9 filament
              construction, as illustrated in figure 6.12 of the IES
              Handbook, or a similar configuration. ([lampe
              antivibrations]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

      - ###### Exclusion --- definition of [[general service lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} {#exclusion-definition-of-general-service-lamp .MarginalNote}

        [(2)]{.lawlabel} The definition [[general service
        lamp]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection (1) does not include

        - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a light fixture;

        - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an LED downlight retrofit kit;

        - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an appliance lamp;

        - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a black light lamp;

        - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a bug lamp;

        - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a coloured lamp;

        - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a G-shape lamp, as described in ANSI C78.79,
          with a diameter of 127 mm (5 inches) or more;

        - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a high-intensity discharge lamp;

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an infrared lamp;

        - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a J-, JC-, JCD-, JCS-, JCV-, JCX-, JD-, JS-
          or JT-shape lamp that does not have an Edison screw base as
          defined in ANSI C81.61;

        - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a lamp that has a wedge base or pre-focus
          base;

        - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a left-hand thread lamp;

        - [(m)]{.lawlabel} a marine lamp;

        - [(n)]{.lawlabel} a marine signal service lamp;

        - [(o)]{.lawlabel} a mine service lamp;

        - [(p)]{.lawlabel} an MR-shape lamp that has a first number
          symbol equal to 16 (diameter equal to 51 mm (2 inches)), as
          described in ANSI C78.79, operates at 12 V and has a lumen
          output greater than or equal to 800 lm;

        - [(q)]{.lawlabel} a fluorescent lamp other than a CFL;

        - [(r)]{.lawlabel} a plant lamp;

        - [(s)]{.lawlabel} an R20 short lamp;

        - [(t)]{.lawlabel} a reflector lamp that

          - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has a first number symbol less than 16
            (diameter less than 51 mm (2 inches)), as described in ANSI
            C78.79, and

          - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} does not have an E26/E24, E26d, E26/50x39,
            E26/53x39, E29/28, E29/53x39, E39, E39d, EP39 or EX39 base;

        - [(u)]{.lawlabel} an S-shape or G-shape lamp that has a first
          number symbol less than or equal to 12.5 (diameter less than
          or equal to 40 mm (1.5625 inches)), as described in ANSI
          C78.79;

        - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a sign service lamp;

        - [(w)]{.lawlabel} a silver bowl lamp;

        - [(x)]{.lawlabel} a showcase lamp;

        - [(y)]{.lawlabel} a specialty MR lamp;

        - [(z)]{.lawlabel} a T-shape lamp, other than a CFL, that

          - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has a first number symbol less than or
            equal to 8 (diameter less than or equal to 25 mm (1 inch)),
            as described in ANSI C78.79, and

          - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} has a nominal overall length less than 305
            mm (12 inches); or

        - [(z.1)]{.lawlabel} a traffic signal lamp.
    :::
    ::::
